title: Tariffs are Taxes, Congress Must Levy Them
affiliations: University of Akron - The George W. Daverio School of Accountancy

detail.title: Tariffs are Taxes, Congress Must Levy Them
detail.abstract: Tariffs are taxes. When presidents use emergency tools to set broad, durable tariff programs, taxing choices drift from the elected legislature to the executive. This Article proposes a reset that preserves agility without surrendering Article I. The framework has two tracks. First, Congress legislates any tariff that operates as general revenue or nationwide pricing, with Origination Clause compliance, budget scoring, and public distributional analysis so voters can see who pays. Second, the executive retains a narrow, time-limited track for defined trade harms, subject to written findings, public notice, quantitative caps, automatic sunsets, and refund mechanics. The approach accepts that taxes can regulate, but only within clear statutory boundaries that Congress sets. It aligns with early practice, improves transparency for households and firms, and replaces rolling proclamations with predictable law. Recent litigation over IEEPA stresses the stakes. A candid statute for taxation and a cabined delegation for emergencies restore accountability and keep needed tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双轨制框架来重新平衡国会与总统在关税制定上的权力：国会负责作为一般财政收入或全国性定价的关税立法，行政部门保留针对特定贸易损害的有限、有时限的紧急关税制定权，但需受多重程序约束。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能保持政策灵活性又不放弃宪法第一条（国会征税权）的关税制定框架，以解决总统使用紧急权力制定广泛、持久关税计划导致的权力转移问题？
AI.motivation: 总统使用紧急工具制定广泛、持久的关税计划，导致征税选择从民选立法机构（国会）转移到行政部门，破坏了宪法第一条确立的征税权分配原则，需要重新平衡权力并提高透明度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法第一条的征税权原则、行政紧急权力的适当边界、税收与监管功能的区分、立法与行政权力的制衡理论。
AI.method: 法律分析与制度设计方法，提出双轨制框架：1）国会立法轨道；2）行政紧急轨道，并分析其与早期实践的一致性、透明度改进和法律可预测性。
AI.findings: 提出的双轨制框架能够：1）保持政策灵活性；2）维护国会宪法征税权；3）提高对家庭和企业的透明度；4）用可预测的法律取代滚动公告；5）恢复问责制并保留必要工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上澄清了税收可以具有监管功能，但必须在国会设定的明确法定边界内；提出了在紧急权力与立法控制之间平衡的制度设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法改革提供具体方案：国会轨道包含起源条款合规、预算评分、公共分配分析；行政轨道包含书面调查结果、公开通知、数量上限、自动日落和退款机制，可应用于当前IEEPA相关诉讼的解决。

title: Pregnancy Loss and Female Labor Market Outcomes
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) and U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Tax Analysis (OTA)

detail.title: Pregnancy Loss and Female Labor Market Outcomes
detail.abstract: How do miscarriages affect women's labor market outcomes? In this paper we examine how a first miscarriage affects women's income and labor supply, using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 data in an event study framework. We find that a first miscarriage is associated with sizable and lasting negative declines in annual income and labor supply in the six-year period post-loss. The results are driven by women who eventually have children. We find suggestive evidence that women with miscarriages have stronger child penalties. Worsening mental health, marriage dissolution, and a reduction in educational attainment serve as additional mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，首次流产对女性收入和劳动供给有显著且持久的负面影响，这种影响在流产后的六年内持续存在，尤其对最终生育子女的女性影响更大。
AI.research_question: 流产如何影响女性的劳动力市场结果？具体来说，首次流产如何影响女性的收入和劳动供给？
AI.motivation: 流产是常见的妊娠并发症，但对其长期经济影响的研究相对有限。了解流产对女性职业生涯的影响对于制定支持性政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场结果理论、生育惩罚理论和心理健康对劳动力参与的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用美国国家青年纵向调查1997年数据，采用事件研究框架分析首次流产对女性收入和劳动供给的影响。
AI.findings: 首次流产与收入和劳动供给的显著且持久的负面下降相关，影响持续六年；这种影响主要出现在最终生育子女的女性中；流产女性表现出更强的生育惩罚；心理健康恶化、婚姻解体和教育程度降低是可能的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了生育惩罚理论，将流产作为影响女性劳动力市场结果的重要因素；为心理健康与劳动力参与的关系提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，支持为经历流产的女性提供心理健康支持和职业发展帮助；帮助企业制定更包容的工作场所政策。

title: Reclaiming the Egalitarian Plateau: Equality as the Basis for Altering and Abolishing Government and Hierarchy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Reclaiming the Egalitarian Plateau: Equality as the Basis for Altering and Abolishing Government and Hierarchy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The work reported in this paper is an independent project, free from the influence of any financial or personal relationships.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this theoretical analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: No financial support for the research, authorship, and publication of this article was received.

detail.abstract: This article discusses the ontological facet surrounding the right to dispose of government and hierarchy as an artificial construct, due to the verity that no person possesses a natural, biological, or metaphysical right to rule another, given the moral creed and legal construct that all men are created equal. References to Kantian and Foucauldian claims are employed to assess the mechanics of control, such as panopticism and brutality to instill subservience. Examples such as the contemporary totalitarian and tyrannical regime of the Somoza Dynasty, and the Battle of Athens (1946) are used to exhibit trains of abuse, deposition of the government, and brutality inflicted by the government. Legal constructs such as qualified immunity and the case of Sause v. Bauer are employed to demonstrate hierarchical structures and governments that put themselves in a different class from the citizens, inadvertently creating immunities and asymmetrical power structures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了统治权的本体论层面，认为政府与等级制度是人为建构，因为没有人拥有统治他人的自然、生物或形而上学权利。文章引用康德和福柯理论分析控制机制，并以索摩查王朝和雅典战役为例展示政府滥用权力、暴政和反抗。通过合格豁免权和Sause v. Bauer案等法律建构，揭示了政府如何将自己置于公民之上，创造不对称的权力结构。
AI.research_question: 政府统治权的本体论基础是什么？当政府与等级制度被视为人为建构时，如何理解统治的合法性与权力不对称？
AI.motivation: 基于"人人生而平等"的道德信条和法律建构，探讨没有人拥有统治他人的自然权利这一核心矛盾，分析政府如何通过暴力、监视等机制维持统治，以及这种权力结构如何导致滥用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 康德哲学（道德平等）、福柯理论（规训与惩罚、全景敞视主义）、政治哲学中的社会契约论、权力不对称理论。
AI.method: 理论分析（康德和福柯哲学框架）、案例研究（索摩查王朝、雅典战役1946）、法律分析（合格豁免权、Sause v. Bauer案）、比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 统治权缺乏自然或形而上学基础，完全是社会建构；2. 政府通过暴力、监视等机制维持控制；3. 法律建构（如合格豁免权）创造权力不对称；4. 历史案例显示政府滥用权力的模式；5. 等级制度将统治者置于公民之上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从本体论角度解构统治权的合法性；2. 整合康德道德哲学与福柯权力理论分析统治机制；3. 提出"人为等级建构"理论框架；4. 深化对权力不对称形成机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为批判政府权力滥用提供理论工具；2. 揭示法律建构如何维护不平等权力关系；3. 为公民抵抗暴政提供哲学依据；4. 促进对民主制度和权力制衡的反思。

title: Signaling Quality in Digital Markets with Consumers' Limited Attention

detail.title: Signaling Quality in Digital Markets with Consumers' Limited Attention
detail.abstract: This paper provides a theoretical model to understand the connection between search frictions in online environments and quality signaling. In the model, consumers allocate their limited attention between verifying product quality and revealing shrouded prices. Firms in a duopoly signal their quality through pricing, optionally employing “on-platform prominence” as a secondary tool. I show that, although the high-quality firm enjoys a local monopoly advantage from consumers who verify quality, the inefficient investment in the secondary tool is unavoidable for achieving separation. I then extend the analysis by allowing the platform to improve matching efficiency and uncover a “Platform Paradox” regarding prices and signaling costs. The intuition is that, as targeting improves, low-quality products incentive compatibility constraints become tighter and the amount of signaling spending required to deter their deviation is more substantial. Finally, I propose explanations for why a platform never wants to fully eliminate informational asymmetries.

AI.tldr: 本文构建理论模型研究在线环境中搜索摩擦与质量信号传递的关系，分析消费者注意力分配、企业质量信号传递策略，发现平台匹配效率提升会加剧信号传递成本，形成"平台悖论"。
AI.research_question: 在线环境中搜索摩擦如何影响企业质量信号传递策略？平台匹配效率提升对信号传递成本有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在线环境中消费者面临搜索摩擦，需要在验证产品质量和发现隐藏价格之间分配有限注意力，这影响了企业如何通过定价和平台工具传递质量信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论、双寡头竞争模型、消费者有限注意力分配、平台经济学
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含搜索摩擦、消费者注意力分配、企业质量信号传递的理论模型，分析均衡结果并进行扩展分析
AI.findings: 1. 高质量企业虽享有本地垄断优势，但为实现分离均衡必须进行低效的二级工具投资；2. 平台匹配效率提升会加剧信号传递成本，形成"平台悖论"；3. 平台不会完全消除信息不对称
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将搜索摩擦与质量信号传递理论结合；2. 揭示平台匹配效率与信号传递成本的悖论关系；3. 解释平台不完全消除信息不对称的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业在线质量信号传递策略提供指导；2. 帮助平台设计匹配机制时考虑信号传递成本影响；3. 解释现实中平台不完全透明化的经济理性

title:
Expanding Youth Suffrage in The Gambia:
Policy Options and Evidence for Lowering the Voting Age to 16–17 in Parliamentary and Local Government Elections (Excluding Presidential Elections)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Expanding Youth Suffrage in The Gambia:
Policy Options and Evidence for Lowering the Voting Age to 16–17 in Parliamentary and Local Government Elections (Excluding Presidential Elections)
detail.abstract: Youth political exclusion remains a persistent democratic challenge in The Gambia, where citizens aged 16–17 are excluded from electoral participation despite constituting a significant share of the population. This paper examines the democratic, legal, and policy implications of lowering the voting age to 16–17 in parliamentary and local government elections, while explicitly excluding presidential elections. Drawing on comparative international evidence and national survey data, the study assesses whether early enfranchisement can enhance democratic legitimacy, political inclusion, and long-term civic engagement. Evidence from Austria and Scotland demonstrates that enfranchising 16–17-year-olds can result in voter turnout rates equal to or higher than those of older first-time voters when supported by civic education. Afrobarometer data further indicate that a majority of Gambian youth possess basic civic awareness, alongside declining trust in political institutions, underscoring the risks of continued exclusion. The paper proposes a cautious, incremental reform strategy, beginning with voluntary pilot participation in local government elections, followed by constitutional reform for parliamentary elections. By balancing ambition with institutional capacity, the study argues that youth suffrage reform is not merely an expansion of voting rights but a strategic investment in democratic trust, inclusion, and resilience in The Gambia.

AI.tldr: 本文研究冈比亚将投票年龄降至16-17岁对议会和地方选举（不包括总统选举）的民主、法律和政策影响，提出渐进式改革策略，认为这是对民主信任、包容性和韧性的战略投资。
AI.research_question: 在冈比亚，将投票年龄降低至16-17岁（仅限议会和地方选举，不包括总统选举）会带来哪些民主、法律和政策影响？
AI.motivation: 冈比亚16-17岁公民被排除在选举参与之外，尽管他们占人口重要比例，这构成了持续的民主挑战。青年政治排斥问题需要解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主合法性理论、政治包容性理论、公民参与理论、制度能力理论，以及比较政治学中的青年选举权改革框架。
AI.method: 采用比较国际证据分析（奥地利和苏格兰案例）和国内调查数据分析（Afrobarometer数据），评估早期选举权对民主合法性、政治包容性和长期公民参与的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 奥地利和苏格兰证据显示，在公民教育支持下，16-17岁选民的投票率可等于或高于年长的首次选民；2. Afrobarometer数据显示冈比亚青年具备基本公民意识，但对政治机构的信任下降；3. 持续排斥存在风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了青年选举权改革的理论框架，强调渐进式、差异化的改革路径；2. 提出青年选举权不仅是权利扩展，更是民主信任、包容性和韧性的战略投资；3. 丰富了发展中国家青年政治参与的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出具体的渐进式改革策略：从地方政府选举自愿试点开始，再到议会选举的宪法改革；2. 为冈比亚政策制定者提供基于证据的改革建议；3. 强调公民教育在支持青年选举权改革中的关键作用；4. 为其他面临类似民主挑战的国家提供参考模式。

title: Who Pays on Wealth? Portfolio Composition and Effective Tax Rates of Wealth and Capital Income in France, 1995-2014
affiliations: University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Who Pays on Wealth? Portfolio Composition and Effective Tax Rates of Wealth and Capital Income in France, 1995-2014
detail.abstract:
This paper analyses the distributional incidence of wealth and capital income taxation in France between 1995 and 2014. Moving beyond aggregate measures of tax progressivity, it links effective tax rates to household portfolio composition across the wealth distribution, distinguishing between taxes on capital stocks and capital income flows.
Using distributional wealth data from the World Inequality Database (WID) combined with asset-level microsimulation, the paper shows that while overall effective tax rates increase with wealth, this progressivity is driven almost entirely by taxes on capital income flows. Recurrent taxes on wealth stocks contribute little across the distribution and fall disproportionately on middle-wealth households whose portfolios are dominated by housing. Wealthier households, by contrast, hold more financial assets that benefit from lighter ownership taxation and extensive exemptions. 
Framed within a simple wealth accumulation model, the findings suggest that progressive capital income taxation can coexist with rising wealth concentration when stock taxation is regressive and saving capacity is unequally distributed. The results highlight structural limits to redistribution through capital taxation and underscore the importance of asset composition for understanding long-run inequality dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1995-2014年法国财富和资本收入税的分配影响，发现虽然整体有效税率随财富增加而上升，但这种累进性几乎完全由资本收入流税驱动。财富存量税对分配影响很小，且不成比例地落在以住房为主的中间财富家庭上，而富裕家庭持有更多享受较轻所有权税和广泛豁免的金融资产。
AI.research_question: 法国财富和资本收入税在1995-2014年间的分配影响如何？不同财富阶层家庭的资产组合构成如何影响其有效税率？
AI.motivation: 超越税收累进性的总体衡量，理解财富税和资本收入税在不同财富阶层间的实际分配影响，特别是考虑家庭资产组合构成的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于简单的财富积累模型，分析资本税对长期不平等动态的影响，强调资产构成在理解税收分配效应中的重要性。
AI.method: 使用世界不平等数据库(WID)的分配财富数据，结合资产层面的微观模拟方法，将有效税率与家庭资产组合构成联系起来。
AI.findings: 1. 整体有效税率随财富增加而上升，但这种累进性几乎完全由资本收入流税驱动；2. 财富存量税对分配影响很小，且不成比例地落在以住房为主的中间财富家庭上；3. 富裕家庭持有更多享受较轻所有权税和广泛豁免的金融资产；4. 当存量税具有累退性且储蓄能力分配不均时，累进的资本收入税可以与上升的财富集中度共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了理解资本税分配影响的新框架，强调资产组合构成的关键作用；2. 揭示了累进资本收入税与上升财富集中度共存的条件；3. 强调了资本税再分配的结构性限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了资本税再分配效应的实证证据；2. 指出了当前税制设计中可能存在的公平性问题；3. 强调了考虑资产构成差异对于设计有效再分配政策的重要性。

title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Public Sector Accountability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Public Sector Accountability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence in public institutions promises a transition from traditional bureaucracy to smart governance. However, the replacement of automated decision-making systems with human agents has presented unprecedented challenges to the classical concepts of accountability, which in this paper, using the theory of accountability of "Mark Boniz" and applying the systematic review method, analyzes the question of how artificial intelligence balances power between It redefines the government and citizens. The findings of the research show that although AI promotes technical accountability and operational efficiency, it simultaneously leads to the formation of a "bureaucratic black box" that undermines political and legal accountability, and ultimately this paper proposes the framework of "accountability in design" as a solution to reduce democratic risks.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨人工智能在公共机构中如何重新定义政府与公民之间的权力平衡，发现AI虽然提升技术问责和效率，但形成"官僚黑箱"削弱政治法律问责，提出"设计问责"框架作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重新定义政府与公民之间的权力平衡？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在公共机构的快速扩张正推动从传统官僚制向智能治理转型，但自动化决策系统取代人类代理人给传统问责概念带来了前所未有的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mark Boniz的问责理论，用于分析人工智能对权力平衡的影响。
AI.method: 系统综述方法（systematic review method）。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）AI促进技术问责和运营效率；2）但同时形成"官僚黑箱"，削弱政治和法律问责；3）AI对政府与公民权力平衡产生复杂影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了Mark Boniz问责理论在人工智能时代的应用；2）提出"官僚黑箱"概念解释AI对问责的负面影响；3）发展了"设计问责"理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"设计问责"框架作为减少民主风险的解决方案，为公共机构实施AI系统提供实践指导，平衡技术效率与民主问责。

title: The Speculative Effect of Urban Proximity on Farmland Prices
affiliations: and Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin)

detail.title: The Speculative Effect of Urban Proximity on Farmland Prices

declarations.funderStatement: We are grateful to the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (German Science Foundation, DFG) for providing us with funding via DFG Research Unit 2569: Agricultural Land Markets – Efficiency and Regulation.

detail.abstract: That prices of farmland tend to be higher in the vicinity of urban areas is a well-established finding, already implied by von Thünen's (1826) pioneering analysis. It stressed that closeness to a city's lucrative market means larger returns from farming and thus higher farmland values. With the worldwide trend towards urbanization, a second source of higher land values near urban areas has come to the fore: the possibility of nearby farmland eventually being converted for a much more lucrative residential or commercial purpose. We combine GEO-coded data on plot-level transactions with six measures of urban pressure to separate this speculative effect from the von Thünen effect of urban proximity. Our estimates yield clear and robust evidence for the presence of a speculative effect on land prices in Brandenburg, Germany, the hinterland of Germany's booming capital Berlin. We find a sizable price premium of around 18% for plots under speculative pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用地理编码的土地交易数据和六种城市压力指标，分离了德国勃兰登堡州农地价格中的投机效应（未来转为住宅或商业用途的可能性）与传统的冯·杜能效应（接近城市市场带来的农业收益）。研究发现存在显著的投机效应，受投机压力的地块价格溢价约18%。
AI.research_question: 如何分离和量化农地价格中的投机效应（未来转为城市用途的可能性）与传统的冯·杜能效应（接近城市市场的农业收益）？
AI.motivation: 随着全球城市化趋势，农地价格不仅受传统农业收益影响，还受到未来转为住宅或商业用途的投机预期影响。需要分离这两种效应以理解城市周边农地价格形成的真正机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冯·杜能（von Thünen）的区位理论（接近城市市场带来更高农业收益）和城市经济学中的土地转换预期理论（投机效应）。
AI.method: 使用地理编码的德国勃兰登堡州地块级交易数据，结合六种城市压力指标（如距离城市中心距离、城市扩张趋势等），通过计量经济学方法分离两种效应。
AI.findings: 在德国柏林周边的勃兰登堡州，农地价格存在显著的投机效应，受投机压力的地块价格溢价约18%，表明未来土地用途转换预期对当前农地价格有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了冯·杜能理论，将投机效应纳入农地价格分析框架，为理解城市化背景下土地价格形成提供了更完整的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和土地管理者提供了量化投机效应的方法，有助于更准确地评估城市周边农地价值，制定合理的土地利用和城市规划政策。

title: Banks Protecting Children: Agricultural Income Shocks, Child Health, and Financial Development in Rural India

detail.title: Banks Protecting Children: Agricultural Income Shocks, Child Health, and Financial Development in Rural India
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of financial infrastructure in shaping child health outcomes in rural India, with a particular focus on whether access to rural banking mitigates the adverse effects of agricultural income shocks. Using data from the National Family and Health Surveys (NFHS), I combine child-level health outcomes with exogenous variation in local agricultural income driven by the interaction of global crop price fluctuations and location-specific agricultural conditions, alongside measures of local financial development. The results show that proximity to rural banks substantially attenuates the negative effects of income shocks on child health. These findings challenge the conventional view that rural areas with limited engagement in the formal financial sector benefit little from financial development. Instead, the evidence highlights the indirect yet economically meaningful role of expanded financial access in protecting children's health during periods of economic volatility.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度农村金融基础设施对儿童健康的影响，发现农村银行的可及性能显著缓解农业收入冲击对儿童健康的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 农村金融基础设施（特别是银行可及性）是否能够缓解农业收入冲击对印度农村儿童健康的不利影响？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，农村地区由于参与正规金融部门有限，从金融发展中获益甚微。本研究旨在挑战这一观点，探索金融基础设施在保护儿童健康方面的间接作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合发展经济学、健康经济学和金融发展理论，探讨金融基础设施作为缓冲机制在应对收入冲击中的作用。
AI.method: 使用印度国家家庭健康调查（NFHS）数据，将儿童健康结果与农业收入冲击（全球作物价格波动与当地农业条件交互作用）以及当地金融发展指标相结合进行分析。
AI.findings: 接近农村银行显著减轻了收入冲击对儿童健康的负面影响，表明金融基础设施在经济波动期间对保护儿童健康具有重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于农村金融发展效益有限的观念，揭示了金融基础设施在缓解收入冲击、保护儿童健康方面的间接但重要的经济作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了证据，支持在农村地区扩大金融基础设施投资，特别是在经济波动期间保护弱势群体（如儿童）的健康。

title: Holistic Design for Living Traditions: Reframing Paete's Arts and Crafts Ecosystem through the Door to Asia Program

detail.title: Holistic Design for Living Traditions: Reframing Paete's Arts and Crafts Ecosystem through the Door to Asia Program
detail.abstract: This paper presents a holistic, ecosystem-based framework for sustaining living craft traditions, grounded in insights derived from the Door to Asia Program of the Japan Foundation implemented in Paete, Laguna, Philippines. Drawing from direct engagement with local artisans, designers, cultural intermediaries, and community stakeholders, the study reframes Paete's arts and crafts not as isolated creative outputs but as an interconnected cultural production ecosystem. The paper maps the full craft supply chain from market demand and raw material sourcing to tool-making, production, finishing, mediation, and market access-highlighting critical yet endangered sectors such as the Panday (blacksmith). By analyzing design propositions developed during the program, the study argues that sustainability in heritage crafts requires integrated, community-centered, and research-informed interventions rather than sectoral, aesthetic-driven, or tourism-focused approaches. The paper contributes to discourse on creative economies, design for social innovation, and cultural heritage sustainability by positioning Paete as a case of a living tradition that can only endure through systemic support and inclusive design planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于生态系统的整体框架来维持活态工艺传统，以日本基金会"亚洲之门"项目在菲律宾帕埃特的经验为基础，将工艺视为相互关联的文化生产生态系统而非孤立创意产出。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整体、生态系统的方法来维持活态工艺传统的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统工艺面临消亡风险，现有方法（如旅游导向、美学驱动或部门化干预）不足以维持活态传统，需要更系统、社区中心的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统理论、文化生产系统理论、创意经济理论、社会创新设计理论、文化遗产可持续发展理论。
AI.method: 基于日本基金会"亚洲之门"项目的参与式行动研究，通过直接与当地工匠、设计师、文化中介和社区利益相关者合作，分析设计提案并绘制完整工艺供应链。
AI.findings: 帕埃特工艺是一个相互关联的文化生产生态系统；关键环节（如铁匠）濒危；工艺可持续性需要整合、社区中心和研究驱动的干预，而非部门化、美学驱动或旅游导向的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创意经济、社会创新设计和文化遗产可持续发展理论提供生态系统视角；提出活态传统只能通过系统支持和包容性设计规划来维持的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供基于生态系统的干预框架；强调社区参与和系统支持的重要性；为类似活态工艺传统的保护提供可借鉴的案例和方法。

title: Inequalities in Out-of-Pocket Expenditure for Vascular Healthcare Services in Eastern Uttar Pradesh
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Inequalities in Out-of-Pocket Expenditure for Vascular Healthcare Services in Eastern Uttar Pradesh
detail.abstract: Background & Objectives: This study rigorously examines the magnitude and factors influencing inequities in out-of-pocket expenditure (OOP) for vascular healthcare services in Eastern Uttar Pradesh. Vascular diseases necessitating expensive diagnostics, medical management, and surgical or endovascular interventions frequently impose a considerable financial burden on households. The main goal is to find out how much more people spend on vascular care out of pocket and what social, economic, and health system factors cause these differences in both inpatient and outpatient settings. Methods: The analysis is based on primary household-level data that was gathered from two districts of Eastern Uttar Pradesh. The distribution and concentration of vascular-related OOP spending across socioeconomic strata have been evaluated using a combination of descriptive statistics and sophisticated inequality measures like the Lorenz curve, Gini coefficient, and Theil index. These tools make it possible to comprehend financial inequalities in vascular diagnostics, emergency care, surgery, and long-term disease management in detail. Results: Significant inequalities in OOP spending for vascular healthcare are revealed by empirical findings. Financial stress is significantly increased by the high costs of necessary vascular services, such as diagnostic imaging (Doppler, CT angiography), medications (antiplatelets, anticoagulants), surgical and endovascular procedures, operation theatre fees, blood transfusions, and oxygen support. Low-income and rural households continue to bear a disproportionately heavy burden, which restricts equitable access to timely and appropriate vascular care and may exacerbate disease outcomes. Interpretation & Conclusions: The study highlights an urgent need for targeted policy reforms to reduce financial barriers to vascular healthcare in Eastern Uttar Pradesh. Important steps toward equity include strengthening Universal Health Coverage (UHC), increasing vascular care services at PHCs and CHCs, enhancing referral systems, and lowering reliance on expensive private facilities. Inequalities in financial burden and vascular health outcomes will continue to exist in the absence of systemic improvements. For vascular healthcare to be accessible, affordable, and equitable for all socioeconomic groups, it is imperative that these inequalities be addressed urgently.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了印度东部北方邦血管医疗自付费用的不平等程度及影响因素，发现低收入和农村家庭承担了不成比例的医疗负担，并提出了加强全民健康覆盖等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 印度东部北方邦血管医疗自付费用存在多大程度的不平等？哪些社会、经济和卫生系统因素导致了这些不平等？
AI.motivation: 血管疾病需要昂贵的诊断、医疗管理和手术干预，给家庭带来沉重的财务负担，特别是在资源有限的地区，了解这些不平等对于制定公平的医疗政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康不平等理论、医疗融资公平性理论、社会经济分层对医疗可及性影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于东部北方邦两个地区的家庭层面原始数据，采用描述性统计和先进的不平等测量工具（洛伦兹曲线、基尼系数、泰尔指数）分析血管相关自付费用的分布和集中度。
AI.findings: 研究发现血管医疗自付费用存在显著不平等。必要的血管服务（如诊断成像、药物、手术和血管内手术、手术室费用、输血和氧气支持）的高成本显著增加了财务压力。低收入和农村家庭承担了不成比例的沉重负担，限制了公平获得及时和适当的血管护理，可能加剧疾病结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为血管医疗融资不平等提供了实证证据，深化了对社会经济因素如何影响医疗可及性和财务负担的理解，丰富了健康不平等理论在特定医疗领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了针对性的政策改革建议，包括加强全民健康覆盖、在初级和社区卫生中心增加血管护理服务、改进转诊系统、减少对昂贵私立设施的依赖，为改善血管医疗公平性提供了具体路径。

title: Implied Volatility as a Geometric Object: A Structural Interpretation of the Volatility Surface

detail.title: Implied Volatility as a Geometric Object: A Structural Interpretation of the Volatility Surface

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a structural interpretation of the implied volatility surface, treating it as a geometric system in dynamic equilibrium rather than merely a functional object to be fitted. Although the literature provides robust arbitrage-free parametrizationssuch as SVI and eSSVI-the analysis of implied volatility remains largely centered on pointwise calibration, with limited ability to distinguish transient fluctuations from persistent structural shifts. Taking the eSSVI surface as an admissible reference geometry, we introduce an internal decomposition metric that represents the observed surface as a structured deformation around an equilibrium state. This decomposition explicitly separates components associated with the displacement of the skew vertex, local curvature, term structure, call-put asymmetry, and the overall volatility regime, yielding dimensionless coefficients that are stable and comparable over time and across assets. The proposed approach does not introduce a new surface parametrization nor does it alter arbitrage-free conditions. Instead, it complements existing models by providing a structural reading of implied volatility. Empirical evidence based on equity options traded on the Brazilian exchange (B3) suggests that the metric consistently captures regime transitions, structural reorganizations, and stress periods, while remaining robust even in low-liquidity environments. Overall, the results indicate that a geometric interpretation of implied volatility delivers relevant information for mark-to-market valuation, risk analysis, and dynamic hedging, offering a conceptual bridge between arbitrage-free surfaces and the observed dynamics of option markets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种隐含波动率曲面的结构解释方法，将其视为动态均衡的几何系统而非仅需拟合的函数对象。通过引入内部分解度量，将观测曲面表示为均衡状态周围的结构化变形，分离出偏度顶点位移、局部曲率、期限结构、看涨-看跌不对称性和整体波动率机制等成分，得到稳定可比的维度系数。
AI.research_question: 如何从结构角度解释隐含波动率曲面，区分瞬态波动与持久结构变化，并提供稳定可比的度量指标？
AI.motivation: 现有隐含波动率分析主要关注点对点校准，难以区分瞬态波动与持久结构变化。虽然已有SVI和eSSVI等无套利参数化方法，但缺乏对曲面结构动态的系统性解读。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何系统理论、动态均衡理论、结构化变形理论、无套利条件理论
AI.method: 以eSSVI曲面作为参考几何，引入内部分解度量，将观测曲面分解为均衡状态周围的结构化变形，分离出五个结构成分：偏度顶点位移、局部曲率、期限结构、看涨-看跌不对称性、整体波动率机制。
AI.findings: 基于巴西交易所(B3)股票期权的实证证据表明，该度量方法能一致捕捉机制转换、结构重组和压力时期，即使在低流动性环境中也保持稳健。分解得到的维度系数在时间和资产间具有稳定性和可比性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出隐含波动率曲面的几何系统解释框架；2. 建立结构化变形分解方法；3. 提供无套利曲面与市场观测动态之间的概念桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为盯市估值提供相关信息；2. 改进风险分析方法；3. 增强动态对冲策略；4. 在低流动性环境中保持稳健性；5. 提供跨资产和时间的可比指标。

title: Risk-Based Auditing in Public Finance Management
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Risk-Based Auditing in Public Finance Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare the sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Persistent inefficiencies in public finance management (PFM) and the limitations of traditional audit approaches continue to undermine fiscal accountability, particularly in emerging economies. This study critically reviews and synthesizes empirical and conceptual literature on risk-based auditing (RBA) in PFM, focusing on its effectiveness, challenges, and adoption across diverse contexts. The review reveals that RBA significantly enhances audit quality by prioritizing high-risk areas, improving fiscal transparency, and supporting informed decision-making. Evidence indicates that RBA facilitates early detection of irregularities, strengthens compliance, and contributes to more efficient resource allocation. However, its implementation faces notable challenges, including capacity gaps, limited auditor expertise, inconsistent application of methodologies, and resistance to change (Vu, Abu Afifa, & Tran; Griffiths, 2016; Mujalli, 2024). The findings underscore that while RBA offers substantial potential to strengthen PFM systems, its success is contingent upon strategic integration with digital technologies, ongoing training, and institutional support. This synthesis provides actionable insights for policymakers and audit institutions, highlighting the need for tailored RBA frameworks that address contextual constraints while leveraging technology to optimize audit effectiveness and promote accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了基于风险的审计（RBA）在公共财政管理（PFM）中的应用，发现RBA能显著提升审计质量、增强财政透明度，但实施面临能力差距、方法论不一致等挑战，成功需结合数字技术、持续培训和制度支持。
AI.research_question: 基于风险的审计（RBA）在公共财政管理（PFM）中的有效性、挑战和采用情况如何？
AI.motivation: 公共财政管理持续低效和传统审计方法的局限性，特别是在新兴经济体，正在削弱财政问责制，需要探索更有效的审计方法。

AI.method: 对基于风险的审计在公共财政管理中的实证和概念文献进行批判性回顾与综合

title: Event-Driven Oil Market Volatility and Trading Strategy Implications of Supply-Side Disruptions An Applied Demonstration within the Global Supply Chain Disruption Index (GSCDI) Framework
affiliations: Global Supply Chain and Independent author

detail.title: Event-Driven Oil Market Volatility and Trading Strategy Implications of Supply-Side Disruptions An Applied Demonstration within the Global Supply Chain Disruption Index (GSCDI) Framework
detail.abstract: Oil markets are increasingly influenced by discrete supply-side disruptions arising from geopolitical events, production outages, logistics constraints, and policy actions. This paper presents an applied, event-driven framework for interpreting oil market volatility and systemic supply-chain stress, operationalized through the Global Supply Chain Disruption Index (GSCDI). The framework integrates structured event classification, market state measurement, volatility regime identification, and impact aggregation to generate daily pressure and risk signals for the oil market. Using empirical testing over the 2015-2025 period, the study produces chart-based outputs including eventconditioned volatility responses, regime-dependent impact patterns, indicators, and an aggregate GSCDI oil pressure index. Results show that clusters of high-impact supply-side events are associated with persistent volatility elevation and regime transitions, signaling rising systemic stress rather than isolated price movements. The framework emphasizes risk interpretation over price prediction, offering a practical tool for monitoring uncertainty and escalation dynamics in disruption-driven oil markets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个事件驱动的框架，通过全球供应链中断指数（GSCDI）来解读石油市场波动性和系统性供应链压力，强调风险解释而非价格预测。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解读和监测由地缘政治事件、生产中断等离散供应侧中断驱动的石油市场波动性和系统性供应链压力？
AI.motivation: 石油市场日益受到地缘政治事件、生产中断、物流约束和政策行动等离散供应侧中断的影响，需要新的框架来理解市场波动性和系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件驱动分析框架，整合了结构化事件分类、市场状态测量、波动性制度识别和影响聚合等理论概念。
AI.method: 应用事件驱动框架，通过全球供应链中断指数（GSCDI）进行操作化，包括结构化事件分类、市场状态测量、波动性制度识别和影响聚合，使用2015-2025年数据进行实证测试。
AI.findings: 高影响供应侧事件集群与持续波动性升高和制度转变相关，表明系统性压力上升而非孤立的价格变动；框架能够生成事件条件波动响应、制度依赖影响模式等图表输出。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合事件分类、市场状态测量和波动性制度识别的综合理论框架，强调风险解释而非价格预测，为理解中断驱动的石油市场提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的全球供应链中断指数（GSCDI）工具，能够生成每日压力和风险信号，帮助监测石油市场不确定性和升级动态，为决策者提供实际风险管理工具。

title: Impact of Global Climate Change on The Labour Market: Evidence from Türkiye
affiliations: and Dokuz Eylül University

detail.title: Impact of Global Climate Change on The Labour Market: Evidence from Türkiye
detail.abstract: In the literature, the relationship between climate change and the labour market is discussed in terms of whether climate policies create employment opportunities or increase unemployment. Therefore, whether the transition to renewable energy will increase unemployment or create employment opportunities is an important research topic. This study aims to investigate the relationship between unemployment and the use of renewable energy by focusing on the Turkish labour market. In the study, the Augmented Autoregressive Distributed Lag test is applied to determine the short and long-run relationships of the variables with annual data for the period 1990-2019 obtained from the International Energy Agency and TurkStat databases. The results of the study show that in the long-run, a 1% increase in non-renewable energy reduces unemployment by 1.64%, while renewable energy reduces unemployment by 2.03%. In the short-run, every 1% increase in the use of renewable energy reduces unemployment by 1.06%, while a 1% increase in the use of non-renewable energy reduces unemployment by 1.31%. In this context, it is possible to say that non-renewable energy sources have a greater impact on unemployment in the short-run. The results of the research suggest that climate policies focussing on renewable energy in Turkey can help fight unemployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨土耳其劳动力市场中可再生能源使用与失业率的关系，发现无论是可再生能源还是不可再生能源都能降低失业率，但可再生能源在长期效果更显著，而不可再生能源在短期效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 土耳其劳动力市场中，向可再生能源转型会增加失业率还是创造就业机会？可再生能源使用与失业率之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 气候变化与劳动力市场关系的研究中，气候政策是创造就业机会还是增加失业存在争议。研究土耳其这一新兴经济体的可再生能源转型对就业的影响，对制定气候政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源转型与就业关系的理论框架，探讨可再生能源发展对劳动力市场的影响机制，包括绿色就业创造和传统能源就业替代效应。
AI.method: 采用增强自回归分布滞后检验方法，分析1990-2019年土耳其年度数据，数据来源于国际能源署和土耳其统计局数据库，研究变量间的短期和长期关系。
AI.findings: 长期来看，可再生能源使用增加1%可降低失业率2.03%，不可再生能源增加1%降低失业率1.64%。短期来看，可再生能源增加1%降低失业率1.06%，不可再生能源增加1%降低失业率1.31%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源转型与就业关系的理论提供了实证支持，揭示了可再生能源在长期对就业的积极影响大于不可再生能源，丰富了发展中国家绿色就业的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明聚焦可再生能源的气候政策有助于应对失业问题，支持了绿色能源转型与就业增长的双赢策略。

title: The Economics of Return Insurance
affiliations: Seoul National University - Business School

detail.title: The Economics of Return Insurance
detail.abstract: Risk-averse consumers purchase products if they match their preferences, but decide whether to return them if they do not. Consumers are assumed to be identical except for their preferences and exchange costs. The analysis yields the following results. First, offering return insurance or free returns is superior to no insurance. This is due to consumers' risk aversion. Second, the proportion of consumers returning products increases in the order of no insurance, return insurance, and free returns. This is because purchasing insurance leads to lower return costs. Third, when sellers can choose return strategies, in equilibrium, (i) all three strategies coexist, (ii) only return insurance exist, or (iii) only no insurance and free returns coexist.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了风险厌恶消费者在退货保险策略下的购买和退货行为。研究发现：提供退货保险或免费退货优于不提供保险；退货比例随保险程度增加而上升；市场均衡中三种退货策略可能共存或特定组合存在。
AI.research_question: 风险厌恶消费者的退货保险策略如何影响购买决策、退货行为和市场均衡？
AI.motivation: 消费者面临产品不匹配偏好时的退货决策受风险态度影响，商家需要了解不同退货保险策略对消费者行为和市场均衡的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险厌恶理论、消费者行为理论、博弈论（市场均衡分析）
AI.method: 理论建模分析，假设消费者除偏好和交换成本外同质，分析不同退货保险策略下的消费者决策和市场均衡
AI.findings: 1. 提供退货保险或免费退货优于不提供保险（因消费者风险厌恶）；2. 退货比例按无保险、退货保险、免费退货顺序递增（保险降低退货成本）；3. 市场均衡中三种策略可能共存，或仅退货保险存在，或仅无保险和免费退货共存
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了风险厌恶消费者退货决策的理论框架，揭示了退货保险策略对消费者行为的影响机制，分析了市场均衡中不同退货策略的共存条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为商家设计退货策略提供理论指导：应考虑消费者风险厌恶特性，理解不同保险策略对退货率的影响，根据市场均衡条件选择最优策略组合

title: Two Price Equilibria for Uncertain Economies With a Stock Market
affiliations: Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Two Price Equilibria for Uncertain Economies With a Stock Market
detail.abstract: An economic equilibrium is defined for an economy with uncertainty in preferences and technologies and the absence of state contingent pricing. A risk absorbing clearing agent, RACA, is introduced and it takes all the uncertainty in the economy. Goods and services are priced to a level of risk acceptability defined by a convex cone of random variables containing the nonnegative random variables. The resulting economy is a two price economy with the RACA setting higher buying prices than selling prices. Additionally the RACA absorbs the randomness in profits by valuing firm to a convex set of risk acceptability defined by a rebate function announcing loss limits for extreme departures from the norm. The resulting valuations permit a study of equilibrium price earnings ratios. It is observed that these ratios rise with an increase in the uncertainty of the real economy.

AI.tldr: 本文引入风险吸收清算代理(RACA)来处理具有不确定偏好和技术、缺乏状态依存定价的经济体，建立了一个双价格经济均衡模型，其中RACA吸收所有经济不确定性，并允许研究均衡市盈率如何随实体经济不确定性增加而上升。
AI.research_question: 在具有不确定偏好和技术、缺乏状态依存定价的经济体中，如何建立经济均衡模型？风险吸收清算代理(RACA)如何运作？均衡市盈率如何随实体经济不确定性变化？
AI.motivation: 现实经济中存在偏好和技术的不确定性，但缺乏状态依存定价机制，需要建立能够处理这种不确定性的经济均衡框架，并研究风险吸收机制对价格和估值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 经济均衡理论；2) 风险吸收清算代理(RACA)概念；3) 基于凸锥的风险可接受性定价；4) 双价格经济模型；5) 基于回扣函数的损失限制估值方法。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：引入RACA作为风险吸收者，使用凸锥定义风险可接受性水平，建立双价格经济均衡模型，通过回扣函数定义企业估值的风险可接受性凸集。
AI.findings: 1) 建立了包含RACA的经济均衡模型；2) RACA设定买入价高于卖出价，形成双价格经济；3) RACA通过回扣函数吸收利润随机性；4) 均衡市盈率随实体经济不确定性增加而上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出RACA概念和双价格经济均衡框架；2) 发展基于凸锥的风险可接受性定价理论；3) 建立不确定性经济中的企业估值方法；4) 揭示市盈率与不确定性之间的理论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为风险管理机构设计提供理论依据；2) 为不确定环境下的资产定价提供新方法；3) 帮助理解市场市盈率变化的经济学原理；4) 为政策制定者管理经济不确定性提供参考。

title: The Drift Velocity Paradox Why Electrical Current Cannot Be Particle Transport A Substrate-Based Resolution of Signal Propagation in Conductors

detail.title: The Drift Velocity Paradox Why Electrical Current Cannot Be Particle Transport A Substrate-Based Resolution of Signal Propagation in Conductors

publicationDetails.detailsText: Jamie L., C. (2025). The Drift Velocity Paradox: Why Electrical Current Cannot Be Particle Transport (1.0). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18059097

detail.abstract: Electrical current is universally taught as the flow of electrons through a conductor. Yet direct measurement demonstrates that electron drift velocities in metals occur at millimeters per second, while electrical signals, power delivery, and electromagnetic effects propagate at velocities approaching the speed of light. This discrepancy-rarely addressed beyond pedagogical metaphor-constitutes a fundamental contradiction in the standard particle-transport interpretation of electricity. This paper formalizes the Drift Velocity Paradox as an unavoidable conflict between empirical measurement and explanatory model. By systematically examining drift velocity calculations, signal propagation physics, transmission line behavior, the Poynting vector, and alternating current dynamics, it demonstrates that electrons cannot be the primary carriers of electrical action. The paradox is resolved through a substrate-based interpretation consistent with Quantum Aether Electrodynamics (QAE), wherein electrical current is identified as Phase Coherence Transport within a continuous medium, while matter functions as a coupling scaffold rather than an energy courier. Displacement current is elevated from auxiliary term to primary mechanism, and energy flow is correctly localized to the surrounding field structure rather than the conductor volume. This work does not reject Maxwellian electrodynamics or circuit theory. Instead, it exposes a foundational pedagogical failure and provides a physically coherent resolution that restores ontological consistency to electrical theory. Together with QAE, this paper replaces particle-based mysticism with a mechanically intelligible framework grounded in resonance, impedance, and phase continuity.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了传统教学中电流作为电子流动模型与电磁信号以光速传播之间的根本矛盾，提出了基于量子以太电动力学的相干传输理论，将电流重新解释为连续介质中的相位相干传输而非粒子运动。
AI.research_question: 如果电子漂移速度仅为毫米/秒级别，而电磁信号以接近光速传播，那么电子如何成为电流的主要载体？如何解决这一漂移速度悖论？
AI.motivation: 传统教学中将电流描述为电子在导体中的流动，但这与电磁信号以光速传播的观测事实存在根本矛盾，这一悖论在教学中通常被隐喻掩盖，需要物理上一致的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子以太电动力学（QAE）、麦克斯韦电磁理论、传输线理论、坡印廷矢量、位移电流理论、相位相干传输理论。
AI.method: 系统分析漂移速度计算、信号传播物理、传输线行为、坡印廷矢量、交流电动力学，通过理论推导和矛盾分析来验证传统模型的局限性。
AI.findings: 电子不能作为电作用的主要载体；电流本质上是连续介质中的相位相干传输；位移电流是主要机制而非辅助项；能量流动定位于周围场结构而非导体体积。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化漂移速度悖论；提出基于QAE的基底解释框架；将位移电流提升为主要机制；建立基于共振、阻抗和相位连续性的机械可理解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示基础教学失败；提供物理一致的解释方案；恢复电学理论的本体论一致性；用机械可理解的框架替代基于粒子的神秘主义。

title: Evaluating the Effect of COVID-19 Tax Relief Measures on SME Compliance

detail.title: Evaluating the Effect of COVID-19 Tax Relief Measures on SME Compliance

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of COVID-19 tax relief measures on the compliance behavior of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The pandemic prompted governments worldwide to introduce relief policies aimed at mitigating economic disruptions, yet the extent to which these measures influenced SME tax compliance remains underexplored. Employing a mixed-methods approach, the study combines survey data, in-depth interviews, and secondary data analysis of SMEs during the pandemic (Ngoma, 2024; Munyemana, Mung'atu & Ruranga, 2024). Findings indicate that SMEs with access to relief programs demonstrated higher levels of compliance, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted fiscal support in encouraging formalization and adherence to tax obligations. However, significant gaps persist among informal SMEs and those unable to access relief, underscoring inequities in policy reach (Faiz, 2024; Sugiartini, 2025). The study further reveals that while relief measures provide immediate incentives for compliance, sustained adherence is contingent upon consistent enforcement, increased awareness, and supportive guidance from tax authorities (Saptono et al., 2024; Alshira'h, 2024). Overall, the research concludes that well-targeted relief policies can enhance SME compliance during crises, but comprehensive strategies addressing access, education, and monitoring are essential to maximize impact. These insights contribute to ongoing policy debates on crisis-responsive tax interventions and the role of equitable support mechanisms in fostering SME formalization and compliance resilience.

title: Numeraire Construction in Multi-Currency Historical Data:,Evidence from Early Modern Art Auctions, 1690–1859
affiliations: Singapore University of Social Sciences

detail.title: Numeraire Construction in Multi-Currency Historical Data:,Evidence from Early Modern Art Auctions, 1690–1859
detail.abstract: Economic historians routinely face a practical challenge: how to combine price records denominated in different currencies—for example, splicing pre-revolutionary French livres with post-Napoleonic British pounds when no overlapping observations exist. Using 351,846 art auction transactions from the Getty Provenance Index (1690–1859), we clarify when numeraire choice matters and when it does not. First, when currency fixed effects are included, native-unit and silver-equivalent specifications yield identical residuals: conversion reparameterizes intercepts but adds no information. Second, when currency controls are unavailable—because a currency is sparse or appears only out-of-sample—unit harmonization matters substantially. In leave-one-currency-out exercises, direct estimation in a common numeraire reduces prediction error by 14–34% (20% on average). Unit harmonization is therefore redundant when currency coverage is complete but essential for dataset splicing and sparse-currency settings—conditions frequently encountered when constructing long-run price and wage series.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了经济史研究中不同货币单位价格记录合并的实际挑战，通过分析1690-1859年间351,846笔艺术品拍卖交易数据，明确了何时选择计价单位重要、何时不重要。
AI.research_question: 在经济史研究中，当需要将不同货币单位的价格记录合并时（如法国革命前的里弗尔和拿破仑后的英镑），如何选择计价单位？在什么情况下计价单位的选择会影响分析结果？
AI.motivation: 经济史学家经常面临将不同货币单位的价格记录拼接的实际挑战，特别是在构建长期价格和工资序列时，当没有重叠观测数据时，如何正确处理货币单位转换问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币单位转换理论、固定效应模型、预测误差分析、数据集拼接方法。
AI.method: 使用Getty Provenance Index的351,846笔艺术品拍卖交易数据（1690-1859年），通过两种方法比较：1）包含货币固定效应的模型；2）直接转换为共同计价单位（如白银等价物）。进行"留一货币出"交叉验证实验。
AI.findings: 1）当包含货币固定效应时，使用原始单位或白银等价单位会产生相同的残差，转换只是重新参数化截距而不增加信息；2）当货币控制不可用时（如货币稀疏或仅出现在样本外），单位统一至关重要，直接使用共同计价单位可将预测误差降低14-34%（平均20%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上明确了货币单位转换在经济史分析中的作用边界：当货币覆盖完整时是冗余的，但在数据集拼接和稀疏货币环境下是必要的。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济史学家提供了实用的指导：在构建长期价格序列时，当面临稀疏货币或需要拼接数据集时，必须进行单位统一；当有完整货币覆盖时，可以直接使用原始单位并加入货币固定效应。

title: Will AI Replace or Enhance Human Intelligence in Asset Management?
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University - Lazaridis School of Business and Economics and University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics

detail.title: Will AI Replace or Enhance Human Intelligence in Asset Management?
detail.abstract: Using  data from LinkedIn profiles, we measure the adoption of AI technologies by mutual fund managers. Compared to low-AI funds, high-AI funds generate superior returns and incur lower expenses. The stock-picking abilities of high-AI funds improve with the availability of big data, such as satellite imagery of parking lots. Consistent with AI complementing investment skills, outperformance is particularly strong among discretionary funds, which rely on human judgment, as opposed to quantitative funds. The greater the AI adoption, the more pronounced the time-varying skill of fund managers across different market conditions.  The local availability of AI skills is a key determinant of cross-sectional variation in mutual fund AI investment. Our findings are robust to using geographic variation in AI supply as an instrument for AI utilization by mutual funds.

AI.tldr: 使用LinkedIn数据衡量共同基金经理的AI技术采用情况。高AI基金相比低AI基金产生更高回报且费用更低，其选股能力随大数据可用性而提升。AI对依赖人类判断的自主型基金表现提升尤为明显，AI采用程度越高，基金经理在不同市场条件下的时变技能越显著。
AI.research_question: 共同基金经理采用AI技术如何影响基金绩效？AI技术如何与基金经理的投资技能相互作用？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在金融领域的应用日益广泛，了解AI如何影响共同基金的投资决策和绩效变得重要。现有研究缺乏对基金经理AI采用程度与基金绩效关系的实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技能互补理论，AI技术可能增强而非替代人类投资技能；大数据可用性理论，AI效果受数据环境调节；资源依赖理论，本地AI技能供给影响AI采用。
AI.method: 使用LinkedIn个人资料数据衡量基金经理AI技术采用程度；比较高低AI基金绩效差异；利用卫星图像等大数据可用性作为调节变量；区分自主型和量化基金；使用地理AI技能供给作为工具变量进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 高AI基金产生更高回报且费用更低；AI选股能力随大数据可用性提升；AI对自主型基金表现提升更显著；AI采用程度越高，基金经理时变技能越明显；本地AI技能供给是基金AI投资横截面差异的关键决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证AI与人类技能的互补关系而非替代关系；揭示AI效果受数据环境调节的机制；提出本地技能供给影响技术采用的新视角；丰富金融科技与投资绩效关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金公司AI投资决策提供实证依据；帮助投资者识别AI技术应用带来的超额收益；为监管机构理解AI对金融市场影响提供参考；指导AI技能人才培养和区域布局。

title: Evaluating The Effectiveness Of Cybersecurity Audits In Reducing
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Evaluating The Effectiveness Of Cybersecurity Audits In Reducing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients or participants. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research/project did not receive any specific funding from public, commercial, or non-profit organizations.

detail.abstract: The increasing frequency, sophistication, and financial impact of data breaches have elevated cybersecurity to a strategic priority for organizations worldwide. Cybersecurity audits have emerged as a critical governance and assurance mechanism designed to assess, monitor, and strengthen an organization’s security posture. However, despite their widespread adoption, empirical evidence on the effectiveness of cybersecurity audits in reducing data breaches remains fragmented. This study evaluates the effectiveness of cybersecurity audits in mitigating data breaches by examining their role in risk identification, control enforcement, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of security practices. Using a conceptual and empirical review framework, the study synthesizes findings from prior literature, industry reports, and publicly disclosed breach data to analyze whether organizations with mature and continuous cybersecurity audit practices experience fewer and less severe data breaches. The findings suggest that cybersecurity audits significantly contribute to reducing breach likelihood and impact when they are risk-based, continuous, and integrated into enterprise governance structures. However, compliance-driven and infrequent audits show limited effectiveness. The study contributes to cybersecurity governance literature by clarifying the conditions under which cybersecurity audits are most effective and provides practical recommendations for organizations, auditors, and regulators.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估网络安全审计在减少数据泄露方面的有效性，发现基于风险、持续且融入企业治理结构的审计能显著降低泄露可能性和影响，而合规驱动、不频繁的审计效果有限。
AI.research_question: 网络安全审计在减轻数据泄露方面是否有效？在什么条件下网络安全审计最有效？
AI.motivation: 数据泄露的频率、复杂性和财务影响不断增加，网络安全已成为全球组织的战略重点。网络安全审计作为关键治理和保证机制被广泛采用，但其有效性的实证证据仍然零散。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络安全治理理论、风险管理理论、合规理论、持续改进理论
AI.method: 采用概念性和实证性综述框架，综合先前文献、行业报告和公开披露的泄露数据，分析具有成熟和持续网络安全审计实践的组织是否经历更少和更不严重的数据泄露。
AI.findings: 网络安全审计在基于风险、持续且融入企业治理结构时，能显著降低数据泄露的可能性和影响。合规驱动和不频繁的审计效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清网络安全审计最有效的条件，为网络安全治理文献做出贡献，提供审计有效性边界条件的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织、审计师和监管机构提供实用建议，强调需要从合规驱动转向基于风险、持续和集成化的审计实践。

title: Carbon Emission Trading, Employment, and Skill Heterogeneity: Evidence from China
affiliations: University of Manchester, Global Development Institute, Students, affiliation not provided to SSRN and The University of Manchester

detail.title: Carbon Emission Trading, Employment, and Skill Heterogeneity: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This paper examines the employment impact of the pilot carbon trading scheme in China, by distinguishing between high- and low-skill workforces. Exploiting the setting of eight regional carbon markets as a quasi-experiment, we adopt a staggered DID research design and estimate the employment effects using firm-level data on listed companies over a sample period of 2011-2018. The analysis results reveal that the scheme does not have an impact on firms’ overall employment or the size of high-skill labour, but it is associated with an increase in the size of low-skill employment. We also observe a significant increase in the share of low-skill workers in total employment and a decrease in the share of high-skill labour, indicative of a skill downgrade in workforce among treated firms. We further find suggestive evidence of end-of-pipe abatement that drives the increases in the employment of low-skill workers.

AI.tldr: 中国碳交易试点政策对就业的影响：研究发现碳交易试点并未影响企业总体就业或高技能劳动力规模，但增加了低技能就业规模，导致劳动力技能结构降级，主要源于末端治理技术的采用。
AI.research_question: 中国碳交易试点政策如何影响企业就业结构，特别是对高技能和低技能劳动力的不同影响？
AI.motivation: 碳交易政策作为重要的环境规制工具，其就业效应存在争议，特别是对不同技能层次劳动力的影响机制尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制理论、技能偏向型技术进步理论、劳动力需求理论、准实验设计方法
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered DID），利用中国八个区域碳市场试点作为准实验，使用2011-2018年上市公司微观数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 碳交易试点未影响企业总体就业规模；2. 未影响高技能劳动力规模；3. 显著增加了低技能就业规模；4. 低技能劳动力占比上升，高技能占比下降，出现技能降级；5. 低技能就业增加主要由末端治理技术驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了碳交易政策对劳动力市场的异质性影响；2. 验证了环境规制可能导致劳动力技能结构降级的机制；3. 丰富了环境规制与就业关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供碳交易政策就业效应的实证依据；2. 提示需要关注环境政策可能带来的劳动力市场结构变化；3. 为企业应对碳交易政策提供劳动力管理参考

title: MODERNIZING EYEWITNESS IDENTIFICATION
affiliations: University of Arizona - James E. Rogers College of Law

detail.title: MODERNIZING EYEWITNESS IDENTIFICATION

publicationDetails.detailsText: Arizona Legal Studies Discussion Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Arizona James E. Rogers College of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Over two-thirds of all wrongful convictions in the United States are based on mistaken eyewitnesses. Frequently, these mistakes begin with a photo lineup. Despite this, police officers continue to primarily rely on photo lineups for their identification procedures. However, recent advances in identification technology-such as the interactive lineup-could improve eyewitness accuracy and reduce the risk of misidentification. 

Based on initial studies, the interactive lineup is the first and only identification method to provide more accurate results than a traditional photo lineup. It presents a witness with three-dimensional, movable faces. While not yet adopted in the United States, the interactive lineup is the next step in eyewitness identification and a promising start to prevent future wrongful convictions. Unfortunately, the governing law is not currently equipped to evaluate these technology-enhanced identification methods. It's outdated. What courts once considered reliable in the age of static photographs is inapplicable to emerging technology, interactive lineups, and artificial intelligence. Thus, a gap is developing between the "old" law and the "new" technology. 

Bridging the gap, this Article is the first to rethink what makes an identification reliable in this current era of technology. Even though new technology presents potential improvements, is also poses new and unexpected concerns. Thus, this Article proposes the modernized identification approach, which revises how courts should evaluate the reliability of an eyewitness identification. The current doctrinal framework relies on a two-actor world, where reliability revolves around police conduct and the eyewitness. However, the modernized identification approach recalibrates this framework to account for a third actor: technology. Without modernizing eyewitness identification, the criminal justice system will fail to take advantage of technology that could limit wrongful convictions based on mistaken eyewitnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国刑事司法系统中目击者辨认的可靠性问题，指出传统照片列队辨认导致大量错误定罪，而新兴的交互式列队等科技手段虽能提高准确性，但现有法律框架已过时，无法有效评估这些技术增强的辨认方法。
AI.research_question: 在当前科技时代，如何重新定义目击者辨认的可靠性标准，以应对交互式列队等新兴技术带来的挑战和机遇？
AI.motivation: 美国三分之二的错误定罪源于目击者辨认错误，而警察仍主要依赖传统照片列队。虽然交互式列队等新技术能提高准确性，但现有法律框架过时，无法评估这些技术增强的辨认方法，导致"旧"法律与"新"技术之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于可靠性理论框架，但指出当前法律框架建立在"双主体世界"（警察行为和目击者）基础上，需要重新校准以纳入第三个主体：技术。
AI.method: 本文采用法律分析和理论重构方法，通过分析现有法律框架的局限性，提出现代化的辨认方法，重新定义法庭应如何评估目击者辨认的可靠性。
AI.findings: 交互式列队是首个比传统照片列队提供更准确结果的辨认方法，但现有法律无法评估这类技术增强的辨认方法。新技术虽能改进准确性，但也带来新的、意想不到的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次重新思考在科技时代什么使辨认可靠，提出了现代化的辨认方法，将法律框架从"双主体"（警察和目击者）重新校准为包含技术作为第三主体的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法庭提供评估技术增强辨认方法可靠性的新框架，帮助刑事司法系统利用技术减少基于错误目击者辨认的错误定罪，推动法律适应新兴技术如交互式列队和人工智能。

title: Emotional Regulation as a Systemic Capacity in Complex Societies

detail.title: Emotional Regulation as a Systemic Capacity in Complex Societies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: Modern societies increasingly operate under conditions of prolonged uncertainty, continuous informational load, and high coordination demands. While emotional regulation has traditionally been studied as an individual psychological function, this paper advances a systemic conceptualization of emotional regulation as a collective capacity that emerges from structured social environments. Drawing on findings from developmental psychology, behavioral science, and social systems theory, the article demonstrates that emotional regulation at scale functions as a foundational mechanism shaping institutional reliability, social predictability, and cooperative behavior. The paper introduces a framework for understanding emotional regulation as an infrastructural component of societal resilience, influencing governance efficiency and long-term stability. The analysis highlights how early developmental environments, educational systems, and institutional interaction patterns contribute to the formation of this capacity. The proposed model positions emotional regulation not as a soft variable, but as a measurable and strategically significant factor in complex social systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出情感调节的系统性概念化，将其视为从结构化社会环境中产生的集体能力，而非传统研究的个体心理功能。文章论证大规模情感调节是塑造制度可靠性、社会可预测性和合作行为的基础机制，并将其定位为社会韧性的基础设施组成部分。
AI.research_question: 情感调节如何作为集体能力从结构化社会环境中产生，并影响制度可靠性、社会可预测性和合作行为？
AI.motivation: 现代社会在长期不确定性、持续信息负荷和高协调需求的条件下运作，需要超越个体层面的情感调节理解，探索其作为集体能力对社会系统的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展心理学、行为科学和社会系统理论，将情感调节概念化为社会韧性的基础设施组成部分。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，整合多学科研究发现，提出情感调节作为集体能力的概念模型。
AI.findings: 情感调节在大规模层面作为基础机制塑造制度可靠性、社会可预测性和合作行为；早期发展环境、教育系统和制度互动模式对这种能力的形成有重要贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 将情感调节从个体心理功能重新概念化为集体能力；提出情感调节作为社会韧性基础设施的理论框架；将情感调节定位为可测量且具有战略意义的复杂社会系统因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解情感调节对社会稳定和治理效率影响的框架；强调早期发展环境、教育系统和制度设计对培养集体情感调节能力的重要性；将情感调节从"软变量"提升为战略规划中的可操作因素。

title: The AI Inverse Risk Model and Its Strain on the IRB's Mandate for Risk Assessment

detail.title: The AI Inverse Risk Model and Its Strain on the IRB's Mandate for Risk Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Tamiko Eto, declares that they have no conflict of interest or competing interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is not a study and does not involve human subjects and therefore does not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper is not funded.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This paper is not relevant to any clinical trial.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how artificial intelligence in human subjects research fundamentally challenges the regulatory framework established by 45 CFR 46 (the Common Rule). It introduces the "AI Inverse Risk Model" to describe a paradigm shift in research risk: whereas traditional biomedical research studies a few individuals to benefit many, AI research uses data from many individuals to make consequential decisions about single individuals. This inversion transforms when, where, and how research-related harm occurs. The paper deconstructs two critical regulatory provisions: the definition of "human subject" under 45 CFR 46.102(e) and the IRB's risk-benefit assessment mandate under 45 CFR 46.111(a)(2). While the definition of human subject is sufficiently broad to encompass individuals whose identifiable data trains AI models, the traditional "narrow interpretation" of IRB oversight-focused on immediate risks during study participation-fails to account for AI's unique risk architecture. In AI research, the most significant harms emerge not during data collection but during model training, deployment, and operational use, when biased predictions, algorithmic errors, and data memorization can directly impact the very individuals whose data built the model. The analysis reveals three critical regulatory gaps: indefinite human subject status without corresponding protections, mischaracterization of foreseeable individual-level harms as excluded "long-range effects," and a post-study oversight vacuum where risks persist but no monitoring entity is assigned. The paper argues that scientific validity and methodological rigor in AI research are indistinguishable from subject protection, requiring IRBs to adopt a broader interpretation of their mandate to fulfill their ethical obligations in the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能在人类受试者研究中如何挑战《共同规则》监管框架，提出"AI逆向风险模型"描述风险范式转变：传统研究是研究少数人使多数人受益，而AI研究是使用多数人数据对单一个体做出重要决策。分析揭示了三个关键监管缺口，并主张IRB需要采用更广泛的解释来履行伦理义务。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在人类受试者研究中如何挑战《共同规则》(45 CFR 46)的监管框架？具体而言，AI研究如何改变研究风险的范式，以及这种变化对"人类受试者"定义和IRB风险效益评估的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在人类受试者研究中的应用从根本上改变了研究风险的性质和分布，但现有的监管框架《共同规则》是基于传统生物医学研究模式设计的，无法有效应对AI研究带来的独特挑战，这可能导致监管漏洞和伦理风险。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. AI逆向风险模型：描述从传统研究（研究少数人使多数人受益）到AI研究（使用多数人数据对单一个体做出决策）的风险范式转变
2. 监管框架分析：基于《共同规则》特别是45 CFR 46.102(e)（人类受试者定义）和45 CFR 46.111(a)(2)（IRB风险效益评估）
3. 风险架构理论：AI研究的风险主要出现在模型训练、部署和操作使用阶段，而非数据收集阶段
AI.method: 规范性法律分析和理论框架构建：通过对《共同规则》关键条款（特别是人类受试者定义和IRB风险效益评估要求）的文本分析，结合AI研究特点，构建AI逆向风险模型，识别监管缺口。
AI.findings:
1. 人类受试者定义足够宽泛，可以涵盖其可识别数据用于训练AI模型的个体
2. IRB对风险的传统"狭义解释"（关注研究参与期间的即时风险）无法应对AI的独特风险架构
3. AI研究中最严重的伤害出现在模型训练、部署和操作使用阶段，而非数据收集阶段
4. 识别出三个关键监管缺口：无限期的人类受试者状态但无相应保护、将可预见的个体层面伤害误判为排除的"长期效应"、研究后监督真空
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"AI逆向风险模型"作为理解AI研究风险范式转变的理论框架
2. 揭示AI研究中科学有效性与受试者保护不可分割的理论洞见
3. 为监管理论提供新的分析视角，强调需要从传统生物医学研究模式向AI研究模式转变
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为IRB提供具体指导，建议采用更广泛的解释来履行伦理义务
2. 识别监管实践中的具体缺口，为政策制定者提供改革方向
3. 强调需要建立研究后监督机制来应对AI研究的持续性风险
4. 为研究人员和伦理委员会提供评估AI研究风险的实用框架

title: Integrated Landslide Risk Assessment and Management in Bangladesh: Governance and Community Resilience Strategies

detail.title: Integrated Landslide Risk Assessment and Management in Bangladesh: Governance and Community Resilience Strategies
detail.abstract: Landslides are a recurring and destructive hazard in the hilly regions of southeast Bangladesh, particularly in the Chittagong Hill Tracts, where fragile geology, intense monsoonal rainfall, deforestation, and unplanned urban expansion come together to increase vulnerability. This study brings forward an integrated assessment of landslide hazards and proposes a multidimensional risk-reduction framework based on contemporary research and community needs. Using susceptibility mapping, historical analysis, climate-informed forecasting, and community-level surveys, the study has pinpointed some critical drivers of vulnerability: weak governance, inadequate land-use regulation, informal settlements, and poor disaster preparedness. To address these impediments, this study proposes a comprehensive mitigation strategy that incorporates sustainable land-use zoning, vegetation-based slope stabilization, the introduction of real-time early warning systems, training at the grassroots level, and improved institutional coordination. The findings of the study emphasize how scientific, social, and policybased measures can be integrated within a holistic framework for landslide risk management in Bangladesh. Accordingly, proactive governance, technological innovation, and community engagement are vital in reducing losses caused by landslides and achieving improved long-term resilience in the region.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对孟加拉国东南部山区的滑坡灾害，提出了一个综合评估和多维风险降低框架，结合科学、社会和政策措施来管理滑坡风险。
AI.research_question: 如何通过综合评估和多维风险降低框架来有效管理孟加拉国东南部山区的滑坡灾害风险？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国吉大港山区滑坡灾害频发且破坏性大，脆弱地质、强季风降雨、森林砍伐和无规划城市扩张共同增加了脆弱性，需要综合解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于综合灾害风险管理理论，结合脆弱性分析、灾害风险评估和社区参与理论，构建多维风险降低框架。
AI.method: 采用敏感性制图、历史分析、气候信息预测和社区层面调查的综合方法。
AI.findings: 识别出脆弱性的关键驱动因素：治理薄弱、土地利用监管不足、非正规定居点和灾害准备不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将科学、社会和政策措施整合到滑坡风险管理整体框架中的理论模型，强调多维度综合方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含可持续土地利用分区、植被边坡稳定、实时预警系统、基层培训和改善机构协调的综合减灾策略。

title: No Soup (or Context) for You! Measuring Student Familiarity of Pop Culture
affiliations: and James Madison University

detail.title: No Soup (or Context) for You! Measuring Student Familiarity of Pop Culture
detail.abstract: Pop culture references are frequently used in college classrooms to increase student engagement, often under the assumption that students recognize the media being referenced. Prior research suggests, however, that generational differences between instructors and students may undermine this strategy. This study examines the extent of that disconnect by surveying students in a large introductory course about their familiarity with twelve television shows that were used as teaching examples. Results indicate that even widely referenced programs, such as The Office and The Simpsons, are unfamiliar to a substantial share of students, raising important questions about how pop culture should be used in instructional settings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，大学教师使用流行文化作为教学参考时，存在显著的代际认知差异，即使像《办公室》和《辛普森一家》这样广泛引用的节目，也有相当比例的学生不熟悉。
AI.research_question: 大学课堂中使用流行文化作为教学参考时，教师和学生之间的代际认知差异程度如何？
AI.motivation: 大学教师经常使用流行文化参考来增加学生参与度，但假设学生能识别这些参考可能存在问题，因为教师和学生之间存在代际差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际差异理论、教学参与理论、流行文化在教育中的应用理论
AI.method: 对大型入门课程的学生进行调查，评估他们对教师使用的12个电视节目的熟悉程度
AI.findings: 结果显示，即使是广泛引用的节目如《办公室》和《辛普森一家》，也有相当比例的学生不熟悉，表明代际认知差异显著
AI.theory_contributions: 为代际差异如何影响教学效果提供了实证证据，挑战了流行文化参考能普遍提高学生参与度的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒教育工作者在使用流行文化参考时需要谨慎，建议评估学生对这些参考的熟悉程度，或选择更当代的参考材料

title: Toward ASI Stability: A Treaty Framework for US–China Cooperation on Artificial Superintelligence

detail.title: Toward ASI Stability: A Treaty Framework for US–China Cooperation on Artificial Superintelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required for this research, as it does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

contentType.other: Full paper accepted as a poster at a non-archival workshop

detail.abstract: As artificial superintelligence (ASI) becomes more technically viable, the risk of an arms race between the United States and China increases. This paper proposes a phased, enforceable treaty designed to reduce that risk by using mutual vulnerability to align incentives. Drawing on lessons from nuclear arms control, the treaty includes verifiable limits on compute and model training, telemetry-based inspections, and bilateral emergency protocols. Unlike frameworks based on voluntary norms, this model integrates oversight into national security infrastructure, making coordination possible even without trust. It addresses near-term safety risks and long-term shifts in global power, offering a strategy that reflects current geopolitical conditions. The treaty is built to function under rivalry, not consensus, and includes mechanisms for adaptability in the face of political change or external disruption. While focused on the U.S. and China, the structure could support future multilateral expansion as other actors approach ASI capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个分阶段、可执行的条约框架，旨在通过相互脆弱性来调整激励，减少美中在人工超级智能（ASI）领域的军备竞赛风险。该条约借鉴核军控经验，包括可验证的计算和模型训练限制、基于遥测的检查机制以及双边紧急协议，将监督融入国家安全基础设施，在不依赖信任的情况下实现协调。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个有效的条约框架来减少美中在人工超级智能（ASI）领域的军备竞赛风险？
AI.motivation: 随着人工超级智能（ASI）技术可行性增加，美中之间爆发军备竞赛的风险上升，需要建立有效的治理机制来防止失控的竞争和安全风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴核军备控制理论，特别是基于相互脆弱性的威慑理论，以及国际关系中的安全困境理论。
AI.method: 提出一个分阶段、可执行的条约设计方法，包括具体的制度安排：可验证的计算和模型训练限制、基于遥测的检查机制、双边紧急协议，并将监督融入国家安全基础设施。
AI.findings: 提出的条约框架能够在竞争而非共识的环境下运作，通过相互脆弱性调整激励，即使在没有信任的情况下也能实现协调，并能适应政治变化和外部干扰。
AI.theory_contributions: 将核军控理论应用于新兴的ASI治理领域，发展了基于相互脆弱性的新型国际协调理论，提出了在竞争性国际关系中建立有效治理框架的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美中ASI治理提供了具体的可操作方案，包括技术限制、验证机制和应急协议，为政策制定者提供了应对ASI安全风险的实际工具，并为未来多边扩展奠定了基础。

title: Users Prefer Generative AI to Depict What is Real Instead of What is Ideal
affiliations: , University of Hohenheim - Faculty of Business, Economics and Social Sciences and University of Hohenheim

detail.title: Users Prefer Generative AI to Depict What is Real Instead of What is Ideal
detail.abstract: The representation of social categories by generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is often considered biased and thus unfair. But there exist several mutually exclusive ethical standards according to which a bias can be established. While different authors seem to take different standards for granted, users’ consideration of what constitutes an appropriate representation is rarely elicited. However, if we want to keep humans in the loop of decision-making, we should make sure that artificial intelligence (AI) does not nudge them away from what they deem morally relevant upon reflection. Our study, therefore, investigates users’ evaluations of the appropriate representation of gender proportions in various social categories. We find that the much discussed standards of uniform equality and substantive equality play little role in these evaluations. Users desire a representation that reflects their perception of reality. Our results suggest that user-centric  GAI should rely on empirical data when representing gender in social categories.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨用户对生成式人工智能（GAI）中性别比例适当表示的评价，发现用户偏好反映现实感知的表示，而非统一的平等标准或实质性平等标准。
AI.research_question: 用户如何评价生成式人工智能（GAI）中社会类别性别比例的适当表示？
AI.motivation: GAI的社会类别表示常被认为存在偏见和不公平，但存在多种相互排斥的伦理标准来界定偏见。不同作者采用不同标准，而用户对适当表示的看法很少被调查。为确保AI不将用户推离他们认为道德相关的方向，需要了解用户的评价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多种伦理标准（如统一平等、实质性平等）来评估GAI中的性别表示偏见，强调用户中心视角在AI伦理中的重要性。
AI.method: 研究调查用户对各种社会类别中性别比例适当表示的评价。
AI.findings: 用户希望表示反映他们对现实的感知，而非广泛讨论的统一平等或实质性平等标准。用户中心的GAI应依赖经验数据来表示社会类别中的性别。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现有关于GAI性别表示偏见的伦理标准讨论，提出用户感知现实作为评价标准的重要性，为AI伦理研究提供新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发用户中心的GAI系统提供指导：应基于经验数据而非预设的平等标准来表示社会类别中的性别，以更好地满足用户期望。

title: Digital Fragmentation as a Contemporary Trend in the Global Economy
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Digital Fragmentation as a Contemporary Trend in the Global Economy
detail.abstract: Digital fragmentation is an increasingly defining and complex trend in the global economy of the 21st century. This process refers to the progressive stratification of the digital sphere, driven by the convergence of technological competition, divergent regulatory regimes, and geopolitical strategies. Fragmentation manifests across multiple, interconnected dimensions: at the technological level through competing, incompatible platforms and ecosystems in areas like cloud computing and IoT; at the regulatory level via disparate national frameworks for data governance, cybersecurity, and digital taxation; and at the geopolitical level through policies aimed at technological sovereignty and protectionism, leading to the emergence of distinct digital domains centered around major powers or blocs like the US, China, and the EU. The economic implications of this trend are profoundly ambivalent. While it may foster regional innovation hubs and enhance data security, it simultaneously imposes significant costs on international businesses through heightened transaction expenses, market adaptation burdens, and increased supply chain complexity. Consequently, digital fragmentation is reshaping the fundamental architecture of the global economic system. Its future trajectory will depend on the evolving balance between competing forces—market dynamics, state intervention, and international governance—as they seek to reconcile the imperatives of openness, security, competition, and cooperation. Understanding this phenomenon necessitates a comprehensive, interdisciplinary approach that integrates insights from economics, political science, and technology studies.

AI.tldr: 数字碎片化是21世纪全球经济日益显著且复杂的趋势，指数字领域因技术竞争、监管差异和地缘政治策略而分层。它在技术、监管和地缘政治三个层面显现，对经济产生矛盾影响：既促进区域创新和数据安全，又增加企业交易成本、市场适应负担和供应链复杂性。
AI.research_question: 数字碎片化如何影响全球经济体系架构？其未来发展趋势将如何受到市场力量、国家干预和国际治理之间平衡的影响？
AI.motivation: 数字碎片化已成为21世纪全球经济的决定性趋势，但对其多维表现、经济影响和未来发展的理解仍不充分，需要跨学科的综合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合经济学、政治学和科技研究的跨学科框架，分析技术竞争、监管差异和地缘政治策略的相互作用。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过文献综述和理论整合，从技术、监管和地缘政治三个维度解析数字碎片化现象。
AI.findings: 数字碎片化在技术层面表现为竞争性平台和生态系统（如云计算、物联网）；在监管层面体现为数据治理、网络安全和数字税收的国家差异；在地缘政治层面表现为技术主权和保护主义政策，形成以美国、中国和欧盟为中心的独立数字领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字碎片化的多维分析框架，整合了技术、监管和地缘政治三个层面的相互作用，为理解21世纪全球经济体系变革提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对数字碎片化提供战略指导，帮助政策制定者平衡开放、安全、竞争和合作的需求，促进国际数字治理的协调。

title: Sustainability-Linked Debt, Capital Structure, and Endogenous Default
affiliations: Ulm University - Institute of Insurance Science and Ulm University - Institute of Insurance Science

detail.title: Sustainability-Linked Debt, Capital Structure, and Endogenous Default
detail.abstract: We develop a structural credit model of perpetual debt financing in which firms issue sustainability-linked bonds (SLBs) whose coupons step up via penalty payments when predefined sustainability targets are missed. Focusing on firms that aim to reduce emissions, we show that SLBs operate through two distinct channels: the firm can choose a lower endogenous bankruptcy threshold while holding equity value constant, or it can attain a significantly higher total firm value. In the first channel—when the bankruptcy threshold is set lower—SLBs reshape default incentives, extend expected firm lifetime, and can raise debt capacity without proportionally increasing distress costs. As a supplementary extension, we incorporate carbon taxes and subsidies to reflect policy-driven effects on cash flows and incentives, without changing the central mechanism through which SLBs affect default and leverage choices.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个永续债务融资的结构性信用模型，研究可持续挂钩债券(SLBs)如何通过惩罚性票息上调机制影响企业融资决策。SLBs通过两种渠道运作：降低内生破产门槛或提升企业总价值，从而重塑违约激励、延长企业寿命并提高债务能力。
AI.research_question: 可持续挂钩债券(SLBs)如何通过惩罚性票息上调机制影响企业的融资决策、违约激励和企业价值？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续金融的发展，SLBs作为一种新兴金融工具，其运作机制和对企业决策的影响尚不明确，需要理论模型来解释其如何通过特定机制影响企业行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性信用模型、永续债务融资理论、代理成本理论、可持续金融理论
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析SLBs的运作机制，通过数学建模分析两种渠道的影响，并引入碳税和补贴作为政策扩展
AI.findings: SLBs通过两种渠道运作：1)在保持股权价值不变的情况下降低内生破产门槛；2)显著提高企业总价值。第一种渠道能重塑违约激励、延长企业预期寿命，并在不按比例增加财务困境成本的情况下提高债务能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了SLBs的结构性信用模型，揭示了其通过惩罚机制影响企业融资决策的双重渠道，为可持续金融工具的理论研究提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业使用SLBs提供了理论指导，帮助政策制定者理解碳税和补贴等政策如何与SLBs相互作用，为金融机构设计可持续金融产品提供了理论依据。

title: Tidal Power, Energy Security, and Decarbonization
affiliations: Lancaster University - Department of Economics, Soongsil University, Busan University of Foreign Studies - College of Commerce & Business, Department of Economics - Lancaster University Management School and Lancaster University - Lancaster University Management School

detail.title: Tidal Power, Energy Security, and Decarbonization
detail.abstract: This paper assesses whether large-scale tidal energy can contribute to energy security and decarbonization by reducing fossil fuel dependence and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions intensity. Focusing on South Korea, we exploit the full operationalization of the Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station in 2012 as a natural experiment. Using national time-series analysis, difference-in-differences estimations against Japan and a broader group of Asia–Pacific economies, and a synthetic control approach, the study examines changes in energy intensity, electricity generation by fuel type, and per-capita CO2 emissions. The synthetic control method constructs a data-driven counterfactual for South Korea based on comparable Asia–Pacific economies, providing a transparent benchmark for assessing post-treatment deviations in coal-based electricity generation and coal-related emissions. Across all empirical strategies, the results consistently indicate that sustained tidal energy deployment is associated with a significant decline in overall energy intensity and a marked reduction in coal-based electricity generation. Correspondingly, per-capita CO2 emissions from coal and coal's relative contribution to total emissions fall significantly, while aggregate per-capita emissions remain broadly stable. Pre-trend tests and the close pre-treatment fit of the synthetic control support the validity of the identification strategy. The estimated effects persist after controlling for international climate policy through a Paris Agreement indicator, suggesting that tidal energy contributes independently to structural changes in the energy system. Overall, the findings provide rare long-run empirical evidence that large-scale tidal power can enhance energy security and support decarbonization primarily through the targeted displacement of coal.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用韩国始华湖潮汐发电站全面运营作为自然实验，通过多种计量方法证明大规模潮汐能源能显著降低能源强度和煤炭发电比例，从而增强能源安全并支持脱碳进程。
AI.research_question: 大规模潮汐能源能否通过减少化石燃料依赖和二氧化碳排放强度来促进能源安全和脱碳？
AI.motivation: 评估可再生能源对能源转型的实际影响，特别是潮汐能源这种相对较少研究的可再生能源形式，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源安全理论、脱碳转型理论、可再生能源替代效应理论，以及自然实验和因果推断方法在能源政策评估中的应用。
AI.method: 采用三重实证策略：1) 国家时间序列分析；2) 以日本和亚太经济体为对照组的双重差分法；3) 基于可比亚太经济体的合成控制法，构建数据驱动的反事实基准。
AI.findings: 潮汐能源部署与能源强度显著下降和煤炭发电大幅减少相关，人均煤炭相关CO2排放及其在总排放中的占比显著下降，而总人均排放保持基本稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大规模潮汐能源对能源系统结构性变化的长期实证证据，验证了可再生能源通过针对性替代煤炭实现脱碳的机制，拓展了自然实验方法在能源政策评估中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了潮汐能源促进能源安全和脱碳的实证支持，表明可再生能源投资可以独立于国际气候政策产生积极影响，为韩国及其他类似国家的能源转型提供参考。

title: Tidal Power, Energy Security, and Decarbonization
affiliations: Lancaster University - Department of Economics, Soongsil University, Busan University of Foreign Studies - College of Commerce & Business, Department of Economics - Lancaster University Management School and Lancaster University - Lancaster University Management School

detail.title: Tidal Power, Energy Security, and Decarbonization
detail.abstract: This paper assesses whether large-scale tidal energy can contribute to energy security and decarbonization by reducing fossil fuel dependence and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions intensity. Focusing on South Korea, we exploit the full operationalization of the Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station in 2012 as a natural experiment. Using national time-series analysis, difference-in-differences estimations against Japan and a broader group of Asia–Pacific economies, and a synthetic control approach, the study examines changes in energy intensity, electricity generation by fuel type, and per-capita CO2 emissions. The synthetic control method constructs a data-driven counterfactual for South Korea based on comparable Asia–Pacific economies, providing a transparent benchmark for assessing post-treatment deviations in coal-based electricity generation and coal-related emissions. Across all empirical strategies, the results consistently indicate that sustained tidal energy deployment is associated with a significant decline in overall energy intensity and a marked reduction in coal-based electricity generation. Correspondingly, per-capita CO2 emissions from coal and coal's relative contribution to total emissions fall significantly, while aggregate per-capita emissions remain broadly stable. Pre-trend tests and the close pre-treatment fit of the synthetic control support the validity of the identification strategy. The estimated effects persist after controlling for international climate policy through a Paris Agreement indicator, suggesting that tidal energy contributes independently to structural changes in the energy system. Overall, the findings provide rare long-run empirical evidence that large-scale tidal power can enhance energy security and support decarbonization primarily through the targeted displacement of coal.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用韩国始华潮汐发电站全面运营作为自然实验，通过多种计量方法证明大规模潮汐能源能显著降低能源强度、减少煤电比例和煤炭相关碳排放，从而增强能源安全和促进脱碳。
AI.research_question: 大规模潮汐能源能否通过减少化石燃料依赖和二氧化碳排放强度来促进能源安全和脱碳？
AI.motivation: 评估可再生能源（特别是潮汐能）在促进能源安全和减少碳排放方面的实际效果，为能源转型提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源安全理论、脱碳转型理论、可再生能源替代效应理论
AI.method: 1) 国家时间序列分析；2) 以日本和亚太经济体为对照组的双重差分法；3) 合成控制法构建韩国反事实基准
AI.findings: 1) 潮汐能源部署与整体能源强度显著下降相关；2) 煤电发电量明显减少；3) 煤炭相关人均CO2排放及其在总排放中的占比显著下降；4) 总人均排放保持基本稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了大规模潮汐能源对能源系统结构性变化的长期实证证据；2) 验证了潮汐能源独立于国际气候政策的脱碳贡献；3) 展示了可再生能源通过针对性替代煤炭实现脱碳的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了潮汐能源促进能源安全和脱碳的实证支持；2) 展示了可再生能源在减少煤炭依赖方面的具体效果；3) 为其他国家发展潮汐能源提供了参考案例
