detail.abstract: The release in 2016 by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development of a draft multilateral treaty to modify thousands of global bilateral tax treaties was met with surprisingly strong support by the international community, with many states signing, ratifying, and implementing the treaty. One of the treaty’s most contentious elements is the addition to the dispute resolution measures in bilateral treaties, a process known as mutual agreement procedure, of a mandatory arbitration procedure that is to be available where agreement cannot be reached under the conventional process. In contrast to the mutual agreement procedure, which includes no requirement that a final agreement be reached, the mandatory arbitration procedure can provide a guaranteed resolution of a treaty dispute. Although the arbitration article has been ratified by most developed countries, many developing nations have noted reservations to it, indicating that they will not incorporate it into their bilateral treaties. Central to the many arguments that have been put forward by opponents of mandatory arbitration in bilateral tax treaties is the argument that agreeing to mandatory arbitration would amount to an unacceptable surrender of sovereignty. However, when viewed critically in the context of tax treaties, this and many other concerns fall away or are revealed to be red herring arguments. A better view, this article suggests, is that entering into a tax treaty is an exercise of fiscal sovereignty, and any agreement to reduce taxing or other rights in the treaty should be seen as an element of that exercise of sovereignty to gain the benefits or advantages the parties seek through a treaty that grants mutual rights to and imposes mutual obligations on sovereign signatories.

AI.findings: 1. 签订税收协定本身就是行使财政主权的表现；2. 同意仲裁程序是主权国家为获得条约利益而自愿限制权利的行为；3. 反对强制性仲裁的主权担忧大多是"红鲱鱼"论点，缺乏实质性依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新诠释了税收协定中主权概念，提出"条约签订是主权行使"的理论视角，为理解国际税收协定中的争端解决机制提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家参与多边税收条约提供理论支持，帮助政策制定者更理性地评估强制性仲裁程序的实际影响，促进国际税收协定的有效实施。

title: A Speed Metaphor for Homo Economicus: A Kinematic Approach to Consumer Theory
affiliations: Globiz Professional University

detail.title: A Speed Metaphor for Homo Economicus: A Kinematic Approach to Consumer Theory
detail.abstract: Students often struggle with the marginal concept in economics due to the intuitive disconnection between calculus and human behavior. This lecture note bridges the gap by mapping economic concepts onto kinematics: utility is position, consumption is time, marginal utility is speed, and price is stream speed. The Lagrange multiplier receives a fresh interpretation as the Mach number of consumption. The analogy is developed through two examples: the Amtrak Empire Service train diagram illustrates speed as slope, and the Maid of the Mist boat excursion illustrates utility maximization as navigating against a river stream. At optimum, every dollar achieves the same Mach across all markets; high Mach indicates tight budget, low Mach indicates relaxed budget.

AI.tldr: 这篇教学笔记通过将经济学概念映射到运动学中，帮助学生理解边际概念：效用是位置，消费是时间，边际效用是速度，价格是流速，拉格朗日乘子被解释为消费的马赫数。
AI.research_question: 如何帮助学生克服经济学中边际概念的理解障碍，特别是微积分与人类行为之间的直觉脱节？
AI.motivation: 学生在经济学中经常难以理解边际概念，因为微积分与人类行为之间存在直觉上的脱节。需要一种创新的教学方法来弥合这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济学与运动学的类比框架：效用-位置，消费-时间，边际效用-速度，价格-流速，拉格朗日乘子-马赫数。
AI.method: 通过两个具体例子进行类比教学：1) Amtrak帝国服务列车图说明速度作为斜率；2) Maid of the Mist游船游览说明效用最大化如同逆流航行。
AI.findings: 在最优状态下，每一美元在所有市场上达到相同的马赫数；高马赫数表示预算紧张，低马赫数表示预算宽松。拉格朗日乘子作为消费的马赫数提供了新的解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济学与运动学之间的创新类比框架，为拉格朗日乘子提供了新的物理解释（马赫数），丰富了经济学教学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学教师提供了具体的教学工具和案例，帮助学生通过直观的运动学类比理解抽象的边际概念，提高教学效果。

detail.abstract: The goal of this paper is to demonstrate that, despite this guarantee, the United States has maintained second-class status for Black people that has locked them out of full membership in American society. This means that throughout history, even when Black people obtain citizenship on paper, they are still excluded from the full benefits of membership.  The first part of this paper explains how anti-Black racism has shaped the rules about who gets to be a citizen. This section discusses how, both during and after the era of slavery, Black people in this country continued to be denied equal rights. The second part explores how Black migrants are deported more often because of anti-Black racism. The paper ends with ideas for changing laws and policies so that everyone—no matter their race or immigration status—is treated fairly and is fully included in American life.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国虽在法律上给予黑人公民身份，但通过系统性种族主义维持其二等公民地位，排除其充分参与社会。文章分析反黑人种族主义如何塑造公民资格规则，以及黑人移民如何因此面临更高驱逐率，并提出法律政策改革建议以实现种族平等。
AI.research_question: 美国如何通过系统性种族主义维持黑人的二等公民地位，即使他们在法律上获得公民身份？
AI.motivation: 揭示美国社会中存在的结构性种族不平等问题，即黑人虽然在法律上获得公民身份，但在实践中仍被排除在充分的社会成员资格之外，无法享受完整的公民权利和福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判种族理论、公民身份理论、结构性种族主义理论、移民与种族交叉性理论
AI.method: 历史分析法和政策分析法：第一部分通过历史分析探讨反黑人种族主义如何塑造公民资格规则；第二部分通过政策分析研究黑人移民面临的不平等驱逐待遇
AI.findings: 1. 反黑人种族主义从奴隶制时期至今持续影响公民资格规则制定；2. 黑人即使在法律上获得公民身份，仍被排除在充分的社会成员资格之外；3. 黑人移民因种族主义面临更高的驱逐率；4. 现行法律和政策维持了种族不平等
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了公民身份理论，强调形式公民权与实质公民权之间的差距；2. 深化了对结构性种族主义如何嵌入法律制度的理解；3. 为移民研究与种族研究的交叉领域提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出具体的法律和政策改革建议，以消除种族不平等；2. 为政策制定者提供实现种族平等的实践指导；3. 为倡导组织和社会运动提供行动框架；4. 促进对移民和公民权利保护的改进

title: Inflation and Competition in an Old Keynesian Model
affiliations: Boston College

detail.title: Inflation and Competition in an Old Keynesian Model
detail.abstract: I study how rationing affects endogenous competition and real rigidities. Households search for firms in the goods market. Nominal rigidities prevent firms from clearing excess demand, incentivizing firms to ration by rejecting buyers. Under excess supply, the model resembles standard New Keynesian models as few firms ration. Under excess demand, however, my model differs substantially. First, rationing, particularly by low-price firms, impedes price competition and matching efficiency. Both elasticity and superelasticity fall, fueling inflation by raising markups and relaxing real rigidities. Second, endogenous competition creates strong nonlinearity in the Phillips curve  and asymmetric inflation persistence without menu costs or changes in concentration. Inflation is higher and more persistent after inflationary shocks, and these effects are not confined to large shocks. Third, stable markups cause real wages to stagnate even in an overheated economy. This partially explains the absence of wage-price spirals during COVID despite tight labor markets. Finally, I provide empirical evidence on rationing and endogenous real rigidities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究配给制如何影响内生竞争和实际刚性。研究发现，在超额需求情况下，配给制（特别是低价企业的配给）会抑制价格竞争和匹配效率，导致通胀上升、实际刚性减弱，并创造非线性的菲利普斯曲线和不对称的通胀持续性。
AI.research_question: 配给制如何影响内生竞争和实际刚性？
AI.motivation: 解释COVID疫情期间尽管劳动力市场紧张但未出现工资-价格螺旋上升的现象，以及理解配给制在经济中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型、搜索匹配理论、内生竞争理论、配给制理论
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析，构建包含家庭搜索、企业配给行为的动态一般均衡模型
AI.findings: 1. 超额需求时，配给制（特别是低价企业配给）抑制价格竞争和匹配效率，降低弹性和超弹性，提高加价率，放松实际刚性；2. 内生竞争创造非线性菲利普斯曲线和不对称通胀持续性；3. 稳定加价率导致实际工资停滞；4. 提供配给制和内生实际刚性的实证证据
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将配给制纳入新凯恩斯主义框架；2. 揭示配给制对价格竞争和实际刚性的影响机制；3. 解释非线性菲利普斯曲线和不对称通胀持续性的内生来源
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释COVID期间无工资-价格螺旋的现象；2. 为货币政策制定提供新视角；3. 帮助企业理解配给策略的经济影响

publicationDetails.detailsText: Canadian Tax Journal/Revue fiscale canadienne, Vol. 73, No. 4, 2025, pp. 735  -  55 (https://doi.org/10.32721/ctj.2025.73.4.pf.mescall)

detail.abstract: The Canadian job market faces a significant transition as a result of the advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology and a new approach to tariffs and trade by the US administration. Without meaningful change in domestic policy, an increase in unemployment rates may have a negative impact on Canada’s economy, communities, and the health and well-being of individuals. In this article, we review prior studies to develop a framework that allows us to map the probable impacts of unemployment levels on economies, communities, and individual wellness outcomes. We analyze the potential impact of tariffs and AI adoption on the Canadian job market between 2025 and 2030 using scenario analysis, and find that the most likely outcome is an unemployment rate peaking above 9 percent. Addressing this challenge requires an integrated approach across government policies, including tax policy, to strengthen the economic pillars supporting business enterprises, to advance the development of skills and training, and to drive the creation of enterprise value by employing Canadian talent. We identify critical success factors for corporate tax incentives, suggest prospective policies, and recommend bold policy changes to elevate investment in human capital and help Canada to thrive in an era of AI and tariffs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了人工智能技术发展和美国贸易政策对加拿大就业市场的双重冲击，预测2025-2030年间失业率可能超过9%，并提出通过税收政策等综合措施应对挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能技术发展和美国贸易政策如何影响加拿大就业市场？如何通过政策干预缓解失业率上升对经济、社区和个人福祉的负面影响？
AI.motivation: 加拿大就业市场面临人工智能技术进步和美国贸易政策调整的双重压力，若不采取有效政策应对，失业率上升将对经济、社区和个人健康福祉产生负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了失业水平对经济、社区和个人福祉影响的映射框架，结合情景分析预测就业市场变化，并基于企业税收激励理论提出政策建议。
AI.method: 文献回顾构建分析框架，采用情景分析法预测2025-2030年间关税和AI采用对加拿大就业市场的潜在影响。
AI.findings: 最可能的结果是失业率在预测期内峰值超过9%，需要跨政府政策的综合应对，包括税收政策、技能培训和企业价值创造等措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了失业影响的多维度分析框架，将AI技术冲击与贸易政策变化结合分析，为企业税收激励政策提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了企业税收激励的关键成功因素，提出了前瞻性政策建议，推荐了促进人力资本投资的重大政策变革，帮助加拿大在AI和关税时代保持竞争力。

title: Is Financial Knowledge Really Declining? Randomized Evidence on the Effects of Smartphone Responses
affiliations: University of Southern California - Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR), Montana State University - Bozeman - Department of Agricultural Economics and Economics and FINRA Foundation

detail.title: Is Financial Knowledge Really Declining? Randomized Evidence on the Effects of Smartphone Responses

publicationDetails.journalName: USC Center for Economic & Social Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Measured financial knowledge declined by 15 percent in the U.S. between 2009 and 2021. We propose one possible explanation: an increase in smartphone responses on web-based surveys. Using within-individual variation in device type in a representative internet panel, we first observe that when respondents use smartphones, they are more likely to choose “don’t know” and less likely to answer questions correctly than when responding on a desktop, laptop, or tablet. We then conduct an experiment where respondents are randomized to complete a survey on a smartphone or another device and find remarkably similar results. Leveraging randomized question placement, we find that the smartphone penalty is larger when questions appear later in the survey. We find similar results for a set of general knowledge questions. Back-ofthe- envelope calculations suggest that at least 23 percent of the decline in financial knowledge can be attributable to expanded smartphone use when taking surveys.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，2009-2021年美国金融知识水平下降的15%中，至少有23%可归因于智能手机在调查中的使用增加。智能手机用户更可能选择"不知道"，正确率更低，且这种影响在调查后期更明显。
AI.research_question: 智能手机使用是否导致美国金融知识水平测量的下降？
AI.motivation: 2009-2021年间美国金融知识水平下降了15%，需要探究这一现象的原因。研究者注意到智能手机在在线调查中的使用增加可能影响回答质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设备类型对调查回答质量的影响理论，包括认知负荷、注意力分散和界面限制等因素。
AI.method: 1) 使用代表性互联网面板数据，分析个体内设备类型变化对回答的影响；2) 随机实验：将受访者随机分配到智能手机或其他设备完成调查；3) 利用随机问题放置分析位置效应；4) 使用一般知识问题验证结果。
AI.findings: 1) 智能手机用户更可能选择"不知道"，正确率更低；2) 实验验证了类似结果；3) 智能手机惩罚效应在调查后期更大；4) 一般知识问题也显示类似模式；5) 至少23%的金融知识下降可归因于智能手机使用增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了设备类型与调查回答质量的理论联系；2) 揭示了智能手机使用对知识测量的系统性影响；3) 为调查方法论提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒研究人员注意设备类型对调查结果的影响；2) 为调查设计提供改进建议；3) 帮助政策制定者更准确解读金融知识趋势数据。

detail.title: Securitization Dynamics in U.S. Banks: Impacts on Credit Supply, Capital Requirements, and Profitability (2000-2017)

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A

detail.abstract: This research explores the securitization activity in US banks between the year 2000 and year 2017. Our aim was to examine how the securitization in banks affected three aspects: the credit supply, capital requirements, and the profitability in US banks. Our research was based on data collected from thirty-three banks over an eighteen-year period. Our methodology was based on a panel linear regression analysis that adopts the approach of investigation of securitization trends and predictive interactions among those three financial variables. Our findings demonstrate a positive correlation between bank securitization activities and regulatory capital requirements. We also found a direct link between securitization and bank profitability. However, we couldn't confirm a connection between securitization and credit supply, despite suggestions in some prior literature.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2000-2017年美国银行的证券化活动，发现证券化与监管资本要求正相关，与银行盈利能力直接相关，但未能确认证券化与信贷供给之间的联系。
AI.research_question: 美国银行的证券化活动如何影响信贷供给、资本要求和盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 探索证券化活动对美国银行金融表现的影响，特别是在信贷供给、资本要求和盈利能力三个关键方面的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融中介理论、证券化理论和银行监管资本理论，探讨证券化对银行经营和监管的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用面板线性回归分析，基于2000-2017年33家美国银行18年的数据，研究证券化趋势与三个金融变量之间的预测性关系。

1. 银行证券化活动与监管资本要求呈正相关
2. 证券化与银行盈利能力存在直接联系
3. 未能确认证券化与信贷供给之间的关系，这与先前文献的某些建议相矛盾
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 实证验证了证券化对银行资本要求的正向影响
2. 确认了证券化与银行盈利能力的直接关系
3. 对证券化与信贷供给关系的现有理论提出了质疑和修正
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为银行管理者提供了证券化活动对资本管理和盈利能力影响的实证依据
2. 为监管机构制定证券化相关政策提供了参考

title: Competitive Incentives and the Persistence of Short-Term Value Destruction in Firm Strategy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Competitive Incentives and the Persistence of Short-Term Value Destruction in Firm Strategy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. A family member is employed by a firm discussed in the paper; however, the research was conducted independently, without access to proprietary information, involvement, or influence from the firm or the affiliated individual.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied exclusively on publicly available secondary data and did not involve human participants, experiments, or the collection of personal data. Formal ethics approval was therefore not required. Additionally, some data was based on personal observation
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: Competitive markets are often expected to reward firms that focus on long-term value creation. In reality, many firms operating under intense competition persistently adopt strategies that weaken long-term unit economics, even when decision-makers are aware of these costs. This paper examines why such behavior continues and argues that short-term value destruction can arise as a rational outcome of competitive incentives rather than managerial failure. The analysis focuses on how relative performance evaluation and incentive pressure shape firm behavior. In markets where firms are constantly compared using short-term, observable metrics such as growth, order volume, or market share, deviation from these benchmarks can trigger immediate penalties. These penalties are often more visible and severe than the uncertain benefits of long-term discipline. As a result, firms may rationally prioritize maintaining competitive position in the short run even when doing so delays profitability or erodes margins. To ground this argument, the paper examines competition in the Indian food delivery sector, with particular attention to the rivalry between Swiggy and Zomato. This market is characterized by low switching costs, high price sensitivity, and strong scale effects, conditions under which short-term customer acquisition becomes a dominant competitive signal. Both firms have repeatedly relied on aggressive discounting and promotional pricing to defend market share and order volume. While these strategies succeed in attracting users in the short run, they compress margins and delay sustainable profitability, a tradeoff that has been widely acknowledged in public disclosures and investor commentary. Despite this awareness, discount-driven competition persists. This paper argues that such behavior reflects a coordination problem created by competitive incentives. Unilateral restraint is costly, as firms that reduce discounts risk rapid customer loss and negative signaling to investors, partners, and the market. Even when margins improve temporarily, reduced scale can weaken bargaining power and long-term efficiency. Competitive pressure therefore locks firms into an equilibrium where short-term signaling dominates, even when it produces inferior long-term outcomes. By examining firm behavior through the lens of incentives and relative evaluation, this paper highlights why market outcomes can diverge from long-term value maximization. Apparent short-termism in business strategy often reflects rational responses to competitive constraints rather than flawed decision-making.

AI.tldr: 竞争市场中的企业即使知道会损害长期价值，仍会理性地选择短期价值破坏策略，这是因为相对绩效评估和竞争激励导致的协调问题，而非管理失败。
AI.research_question: 为什么在激烈竞争的市场中，企业会持续采用削弱长期单位经济性的策略，即使决策者知道这些成本？
AI.motivation: 竞争市场预期会奖励长期价值创造，但现实中许多企业在激烈竞争下持续采用损害长期经济性的策略，这种现象需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对绩效评估理论、竞争激励理论、协调问题理论、短期信号主导理论
AI.method: 案例分析：以印度外卖行业（Swiggy和Zomato的竞争）为研究对象，分析其折扣策略和竞争行为
AI.findings: 企业理性地优先保持短期竞争地位，因为偏离短期可观察指标（增长、订单量、市场份额）会立即受到惩罚，而长期收益不确定；折扣驱动的竞争反映了竞争激励创造的协调问题
AI.theory_contributions: 解释了为什么市场结果会偏离长期价值最大化，表明表面上的短期主义是竞争约束下的理性反应而非决策失误
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者、管理者和监管者理解竞争市场中企业行为的逻辑，为评估企业战略提供新视角

title: Demand for Low-Carbon Energy Technologies in Private Households: Evidence from Switzerland
affiliations: University of Konstanz - Faculty of Economics and Statistics, Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology and Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL

detail.title: Demand for Low-Carbon Energy Technologies in Private Households: Evidence from Switzerland
detail.abstract: Improving energy efficiency in the residential sector and shifting away from fossil fuel-based heating are crucial for achieving net-zero energy systems. Here, we present empirically grounded projections of the demand for low-carbon energy technologies among private households. Using a nationwide discrete-choice experiment involving 1,676 homeowners from all regions of Switzerland, we examine how technology demand is influenced by subsidies and peer effects. We find substantial demand among homeowners for capital-intensive, decentralized technologies, such as rooftop photovoltaic systems, envelope retrofits, and heat pumps, which can be increased further through subsidies. In contrast, subsidies have little impact on the demand for centralized technologies. Electricity storage solutions are generally not attractive to homeowners unless they are combined with other technologies. At the current speed of technology adoption, peer effects will play a minor role in stimulating technology demand, even when technologies are heavily subsidized. This calls for further efforts to remove the barriers to technology adoption that currently hinder the spread of technologies through peer influence.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过瑞士全国范围的离散选择实验，分析补贴和同伴效应对家庭低碳能源技术需求的影响。研究发现补贴能显著提升屋顶光伏、建筑围护结构改造和热泵等资本密集型分散式技术的需求，但对集中式技术影响有限。电力存储方案吸引力不足，同伴效应在当前技术采用速度下作用有限。
AI.research_question: 补贴和同伴效应对家庭低碳能源技术需求有何影响？不同技术类型（分散式vs集中式）的需求响应模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 提高住宅能源效率和减少化石燃料供暖是实现净零能源系统的关键，需要了解家庭对低碳能源技术的需求驱动因素，特别是补贴政策和同伴效应的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择理论，结合行为经济学中的同伴效应理论，分析家庭在能源技术选择中的决策行为。
AI.method: 采用全国范围的离散选择实验，覆盖瑞士所有地区的1,676名房主，实证分析补贴和同伴效应对技术需求的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 房主对资本密集型分散式技术（屋顶光伏、围护结构改造、热泵）有显著需求，补贴能进一步提升需求；2. 补贴对集中式技术需求影响有限；3. 电力存储方案单独吸引力不足，需与其他技术结合；4. 在当前技术采用速度下，同伴效应刺激技术需求的作用有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了分散式和集中式低碳能源技术的需求响应差异；2. 揭示了补贴政策和同伴效应在不同技术类型中的异质性影响；3. 为理解家庭能源技术采用决策提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应针对分散式技术设计更有效的补贴方案；2. 需要解决阻碍技术通过同伴效应传播的障碍；3. 电力存储方案需要与其他技术捆绑推广；4. 为加速低碳转型提供了具体的政策建议。

title: Governance, Politics, and Development Management in Bangladesh

detail.abstract: This book chapter (in Development, Governance, and the Environment in South Asia, Palgrave Macmillan), outlines key political events that have contributed to political instability in the country. These events include Prime Minister Sheikh Mujibur Rahman’s granting all credits and privileges for the Liberation War to the Awami League refusing to acknowledge various factions of the Mukti Bahini (Freedom Fighters or FF), and establishment of a single-party system, blaming "divisive activities," particularly of "leftist radical parties." The chapter examines how the actions of various parties and their leaders over the years have negatively impacted the people's aspirations and the country's development, and offers insights for the future.

AI.tldr: 本章分析了孟加拉国政治不稳定的关键事件，包括谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼总理将解放战争的所有功劳和特权授予人民联盟、不承认穆克提·巴希尼（自由战士）的各个派系、建立一党制并指责"分裂活动"，特别是"左翼激进政党"的行为。
AI.research_question: 哪些关键政治事件导致了孟加拉国的政治不稳定？这些事件如何影响人民愿望和国家发展？
AI.motivation: 理解孟加拉国政治不稳定的历史根源，为未来治理提供见解，促进南亚地区的政治稳定和发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治发展理论、国家建设理论、政党政治理论、历史制度主义
AI.method: 历史分析、文献回顾、事件分析、定性研究
AI.findings: 1. 穆吉布·拉赫曼将解放战争功劳归于单一政党导致政治排斥；2. 不承认自由战士各派系加剧了社会分裂；3. 一党制建立削弱了民主制度；4. 指责左翼政党进一步激化了政治对立；5. 这些历史事件共同导致了长期的政治不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了南亚政治不稳定研究的理论框架；2. 提供了历史事件如何塑造政治制度的实证案例；3. 扩展了国家建设理论在发展中国家政治转型中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为孟加拉国政治改革提供历史教训；2. 为南亚其他国家避免类似政治不稳定提供借鉴；3. 为国际发展机构理解孟加拉国政治环境提供参考；4. 为未来治理和政策制定提供历史视角。

title: Steering Banks towards Sustainability: External Drivers, Internal Change Levers, and Management Controls
affiliations: WU Vienna University of Economics and Business and

detail.title: Steering Banks towards Sustainability: External Drivers, Internal Change Levers, and Management Controls
detail.abstract: Banks play a crucial role in the transition towards a more sustainable global economy by directing capital flows to sustainable activities. Drawing on the management control system (MCS) framework of Malmi and Brown (2008), this study analyses 17 semi-structured interviews with individuals at from five Swiss banks to examine how sustainability is integrated into banks’ MCSs and how this integration is shaped by internal and external drivers. We show that the integration of sustainability into business strategy, administrative controls, and organizational culture, as well as into top-management commitment constitute important levers to change banks’ core business activities, both directly and through their MCSs. Furthermore, we observe substantial variation in how sustainability is integrated across these levers and across different MCS components, which translates into varying degrees of sustainability integration in lending and investment products. Regarding external drivers, regulation induces banks to formally integrate sustainability into client advisory processes and reporting, yet does not necessarily induce fundamental organizational change. Sustainability reporting plays a dual role: while externally mandated, reporting requirements support internal integration by defining the relevant data points. Overall, our findings highlight the dynamic and interconnected nature of sustainability integration in banks and underscore that banks can actively shape their transformation.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Malmi和Brown（2008）的管理控制系统框架，通过分析瑞士五家银行的17个半结构化访谈，探讨银行如何将可持续发展整合到管理控制系统中，以及这种整合如何受内外驱动因素影响。
AI.research_question: 银行如何将可持续发展整合到管理控制系统中？这种整合如何受内部和外部驱动因素影响？
AI.motivation: 银行在向更可持续的全球经济转型中扮演关键角色，通过引导资本流向可持续活动。然而，银行如何将可持续发展整合到其管理控制系统中的机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Malmi和Brown（2008）的管理控制系统（MCS）框架，该框架包括战略、行政控制、组织文化等组件。
AI.method: 对瑞士五家银行的17个半结构化访谈进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 可持续发展整合到业务战略、行政控制、组织文化和高层承诺中是改变银行核心业务活动的重要杠杆；2. 不同银行在整合程度上存在显著差异，导致贷款和投资产品的可持续性整合程度不同；3. 监管驱动银行在客户咨询流程和报告中正式整合可持续性，但不一定引发根本性组织变革；4. 可持续性报告具有双重作用：外部强制要求支持内部整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了管理控制系统理论在可持续金融领域的应用，揭示了可持续性整合的动态性和相互关联性，为理解银行转型提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理者提供了整合可持续性的具体杠杆（战略、行政控制、文化、高层承诺），强调了银行可以主动塑造转型过程，为监管机构提供了政策启示。

title: Managing Your 'Tax' Academic Career: Rear-View Mirror Reflections And Looking Ahead
affiliations: Curtin University - Curtin Law School

detail.title: Managing Your 'Tax' Academic Career: Rear-View Mirror Reflections And Looking Ahead
detail.abstract: Australia saw major tax reform at the end of the millennium, and the introduction of the Goods and Services Tax acted as the catalyst that created opportunities for me to move from industry to academia. I have now worked in academia for over a quarter of century, initially casually then with a full-time position. During this time the Australian tax academic environment has seen many changes, particularly driven by key performance indicators implemented by the Federal government, but also due to the nationalisation of Australia's tax agent regime. Two fundamental influences on my academic career have been the Australasian Tax Teachers Association ('ATTA') and the 1999 book written by Royce Sadler Managing Your Academic Career. At this stage of my career, I will provide a critical analysis of Sadler's themes and I my interaction with ATTA as to their application to my own career, but also their potential application to the future of academia, especially for tax. Academia is a rewarding but challenging environment. It is critical for the tax profession as whole to have a healthy and thriving tax academic environment, both for the development of good tax policy, but also for the next generation of tax professionals.

AI.tldr: 本文是一位澳大利亚税务学者对自身学术生涯的反思性分析，探讨了税务学术环境的变化、关键影响因素（ATTA和Sadler的著作），以及对未来税务学术发展的思考。
AI.research_question: 如何评估Sadler的学术生涯管理主题和ATTA对作者个人学术生涯的影响，以及这些因素对未来税务学术环境的潜在应用？
AI.motivation: 作者经历了从产业界到学术界的转型，见证了澳大利亚税务学术环境的重大变化（包括GST改革、政府绩效指标、税务代理制度国家化），希望通过对个人经历的批判性分析，为税务学术环境的健康发展提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: Royce Sadler的《管理你的学术生涯》（1999）中的学术生涯管理理论；澳大利亚税务学术环境变迁的社会制度理论；专业学术协会（ATTA）对学者发展的影响理论。
AI.method: 批判性反思分析（critical reflective analysis），基于作者25年以上的学术经历，结合Sadler的理论框架和ATTA的实践经验进行自我分析。
AI.findings: 1. GST改革为产业界到学术界的转型创造了机会；2. 政府绩效指标和税务代理制度国家化显著改变了学术环境；3. ATTA和Sadler的著作对作者学术生涯发展起到了关键指导作用；4. 健康的税务学术环境对整个税务专业和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Sadler的学术生涯管理理论应用于税务学术领域的实证检验；2. 提出了税务学术环境变迁的制度分析框架；3. 发展了专业学术协会在学者发展中的中介作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为税务学者提供职业发展指导；2. 为学术机构改善税务学术环境提供建议；3. 强调了维持健康税务学术生态对税务政策和专业人才培养的重要性；4. 为未来税务学术发展提供战略方向。

title: Legal Implications Of Space Tourism
affiliations: Central University of Karnataka and Independent

detail.title: Legal Implications Of Space Tourism
detail.abstract: Necessity is the mother of invention, they say. Since ancient times, humanity has continued to strive for its unique quest for knowledge. With each progress, they introduced new dimensions for amusements and recreational purposes, which the millennials quote as an adrenaline rush. One such path-breaking invention is the concept of space tourism as an adventure for the rich. Space tourism, in simplest terms, refers to travelling into space for adventure. History was made by one Dannis A. Tito, who travelled to space in 2001, known as the first man to make his first space voyage as a space tourist. Once the ambit of space tourism emerged, the need for a legal framework to regulate such transits was also felt. Thereby, Space law developed as a new discipline to govern the growing aspects of space tourism. This paper aims to discuss the concept of Space tourism and the concurrent space laws that regulate such activities. This paper also focuses on the impact of space tourism in modern civilised nations and the responsibilities of the States in regulating space tourism. While discussing the relationship between tourists, operators, and third parties, this paper also discusses their liabilities toward each other in case of probable dangers. This paper also discusses the current status of Space tourism and space law within the legal framework of various International Treaties.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨太空旅游的概念、相关法律框架及其在现代文明国家的影响，分析国家监管责任以及游客、运营商和第三方之间的法律责任关系。
AI.research_question: 太空旅游的法律框架如何规范相关活动？国家在监管太空旅游中应承担什么责任？游客、运营商和第三方之间的法律责任关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着2001年Dannis A. Tito成为首位太空游客，太空旅游成为现实，迫切需要建立相应的法律框架来规范这一新兴领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 太空法作为新兴学科，基于国际条约框架，涉及国家责任、商业太空活动监管、以及多方利益相关者的法律责任关系。
AI.method: 文献分析法，分析现有国际条约、法律框架和相关案例，探讨太空旅游的法律监管机制。
AI.findings: 太空旅游需要完善的法律框架来规范国家责任、运营商资质、游客安全以及第三方责任；现有国际条约需要适应商业太空活动的发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了太空法理论，特别是商业太空旅游领域的法律规制，为多方利益相关者的法律责任关系提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国制定太空旅游监管政策提供参考，帮助运营商和游客理解法律责任，促进太空旅游行业的规范发展。

title: The Coronavirus Trade-off --Life vs. Economy: Handling the Trade-off Rationally and Optimally
affiliations: and North Carolina State University

detail.title: The Coronavirus Trade-off --Life vs. Economy: Handling the Trade-off Rationally and Optimally
detail.abstract: The recent coronavirus outbreak has made governments face an inconvenient trade-off choice, i.e. the choice between saving lives and saving the economy, forcing them to make immensely consequential decisions among alternative courses of actions without knowing what the ultimate results would be for the society as a whole. This paper attempts to frame the coronavirus trade-off problem as an economic optimization problem and proposes mathematical optimization methods to make rationally optimal decisions when faced with trade-off situations such as those involved in managing through the recent coronavirus pandemic. The framework introduced and the method proposed in this paper are on the basis of the theory of rational choice at a societal level, which assumes that the government is a rational, benevolent agent that systematically and purposefully takes into account the social marginal costs and social marginal benefits of its actions to its citizens and makes decisions that maximize the society's well-being as a whole. We approach solving this trade-off problem from a static as well as a dynamic point of view. Finally, we provide several numerical examples clarifying how the proposed framework and methods can be applied in the real-world context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个经济优化框架，将新冠疫情中的"拯救生命vs拯救经济"权衡问题建模为理性选择问题，从静态和动态角度提供数学优化方法，帮助政府做出社会福利最大化的决策。
AI.research_question: 政府如何在新冠疫情中做出"拯救生命vs拯救经济"的权衡决策，以实现社会福利最大化？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情迫使政府在不清楚最终社会结果的情况下做出重大权衡决策，需要在拯救生命和拯救经济之间找到最优平衡点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会层面的理性选择理论，假设政府是理性、仁慈的代理人，系统考虑其行为的社会边际成本和社会边际收益，做出最大化社会整体福利的决策。
AI.method: 将权衡问题构建为经济优化问题，提出数学优化方法，从静态和动态两个角度分析，并提供数值示例说明实际应用。
AI.findings: 提出了一个框架和方法，能够帮助政府在面对类似新冠疫情的权衡困境时，做出理性最优决策，平衡公共卫生和经济影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会理性选择理论应用于公共卫生危机管理，建立了政府决策的优化框架，扩展了理性选择理论在危机情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的数学工具和决策框架，帮助他们在现实世界中应对类似的权衡困境，做出更科学、更理性的政策选择。

title: The EU’s CBAM: implications for member states and trading partners
affiliations: and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: The EU’s CBAM: implications for member states and trading partners

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) came into force on 1 October 2023, introducing reporting requirements for importers of covered products and, from 2026, an obligation to pay a fee on the carbon content of imported goods. This paper uses indices of ad valorem tariffs to assess the incidence of the EU CBAM on both EU member states and the EU’s trading partners. Overall, the direct impact on EU countries’ trade is estimated to be small, adding 0.1 percent to the value of EU imports when averaged across all imports, and 0.04 percent to the average cost of non-EU countries’ exports to the EU—with a maximum of 1.2 percent. However, effects could be sizeable for specific products such as iron, steel and aluminium, which can help explain CBAM’s political salience. Moreover, an expanded CBAM featuring full coverage of ETS sectors, and a significantly higher carbon price could entail larger costs in the more distant future.

AI.tldr: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）于2023年10月生效，该研究使用从价关税指数评估CBAM对欧盟成员国和贸易伙伴的影响。总体贸易影响较小，但对特定产品（如钢铁、铝）影响显著，未来扩大覆盖范围和提高碳价可能带来更大成本。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）对欧盟成员国及其贸易伙伴的贸易影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: CBAM作为欧盟重要的气候政策工具，已于2023年10月生效，需要评估其对贸易的实际影响，特别是对特定产品和不同国家的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于从价关税指数的贸易影响评估框架，分析碳边境调节机制对贸易成本和竞争力的影响。
AI.method: 使用从价关税指数方法，量化评估CBAM对欧盟进口价值和贸易伙伴出口成本的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 总体影响较小：欧盟进口价值平均增加0.1%，非欧盟国家出口到欧盟的平均成本增加0.04%（最高1.2%）
2. 特定产品影响显著：钢铁、铝等产品受影响较大，解释了CBAM的政治重要性
3. 未来潜在影响：如果扩大ETS行业覆盖范围并提高碳价，未来可能带来更大成本
AI.theory_contributions: 为碳边境调节机制的贸易影响评估提供了量化分析框架，拓展了环境政策与贸易关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供CBAM实际影响的量化参考
2. 帮助企业了解CBAM对特定产品的潜在成本影响
3. 为贸易伙伴国家评估CBAM影响提供分析依据
4. 对未来CBAM政策调整提供预测基础

title: The ‘Ascension’ Strategy for Canadian Labour Law Reform: Options for Broader based Collective Bargaining
affiliations: York University

detail.title: The ‘Ascension’ Strategy for Canadian Labour Law Reform: Options for Broader based Collective Bargaining
detail.abstract: In Canada, as in many other countries, collective bargaining coverage has fallen sharply since the 1980s. While there is widespread understanding that a labour law model designed in the 1930s is probably no longer fit for purposes in the 21st century, there is little agreement on what a revised, modern collective bargaining law should look like. The possibilities for "broader-based" bargaining models are often bandied about in policy circles, but there is little understanding or agreement on what those models would do or how they would operate in practice. In this Working Paper, I describe a model for thinking about modern labour law reform that involves strategies of "ascension" and "descension" from the Wagner model's focus on enterprise bargaining.  The paper then describes various models of broader-based bargaining that have been proposed or adopted in western nations that have traditionally relied on decentralized models of collective bargaining. The paper concludes with a call for governments to study broader-based bargaining in a serious attempt to map a way forward for collective bargaining in the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨加拿大集体谈判覆盖率下降问题，提出通过"上升"和"下降"策略改革传统企业谈判模式，分析西方国家更广泛谈判模式的实践，呼吁政府认真研究以制定21世纪集体谈判新路径。
AI.research_question: 在传统企业谈判模式不再适用的21世纪，应如何改革集体谈判法律，特别是更广泛谈判模式应如何设计和运作？
AI.motivation: 加拿大自1980年代以来集体谈判覆盖率急剧下降，1930年代设计的劳动法模式已不适应21世纪需求，但缺乏对现代集体谈判法律改革的共识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Wagner企业谈判模式的"上升"和"下降"策略框架，分析从企业层面向上（行业/区域）或向下（工作场所）扩展谈判范围的理论模型。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建与比较研究法，分析西方国家（特别是传统依赖分散谈判模式的国家）已提出或采纳的更广泛谈判模式。
AI.findings: 存在多种更广泛谈判模式的可能性，但缺乏对这些模式实际运作方式和效果的系统理解与共识，需要进一步研究以明确改革路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"上升-下降"策略框架，为理解集体谈判改革提供新的理论视角，系统梳理西方国家更广泛谈判模式的实践经验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改革集体谈判法律的参考框架，呼吁政府认真研究更广泛谈判模式，为21世纪集体谈判发展指明方向。

title: Milton Friedman's Spending Matrix Revisited: 'Spending Efficiency' and 'Preference Compatibility' Across different Economic Systems

detail.title: Milton Friedman's Spending Matrix Revisited: 'Spending Efficiency' and 'Preference Compatibility' Across different Economic Systems
detail.abstract: This article expands Milton Friedman's spending matrix to analyse 'spending efficiency' and 'preference compatibility' across different economic systems against five key outcome criteria. By generalising Friedman's typology, it compares efficiency and freedom as systems shift from laissez-faire capitalism to communism, illustrating a gradual deterioration in their key outcomes. While government intervention is sometimes necessary to address market failures, its role should always be carefully limited to avoid inefficiency and misalignment with individual preferences. The insights may provide guidance for policymakers in designing economic systems and policies that promote both economic prosperity and personal liberty.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了弗里德曼的支出矩阵，通过五个关键结果标准分析不同经济体系下的"支出效率"和"偏好兼容性"。研究发现，从自由放任资本主义向共产主义转变时，效率和自由逐渐恶化。政府干预虽有时必要，但应谨慎限制以避免效率低下和偏好错配。
AI.research_question: 不同经济体系（从自由放任资本主义到共产主义）在支出效率和偏好兼容性方面如何表现？政府干预应如何平衡以同时促进经济繁荣和个人自由？
AI.motivation: 扩展米尔顿·弗里德曼的经典分析框架，为经济体系设计提供更系统的比较工具，帮助政策制定者在市场效率和个人自由之间找到最佳平衡点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于米尔顿·弗里德曼的支出矩阵理论，扩展为包含"支出效率"和"偏好兼容性"的分析框架，结合五个关键结果标准评估不同经济体系。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：扩展弗里德曼的支出矩阵，建立分析框架，通过五个关键结果标准比较不同经济体系（从自由放任资本主义到共产主义）的效率和自由表现。
AI.findings: 随着经济体系从自由放任资本主义向共产主义转变，支出效率和偏好兼容性逐渐恶化。政府干预虽能解决市场失灵，但过度干预会导致效率低下和与个人偏好错配。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了弗里德曼的经典分析框架，提出了更系统的经济体系比较工具，深化了对政府干预边界和效率-自由权衡的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供指导，帮助设计既能促进经济繁荣又能保护个人自由的经济体系和政策，强调政府干预应谨慎限制。

detail.abstract: Fall colour is fantastic in Canada, while it is relatively unknown and insignificant in India. The underlying reasons are well researched in cold countries like Canada and USA but it has not attracted attention in India, as it is not that vibrant and is less conspicuous. AI.tldr: 该研究比较了加拿大和印度秋季色彩的差异，探讨了为什么加拿大秋季色彩绚丽而印度相对不显著的原因，并分析了两国秋季自然景观的特点。
AI.research_question: 为什么加拿大秋季色彩绚丽而印度秋季色彩相对不显著？两国秋季自然景观有何差异？
AI.motivation: 加拿大秋季色彩绚丽且备受关注，而印度秋季色彩相对不显著且缺乏研究。本研究旨在填补这一研究空白，比较两国秋季自然景观的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 植物生理学、气候生态学、景观生态学、跨文化自然景观比较研究
AI.method: 比较研究法、文献综述、实地观察、案例分析（加拿大和印度）
AI.findings: 加拿大秋季色彩绚丽主要由于温带气候、落叶树种多样性、温度变化等因素；印度秋季色彩不显著主要由于热带/亚热带气候、常绿树种主导、温度变化较小等因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了秋季色彩研究的全球视野，建立了跨气候带的秋季景观比较理论框架，丰富了景观生态学的跨文化研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度秋季旅游开发提供参考，促进跨文化自然景观认知，为生态保护和景观规划提供科学依据。

title: Jus Cogens As A Barrier To Impunity: A Theoretical And Legal Analysis In The Light Of Ecthr Andicc Practicejus Cogens As A Barrier To Impunity: A Theoretical And Legal Analysis In The Light Of Ecthr Andicc Practice

detail.title: Jus Cogens As A Barrier To Impunity: A Theoretical And Legal Analysis In The Light Of Ecthr Andicc Practicejus Cogens As A Barrier To Impunity: A Theoretical And Legal Analysis In The Light Of Ecthr Andicc Practice
detail.abstract: The article focuses on the theoretical and legal analysis of jus cogens norms as a universal constraint on immunities in the context of the case law of the European Court of Human Rights and the International Criminal Court. The aim of the study is to reveal the legal nature of jus cogens norms as a universal limitation on immunities and a guarantee of effective justice in cases involving violations of the fundamental principles of international law. The study employed general scientific methods of cognition: analysis, synthesis, induction, deduction, abstraction, generalization and the comparative legal method. The findings show that jus cogens norms are being established as a fundamental category of international public law with absolute legal authority and priority over both customary rules and international treaties. Their imperative nature imposes restrictions not only on lawmaking but also on the application of the concepts of state and functional immunity in cases involving crimes against the core values of humanity. The case law of the International Criminal Court, specialized tribunals, and, to some extent, the European Court of Human Rights has been analyzed, demonstrating a gradual limitation of the scope of immunities in cases involving crimes falling under jus cogens. It is emphasized that this trend reinforces the primacy of victims’ rights and strengthens the principle of unconditional accountability. The conclusion highlights the need to reform Ukraine’s criminal procedural legislation in order to implement jus cogens norms. It is shown that such reform should include the introduction of special proceedings for individuals with immunity, the priority of peremptory norms over national limitations, and the creation of effective procedural mechanisms for investigating and prosecuting crimes that threaten international legal order. It has been proven that the law must provide for the possibility of prosecuting individuals regardless of their official status or citizenship, and the judiciary must apply jus cogens norms as universal standards that cannot be overridden by references to national privileges. This approach aligns with Ukraine’s international obligations and promotes the strengthening of the rule of law at all levels. The practical value of the study lies in developing a normative framework to ensure effective accountability for jus cogens crimes within the Ukrainian jurisdiction.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了强行法规范作为豁免权普遍限制的理论和法律分析，特别关注欧洲人权法院和国际刑事法院的判例。研究发现强行法规范具有绝对法律权威，优先于习惯规则和国际条约，对国家和职能豁免权构成限制，强化受害者权利和无条件问责原则。研究建议乌克兰进行刑事程序立法改革以实施强行法规范。
AI.research_question: 强行法规范作为豁免权的普遍限制，其法律性质是什么？如何确保在涉及违反国际法基本原则的案件中实现有效司法？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在揭示强行法规范作为豁免权普遍限制的法律性质，确保在涉及违反国际法基本原则的案件中实现有效司法，特别是针对危害人类核心价值的犯罪行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际公法中的强行法理论、豁免权理论（国家豁免和职能豁免）、国际人权法、国际刑法、比较法理论。
AI.method: 采用一般科学认知方法：分析、综合、归纳、演绎、抽象、概括，以及比较法律方法。分析国际刑事法院、专门法庭和欧洲人权法院的判例法。
AI.findings:
1. 强行法规范正在确立为国际公法的基本范畴，具有绝对法律权威，优先于习惯规则和国际条约
2. 强行法的强制性不仅限制立法，还限制在涉及危害人类核心价值犯罪的案件中适用国家和职能豁免概念
3. 国际刑事法院、专门法庭和欧洲人权法院的判例显示，在涉及强行法犯罪的案件中豁免范围逐渐受限
4. 这一趋势强化了受害者权利的首要地位和无条件问责原则
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 深化了对强行法规范作为豁免权普遍限制的理论理解
2. 阐明了强行法规范在国际法体系中的绝对优先地位
3. 发展了关于豁免权限制与强行法规范关系的理论框架
4. 为国际刑法和人权法的理论发展提供了新的视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为乌克兰刑事程序立法改革提供具体建议：引入针对享有豁免权个人的特别程序、确立强行法规范优先于国内限制、创建调查和起诉威胁国际法律秩序犯罪的有效程序机制
2. 证明法律必须规定无论个人官方地位或国籍如何都可起诉的可能性
3. 司法机构必须将强行法规范作为不可被国内特权援引推翻的普遍标准适用
4. 开发确保在乌克兰管辖范围内对强行法犯罪有效问责的规范框架

title: Global Financial Spillovers of U.S. Trade Policy
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Global Financial Spillovers of U.S. Trade Policy
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic transmission of U.S. trade policy shocks to the macro-financial conditions of 26 major trading partners using a country-specific structural vector autoregression framework spanning January 2001 to June 2025. We document a distinct heterogeneity in global spillovers characterized by a tug-of-war between opposing economic forces. For economies deeply integrated into North American supply chains, such as Australia, Chile, and Colombia, U.S. tariffs manifest as stagflationary cost-push shocks. Conversely, for major Eurozone exporters like Germany, Austria, and Italy, the deflationary demand channel prevails, as negative income effects outweigh cost pressures. Beyond price dynamics, we uncover a rapid financial transmission channel where trade policy functions as a primary driver of asset repricing. While the shocks trigger immediate equity sell-offs in markets such as Sweden and France, we observe large positive cumulative returns in Canada, consistent with trade diversion effects. Cross-country regressions identify the structural determinants of this variation: financial openness and global value chain participation significantly mitigate short-run exchange rate depreciation, whereas geographic distance and import dependence amplify long-run asset price volatility. Quantitatively, trade policy uncertainty explains over 27\% of the forecast error variance in Canadian stock returns, highlighting the dominance of U.S. policy in driving partner financial conditions. These findings underscore a monetary policy dilemma, where central banks in emerging markets must tighten rates to defend currencies against capital flight despite sharply tightening financial conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用结构向量自回归模型分析了2001-2025年间美国贸易政策冲击对26个主要贸易伙伴的宏观金融条件动态传导，发现全球溢出效应存在显著异质性：北美供应链深度整合经济体面临滞胀性成本推动冲击，而主要欧元区出口国则经历通缩性需求冲击。研究还揭示了贸易政策作为资产重新定价主要驱动因素的快速金融传导渠道。
AI.research_question: 美国贸易政策冲击如何动态传导至主要贸易伙伴的宏观金融条件？这种传导机制在不同经济体间存在怎样的异质性？哪些结构性因素决定了传导效应的差异？
AI.motivation: 随着全球贸易紧张局势加剧，理解美国贸易政策对全球经济的溢出效应变得至关重要。现有研究多关注贸易政策对本国经济的影响，而对跨国传导机制、特别是对宏观金融条件的动态影响缺乏系统性分析。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为政策制定者提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放经济宏观经济学理论，结合成本推动冲击和需求冲击的传导框架，以及国际金融中的资产定价理论。研究区分了贸易政策的两种传导渠道：实体经济渠道（通过供应链和贸易流动）和金融渠道（通过资产重新定价和资本流动）。
AI.method: 采用国别特定的结构向量自回归（SVAR）框架，时间跨度为2001年1月至2025年6月，覆盖26个主要贸易伙伴。通过脉冲响应函数分析动态传导效应，并使用跨国回归识别结构性决定因素。采用预测误差方差分解量化贸易政策不确定性对资产回报的解释力。
AI.findings: 1. 全球溢出效应存在显著异质性：北美供应链深度整合经济体（如澳大利亚、智利、哥伦比亚）面临滞胀性成本推动冲击；主要欧元区出口国（如德国、奥地利、意大利）则经历通缩性需求冲击。2. 贸易政策作为资产重新定价的主要驱动因素：瑞典和法国出现立即的股票抛售，而加拿大则因贸易转移效应获得正的累积回报。3. 结构性决定因素：金融开放度和全球价值链参与显著缓解短期汇率贬值，而地理距离和进口依赖则放大长期资产价格波动。4. 贸易政策不确定性解释了加拿大股票回报预测误差方差的27%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了贸易政策冲击跨国传导的异质性理论框架，区分了成本推动和需求传导渠道。2. 提出了贸易政策作为金融冲击的传导机制，丰富了国际金融理论。3. 识别了决定传导差异的结构性因素，为理解全球溢出效应的决定因素提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对贸易政策冲击的实证依据：新兴市场央行面临货币政策困境，需要在资本外流时收紧利率以捍卫货币，尽管这会加剧金融条件紧缩。2. 为投资者提供了资产配置的参考：不同经济体的资产价格对贸易政策冲击反应不同，加拿大等经济体可能受益于贸易转移效应。3. 为国际贸易谈判提供了启示：金融开放度和全球价值链参与可以作为缓冲贸易政策冲击的重要工具。

title: Active Aging with Leisure and Free Time Activities for a Better Quality of Life
affiliations: University Camilo José Cela - Universidad Camilo José Cela, University of Extremadura - Extremadura University, University of Extremadura - Extremadura University and National Distance Education University (UNED)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No aplica
declarations.ethicsApproval: No aplica

detail.abstract:
The objective of this research was to study the relationship between the participation of the elderly in learning programs in cultural activities developed in senior centers. The research was quantitative, cross-sectional and relational; a probabilistic sample was applied to select 340 elderly people over 65 years of age, corresponding to a senior center in Madrid. The instrument used to collect information consisted of 20 questions grouped into 4 dimensions. The results indicate that the elderly are satisfied with the new cultural learning offered by  the senior centers. 72% of the people surveyed, contribute to improve learning through these activities. The research provides possible improvements to prevent loneliness, improving the quality of life. It is suggested to improve the learning programs in cultural activities to achieve greater participation in society. This research suggests possible improvements in areas that will help prevent dependency, such as those where there is greater demand from users. Specific plans to increase the participation of men in the workshops held in the senior centers are suggested as suggestions for improvement.

La investigación fue cuantitativa, transversal y relacional; se aplicó un muestreo probabilístico para seleccionar a 340 personas mayores de 65 años, correspondientes a un centro de mayores de Madrid. El instrumento utilizado para recoger la información consistió en 20 preguntas agrupadas en 4 dimensiones. Los resultados indican que los mayores están satisfechos con los nuevos aprendizajes culturales que ofrecen los centros de mayores. El 72% de los encuestados, contribuyen a mejorar el aprendizaje a través de estas activi-dades. La investigación aporta posibles mejoras para prevenir la soledad, mejorando la calidad de vida. Se sugiere mejorar los programas de aprendizaje en actividades culturales para lograr una mayor participación en la sociedad. Esta investigación sugiere posibles mejoras en áreas que ayuden a prevenir la dependencia, como aquellas en las que existe una mayor demanda por parte de los usuarios. AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了老年人参与老年中心文化学习项目的关系，发现72%的受访者通过活动改善了学习，并提出改进建议以预防孤独、提高生活质量。
AI.research_question: 老年人参与老年中心文化学习项目与其学习效果、生活质量改善之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在了解老年中心文化学习项目对老年人的影响，特别是如何通过这类活动改善学习效果、预防孤独、提高生活质量，并促进社会参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于老年学习理论、社会参与理论和生活质量理论，探讨文化学习活动对老年人认知、社交和生活质量的影响。
AI.method: 采用定量、横断面、关系性研究方法，对马德里一个老年中心的340名65岁以上老年人进行概率抽样，使用包含20个问题、4个维度的问卷收集数据。
AI.findings: 1. 老年人对老年中心提供的文化学习活动感到满意；2. 72%的受访者通过这些活动改善了学习；3. 活动有助于预防孤独和提高生活质量；4. 需要改进项目以增加社会参与；5. 需要特别关注男性参与度较低的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了文化学习活动对老年人学习效果的积极影响；2. 建立了老年学习与社会参与、生活质量改善的理论联系；3. 为老年教育理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为老年中心改进文化学习项目提供具体建议；2. 提出预防孤独和依赖的具体措施；3. 建议制定增加男性参与度的专门计划；4. 为政策制定者提供改善老年人生活质量的实践指导。

All respondents were fully informed about the purpose and procedures of this study and were told that their participation in the assessment was voluntary and that they had the right to terminate the survey at any point or refuse to answer any questions. Confidentiality of the interviews and anonymity of all participants and the data collected during the survey were strictly guarded. detail.abstract:
Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major public health challenge in Azerbaijan, where stigma and discrimination continue to act as significant barriers to timely diagnosis, access to care, and treatment adherence. This national TB Stigma Assessment aimed to evaluate the extent, forms, and drivers of TB-related stigma across multiple settings and population groups, and to identify legal, social, and health-system factors contributing to stigma. Using standardized tools developed by the Stop TB Partnership, the study employed a mixed-methods approach combining quantitative surveys and qualitative data collection.

Data were collected between October and December 2023 from 540 participants across nearly all economic regions of Azerbaijan, including people with TB (PWTB), family members, community members, health care workers, and key stakeholders. Quantitative data were analyzed using SPSS, while qualitative findings were triangulated through focus group discussions and legal and policy review.

The findings reveal high levels of self-stigma among PWTB (51%), widespread stigma within communities (69%), and notable stigma within health care settings (57%). More than one-third of PWTB reported experiencing enacted stigma, particularly in communities, workplaces, and health facilities, often during the early stages of the TB care pathway. Women with TB were disproportionately affected across most stigma dimensions. Family members and health care workers also reported experiencing secondary stigma.

The assessment concludes that addressing TB stigma requires comprehensive legal reform, community awareness, health worker training, and people-centered support services to improve health outcomes.

AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆结核病相关污名的程度、形式和驱动因素是什么？哪些法律、社会和卫生系统因素导致了污名？

AI.method: 混合方法研究：采用Stop TB Partnership标准化工具，定量调查（540名参与者）和定性数据收集（焦点小组讨论、法律政策审查），数据通过SPSS分析

title: Evaluating Behavioral Interventions at Scale with AI
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, NHH Norwegian School of Economics , affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Cologne

detail.title: Evaluating Behavioral Interventions at Scale with AI
detail.abstract: We test the effectiveness of different AI-delivered conversation protocols to increase people's motivation for change. In a large-scale experiment with 2,719 social media users, we randomly assign participants to a control conversation or one of three treatment arms: two Motivational Interviewing protocols promoting self-persuasion (change focus or decisional balance) and a direct persuasion protocol providing unsolicited advice and information. All conversations are led by an AI interviewer, enabling standardized delivery of each protocol at scale. Our results show that all three interventions significantly increase motivation for change and the perceived costs of social media use, with change-focused self-persuasion yielding the largest effects. These effects persist and translate into self-reported reductions in social media use more than two weeks after the intervention. Our findings illustrate how AI-led conversations can serve as a scalable platform both for delivering behavioral interventions and for testing what makes them effective by systematically varying how conversations are conducted.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模实验测试了AI主导的对话协议对提升人们改变动机的效果。研究发现，三种AI对话干预（两种动机性访谈协议和一种直接说服协议）都能显著提高改变动机和感知成本，其中以改变为重点的自我说服效果最佳，且效果能持续两周以上并转化为实际社交媒体使用减少。
AI.research_question: 不同AI主导的对话协议在提升人们改变动机方面的效果如何？特别是比较动机性访谈（自我说服）与直接说服协议的效果差异。
AI.motivation: 需要开发可扩展的行为干预方法，同时系统性地测试对话方式如何影响干预效果。AI对话平台为此提供了标准化、大规模实施和测试不同对话协议的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动机性访谈理论（特别是自我说服机制）、行为改变理论、说服理论、人机交互理论。
AI.method: 大规模随机对照实验，2,719名社交媒体用户被随机分配到控制组或三种干预组之一：两种动机性访谈协议（改变焦点或决策平衡）和一种直接说服协议。所有对话由AI访谈者主导，确保协议标准化实施。
AI.findings: 1. 所有三种干预都显著提高了改变动机和社交媒体使用的感知成本；2. 以改变为重点的自我说服效果最大；3. 效果持续两周以上，并转化为自我报告的社交媒体使用减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了AI主导对话作为行为干预平台的有效性；2. 比较了不同对话协议（自我说服vs直接说服）的相对效果；3. 证明了AI对话可以系统性地测试对话方式对干预效果的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种可扩展的行为干预方法；2. 确定了最有效的对话协议（改变焦点自我说服）；3. 展示了AI对话平台在行为干预研究和实践中的双重价值。

title: Teaching Economics and Providing Visual "Big Pictures"

detail.title: Teaching Economics and Providing Visual "Big Pictures"

keywords: and Keynesians IS/LM/AS/AD Models. JEL. A22

detail.abstract: The goal of this paper is to investigate the importance of providing visual "big pictures" in the teaching of economics. The plurality and variety of concepts, variables, diagrams, and models involved in economics can be a source of confusion for many economics students. However, reviewing the existing literature on the importance of providing visual "big pictures" in the process of learning suggests that furnishing students with a visual "big picture" that illustrates the ways through which those numerous, diverse concepts are connected to each other could be an effective solution to clear up the mentioned mental chaos. As a practical example, this paper introduces a "big picture" that can be used as a good resource in intermediate macroeconomics classes. This figure presents twenty-seven commonly-discussed macroeconomic diagrams in the intermediate macroeconomics course, and gives little detail on some of these diagrams, aiming at helping students to get the whole picture at once on a single piece of paper. This macroeconomics big picture mostly focuses on the routes through which common diagrams in macroeconomics are connected to each other, and finally introduces the general macroeconomic equilibrium that is graphically derived through those connections.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在经济学教学中提供视觉"大图"的重要性，认为这能帮助学生理清众多概念、变量、图表和模型之间的混乱关系。论文以中级宏观经济学为例，介绍了一个包含27个常用宏观经济图表的视觉大图，展示这些图表如何相互连接并最终推导出宏观经济均衡。
AI.research_question: 在经济学教学中提供视觉"大图"是否能有效帮助学生理清众多概念、变量、图表和模型之间的混乱关系？
AI.motivation: 经济学中概念、变量、图表和模型的多样性和复杂性常常导致学生感到困惑和混乱，需要寻找有效的教学方法来帮助学生建立整体理解框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于视觉学习理论和认知负荷理论，强调视觉"大图"在帮助学习者建立知识结构和理解复杂概念关系方面的重要性。
AI.method: 文献综述结合实践案例研究，通过开发一个包含27个常用宏观经济图表的视觉大图作为教学资源，展示概念间的连接路径。
AI.findings: 提供视觉"大图"能有效帮助学生理清经济学概念间的复杂关系，特别是在中级宏观经济学中，通过展示27个图表如何相互连接并推导出宏观经济均衡，能显著提高学生的整体理解能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济学教育领域提供了视觉"大图"教学方法的理论支持，强调了视觉整合在复杂概念学习中的认知价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个具体可用的中级宏观经济学视觉"大图"教学资源，为经济学教师提供了实用的教学工具，帮助学生在一张纸上获得整体理解。

title: Historicism and Urban Climate Governance in the Americas

detail.title: Historicism and Urban Climate Governance in the Americas

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were used in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: The author has no external funding or financial conflicts of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: As climate risks become increasingly apparent in cities and other urban areas, there is a growing need to develop climate mitigation and adaptation strategies to reduce the vulnerability of people and communities in such geographies. While the literature on urban climate governance emphasizes contemporary policies and future projections, it often overlooks the historical context that shapes present-day urban climates and the increasingly vital role that historical knowledge plays in climate mitigation and adaptation efforts. In addition, existing studies tend to neglect the deep-rooted historical factors that have shaped urban governance structures themselves. Meanwhile, there is a lack of methodological frameworks that adequately capture the complex qualitative interplay between historical processes and contemporary climate governance practices. This study addresses these gaps in the literature by exploring the role that historicism plays in urban climate governance. Drawing upon the theories and approaches of political ecology, historicism, and global governance, and utilizing quantitative and qualitative content analysis methods, this paper examines how cities in the Americas are building resilience to climate change by fusing historical knowledge with ecological principles. Moreover, by paying greater attention to historicism in environmental analysis and solutionsfinding, this study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of how historical legacies influence urban climate governance strategies and outcomes. The empirics for this study were gathered from an analysis of climate plans and green urban development projects (N=102) enacted between 2001 and 2020 in climate hotspot cities (N=95) located in North America, Latin America, and Caribbean island states. The findings of this study confirm that city planners and urban development plans in these regions are increasingly incorporating historical knowledge as they address the issue of climate change. Much of the historical and ecological knowledge systems that are being incorporated into urban planning aim to remedy historical legacies of socioeconomic inequity, which manifest contemporarily as environmental and spatial inequalities (or vice versa) in these cities. These legacies of inequality are shown to disproportionately concentrate climate risks in neighborhoods and communities that have been historically underserved and resource-strapped. The typologies of climate risk interventions where these historical knowledge systems were being applied were evenly distributed between nature-based and governance interventions. However, green infrastructural development, water resource management, and native biodiversity enhancement were the main intervention areas these plans addressed. Plans also focused more on climate adaptation in South America and the Caribbean island states, whereas climate mitigation (carbon emissions reduction) featured more prominently in the plans of North American cities. The unavailability of historical data on certain aspects of city ecology was a major limitation identified in these climate plans. This study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of the complex interactions between the past, present, and future that are shaping cities in the face of global climate shifts.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨历史主义在城市气候治理中的作用，通过分析美洲95个气候热点城市的102份气候计划和绿色城市发展项目，发现城市规划者正越来越多地融入历史知识来解决气候变化问题，特别是针对社会经济不平等的历史遗留问题。
AI.research_question: 历史主义在城市气候治理中扮演什么角色？历史知识如何与生态原则融合来增强城市的气候韧性？
AI.motivation: 现有城市气候治理文献过于关注当代政策和未来预测，忽视了塑造当今城市气候的历史背景，以及历史知识在气候减缓和适应中的重要作用。同时缺乏能够捕捉历史过程与当代气候治理实践复杂定性互动的方法框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治生态学、历史主义理论和全球治理理论
AI.method: 定量和定性内容分析方法，分析2001-2020年间北美、拉丁美洲和加勒比岛国95个气候热点城市的102份气候计划和绿色城市发展项目
AI.findings: 1. 城市规划者越来越多地将历史知识融入气候变化应对；2. 融入的历史和生态知识系统旨在纠正社会经济不平等的历史遗留问题；3. 不平等历史遗留导致气候风险不成比例地集中在历史上服务不足和资源匮乏的社区；4. 历史知识应用在基于自然的干预和治理干预中分布均匀；5. 主要干预领域包括绿色基础设施发展、水资源管理和本地生物多样性增强；6. 南美和加勒比岛国更关注气候适应，北美城市更关注气候减缓；7. 城市生态某些方面的历史数据缺乏是主要限制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了城市气候治理中历史背景研究的空白；2. 提供了历史主义在环境分析和解决方案中的理论框架；3. 深化了对过去、现在和未来复杂互动如何塑造城市应对全球气候变化的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市规划者提供了将历史知识融入气候治理的实践指导；2. 揭示了如何通过纠正历史不平等来减少气候风险分布不均；3. 为不同地区的气候治理重点提供了区域差异的见解；4. 指出了历史数据收集的重要性

title: Legal Liability of Property Agents in Marketing Houses Using the Pre-Project Selling System
affiliations: and Hasanuddin University, Students

detail.title: Legal Liability of Property Agents in Marketing Houses Using the Pre-Project Selling System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this article
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical research principles. Informed consent was obtained from all participants, and participants’ anonymity and confidentiality were strictly maintained throughout the research process

detail.abstract: Marketing houses using the pre-project selling (PPS) system is prone to problems because the houses being marketed are not yet completed, so that losses suffered by consumers due to developer default can have an impact on property agents who act as intermediaries between developers and consumers in marketing houses using the PPS system. The purpose of this study is to analyse the legal relationship between developers, property agents, and consumers, as well as the legal responsibility of property agents in marketing houses using the PPS system. The research method used was empirical legal research in the city of Makassar. The data sources consisted of primary data (interviews) and secondary data (laws and regulations, books, and other literature). Data collection techniques were conducted through interviews and literature studies, then analysed qualitatively through descriptive descriptions. The results of the study show that the legal relationship between developers and real estate agents, and developers and consumers, is bound by agreement. Meanwhile, real estate agents and consumers do not have a direct legal relationship, because real estate agents only act as intermediaries between developers and consumers. Real estate agents are not included in the sale and purchase agreement between developers and consumers. Therefore, in general, real estate agents are not directly responsible for developers' default in the PPS system. However, property agents still have a moral responsibility to consumers in the event of default by developers. The conclusion of this study is that the legal relationship between developers, property agents, and consumers gives rise to the rights and obligations of each party according to their position. If each party understands this, then house marketing using the PPS system can run well without harming any party.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了在预项目销售(PPS)系统中开发商、房地产中介和消费者之间的法律关系，以及房地产中介的法律责任。研究发现开发商与中介、开发商与消费者之间存在合同关系，但中介与消费者没有直接法律关系。中介通常不对开发商违约承担直接法律责任，但负有道德责任。
AI.research_question: 在预项目销售(PPS)系统中，开发商、房地产中介和消费者之间的法律关系是什么？房地产中介在PPS系统营销房屋中的法律责任是什么？
AI.motivation: 由于PPS系统销售的房屋尚未完工，开发商违约可能给消费者造成损失，而作为开发商与消费者中介的房地产中介也可能受到影响。需要明确各方法律关系和责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同法理论、中介法律关系理论、预项目销售系统相关法律框架
AI.method: 采用实证法律研究方法，在望加锡市进行。数据来源包括主要数据（访谈）和次要数据（法律法规、书籍和其他文献）。通过访谈和文献研究收集数据，然后通过描述性分析进行定性分析。
AI.findings:
1. 开发商与房地产中介、开发商与消费者之间存在合同约束的法律关系
2. 房地产中介与消费者没有直接法律关系，因为中介仅作为开发商与消费者之间的中间人
3. 房地产中介不包含在开发商与消费者的买卖合同中
4. 房地产中介通常不对开发商在PPS系统中的违约承担直接法律责任
5. 但房地产中介在开发商违约时对消费者负有道德责任
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 明确了PPS系统中三方主体的法律关系结构
2. 区分了房地产中介的法律责任与道德责任
3. 为预项目销售系统的法律分析提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助房地产中介了解其在PPS系统中的法律地位和责任边界
2. 为消费者提供法律保护意识，明确维权对象
3. 为开发商规范PPS系统营销提供参考
4. 促进PPS系统房屋营销的健康运行，减少各方损失风险

title: Assessing the Relative Importance of the Drivers of CO2 Emissions in the Selected Emerging Economies Using Machine Learning Approach
affiliations: , University of Delhi and Power Finance Corporation

detail.title: Assessing the Relative Importance of the Drivers of CO2 Emissions in the Selected Emerging Economies Using Machine Learning Approach
detail.abstract: The main objective of the present research is to answer a key research question: what is the relative importance of the drivers of CO2 emissions? Another important question the present study addresses is how the countries are related to each other regarding CO2 emissions. Taking a sample of 42 emerging economies from Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) and using hierarchical clustering and the neural network method the study tries to answer the key question. Firstly, the explanatory variables were identified through a review of the literature. Subsequently, the gathered data was classified into two clusters having similar characteristic variables utilizing the dendrogram by performing an exploratory clustering method known as hierarchical clustering. Later using the machine learning K-Means clustering technique, the clusters were verified. The use of another machine learning method of feed-forward multilayer perceptron commonly known as neural network helped us to identify the relative importance of explanatory variables viz. economic growth (EG), renewable energy consumption (REC), urbanization (URB), democracy index (DI) and foreign direct investment (FDI) for their relation to the response variable viz. CO2 emissions. The neural network results reveal that EG, REC, and URB are the most important variables (with Rank 1,2, and 3 respectively) followed by DI (Rank 4) and FDI (Rank 5). FDI seemingly is the least important among these identified variables.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用层次聚类和神经网络方法，分析了42个新兴经济体CO2排放的驱动因素相对重要性，发现经济增长、可再生能源消费和城市化是最重要的三个变量。
AI.research_question: CO2排放驱动因素的相对重要性是什么？各国在CO2排放方面如何相互关联？
AI.motivation: 了解新兴经济体CO2排放的关键驱动因素及其相对重要性，为制定有效的减排政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和发展经济学理论，探讨经济增长、可再生能源消费、城市化、民主指数和外国直接投资对CO2排放的影响。
AI.method: 采用层次聚类分析（通过树状图）将42个亚洲和撒哈拉以南非洲新兴经济体分为两个聚类，使用K-Means聚类验证，然后通过前馈多层感知器（神经网络）确定解释变量的相对重要性。
AI.findings: 神经网络结果显示：经济增长（EG）是最重要的变量（排名第1），其次是可再生能源消费（REC，排名第2）、城市化（URB，排名第3）、民主指数（DI，排名第4）和外国直接投资（FDI，排名第5）。FDI是这些变量中最不重要的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了新兴经济体CO2排放驱动因素相对重要性的实证证据；2）将机器学习方法（层次聚类、K-Means、神经网络）应用于环境经济学研究；3）揭示了不同社会经济变量对CO2排放的非线性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了减排政策的优先顺序：应重点关注经济增长模式转型、促进可再生能源消费和可持续城市化；2）帮助识别具有相似CO2排放特征的国家群体，便于制定区域合作策略；3）为国际组织提供针对不同国家群体的差异化政策建议。

title: Econometric Modeling of Input-Driven Output Risk through a Versatile CES Production Function

detail.title: Econometric Modeling of Input-Driven Output Risk through a Versatile CES Production Function
detail.abstract: The conventional functional form of the Constant-Elasticity-of-Substitution (CES) production function is a general production function nesting a number of other forms of production functions. Examples of such functions include Leontief, Cobb-Douglas, and linear production functions. Nevertheless, the conventional form of the CES production specification is still restrictive in multiple aspects. One example is the fact that the marginal effect of increasing input use always has to be to increase the variability of output quantity by the conventional construction of this function. This paper proposes a generalized variant of the CES production function that allows for various input effects on the probability distribution of output. Failure to allow for this possible input-output risk structure is indeed one of the limitations of the conventional form of the CES production function. This limitation may result in false inferences about input-driven output risk. In light of this, the present paper proposes a solution to this problem. First, it is shown that the familiar CES formulation suffers from very restrictive structural assumptions regarding risk considerations, and that such restrictions may lead to biased and inefficient estimates of production quantity and production risk. Following the general theme of Just and Pope's approach, a CES-based production-function specification that overcomes this shortcoming of the original CES production function is introduced, and a three-stage Nonlinear Least-Squares (NLS) estimation procedure for the estimation of the proposed functional form is presented. To illustrate the proposed approaches in this paper, two empirical applications in irrigation and fertilizer response using the famous Hexem-Heady experimental dataset are provided. Finally, implications for modeling input-driven production risks are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义CES生产函数，克服了传统CES函数在输入-输出风险结构建模方面的限制，允许输入对产出概率分布产生不同影响，并提供了三阶段非线性最小二乘估计方法。
AI.research_question: 如何扩展传统的CES生产函数以更好地建模输入驱动的生产风险？
AI.motivation: 传统CES生产函数在风险考虑方面存在结构性限制，其边际效应假设总是增加产出变异性，这可能导致对输入驱动产出风险的错误推断和估计偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Just和Pope的风险生产函数方法，结合CES生产函数框架，构建能够灵活建模输入对产出概率分布影响的广义CES生产函数。
AI.method: 提出三阶段非线性最小二乘估计程序来估计广义CES生产函数参数，并使用Hexem-Heady实验数据集进行灌溉和肥料响应两个实证应用。
AI.findings: 传统CES函数在风险建模方面存在限制，可能导致生产数量和风险估计的偏差；提出的广义CES函数能够更灵活地捕捉输入对产出风险的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CES生产函数理论，使其能够建模输入对产出概率分布的不同影响，克服了传统CES在风险结构方面的限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可用于实证分析的广义CES函数估计方法，有助于更准确地评估农业生产中的输入风险，为灌溉和肥料管理等决策提供更好的分析工具。

title: The African Regional Human and Peoples' Rights System: 40 Years of Progress and Challenges

detail.title: The African Regional Human and Peoples' Rights System: 40 Years of Progress and Challenges
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a comprehensive and detailed analysis of the African regional human rights system, emphasizing both its innovations and remaining challenges. To this end, a literature review of primary sources, as well as the jurisprudence of the human rights bodies of the African system, will be analyzed. Although this system did not start functioning until the decade of the eighties of the 20th century, it has evolved considerably once the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights was adopted. Thus, several other treaties followed it, of which the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child and the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples› Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa can be pointed out. And even though initially only the creation of protection and control mechanisms was foreseen-the African Commission on Human and People's Rights and the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child-after 1998, the African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights was added, which has progressively adopted a protectionist and growing jurisprudence; but also that, as its predecessors, will face different challenges, among which the reform process of the judicial bodies of the African Union themselves. In any case, the main conclusion of this article is that the innovations of the system are considerable (and largely unknown), although outstanding challenges need to be addressed to ensure the effectiveness and development of the system.

title: Backward Growth Accounting: An Economic Tool for Strategic Planning of Business Growth

detail.title: Backward Growth Accounting: An Economic Tool for Strategic Planning of Business Growth
detail.abstract: Business growth is a goal of great importance for its both private and social benefits. Many firms view business growth as an imperative for their survival, stability, and long-term success. Business growth can be socially beneficial, too, as it enables businesses to expand into new territories where they can stimulate economic growth and development, creates more jobs, increase living standards, and better serve their communities by giving back more through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. Business growth must be planned reasonably and optimally so that it can effectively achieve its critical ambitions in business practice. The current common practices for planning the supply side of business growth are usually ad-hoc and lack well-established mathematical and economic foundations. The present paper argues that business growth planning can be pursued more structurally, reliably, and meaningfully within the framework of Growth Accounting (GA), which was first introduced by Economics Nobel Laureate Robert Solow to study economic growth. It is shown that, although GA was initially put forth as a procedure to explain "economic growth" ex-post, it can similarly be used to plan "business growth" ex-ante when a general backward approach is taken in its procedure-called Backward Growth Accounting (BGA) in this paper. Taking this well-established economic-mathematical approach to planning business growth will enhance the current practices conceptually and structurally, as it is built on the basis of economic logic and mathematical tools. BGA can help businesses identify and plan for key drivers of output growth and assess shortcomings in the growth process, such as poor productivity, inadequate labor utilization, or insufficient capital investment. The paper outlines an eight-step procedure for planning business growth using BGA and includes appendices with real-world examples.C5, D2, L1, M11, M21, O4. This is an open access article under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License, which permits use, distribution and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于增长核算框架的结构化业务增长规划方法，称为"反向增长核算"，将原本用于事后分析经济增长的工具应用于事前业务增长规划。
AI.research_question: 如何将增长核算框架应用于业务增长规划，以提供更结构化、可靠和有意义的方法？
AI.motivation: 当前业务增长规划实践通常缺乏数学和经济基础，采用临时性方法。需要更结构化的方法来有效实现业务增长的关键目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长核算理论（罗伯特·索洛提出），反向增长核算框架，经济增长理论在微观层面的应用。
AI.method: 提出八步反向增长核算程序，将原本用于事后分析经济增长的增长核算方法应用于事前业务增长规划。
AI.findings: 增长核算框架可以成功应用于业务增长规划，帮助企业识别产出增长的关键驱动因素，评估增长过程中的不足（如生产率低下、劳动力利用不足或资本投资不足）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宏观经济增长理论（增长核算）扩展到微观业务层面，提出反向增长核算概念，为业务增长规划提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供八步结构化程序帮助企业规划增长，包含现实案例，增强当前实践的概念和结构基础，基于经济逻辑和数学工具。

title: The Case Law of the African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights in Libya Following the Arab Uprisings: Lessons Learned for the Consolidation and Legitimation of the Court
affiliations: and University of Seville, Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Case Law of the African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights in Libya Following the Arab Uprisings: Lessons Learned for the Consolidation and Legitimation of the Court
detail.abstract: This article examines the two cases brought before the African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights following the Libyan uprising in 2011: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (Benghazi) v Libya and African Commission (Saif al-Islam Gaddafi) v Libya. These two cases mark three ‘firsts’: the first time for the African Commission to transfer a case to the African Court; the first order for provisional measures by the Court; and the first time the Court rendered a judgment by default. This study reveals that although the Court has taken significant steps in terms of its consolidation and legitimation, substantive and procedural challenges in its functioning remain. Moreover, the authors argue that the political divisions within the African Union diminished the Court’s potential impact on the Libyan crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文分析非洲人权法院审理利比亚2011年起义后两起案件，探讨法院在程序创新、制度巩固方面的进展，以及政治因素如何限制其实际影响。

AI.motivation: 分析非洲人权法院首次处理非洲委员会移交案件、首次发布临时措施命令、首次作出缺席判决的三个"第一次"，评估法院在人权保护机制中的发展状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人权法、国际法院制度发展理论、区域人权保护机制有效性理论、国际法与政治互动理论。

title: Shaming Climate Wrongdoers
affiliations: The Max Stern Yezreel Valley College and George Mason University - Center for Climate Change Communication

detail.title: Shaming Climate Wrongdoers
detail.abstract: Climate law, policy, and governance have grown substantially in recent years, yet these efforts have achieved only modest success. This article spotlights an underexplored complementary strategy in policy, governance, and legal domains: climate shaming--the use of public condemnation to encourage climate-responsible behaviour among governments, corporations, and their leaders. While shaming has been studied and applied as a regulatory and governance tool in other contexts, only a small but growing body of scholarship has begun to examine its potential in the climate arena. Drawing on multidisciplinary research from the social sciences, the humanities, and law, we review and map the main strands of this emerging literature to show the diverse forms and potential of shaming mechanisms, actors, and messages in the climate domain. Based on this analysis, we identify several gaps in the literature and practice of climate shaming, including explicit regulatory shaming, intergovernmental shaming, shaming of regulators by civil-society actors, and regulatory shaming of industry leaders. We propose expanding the conceptual framework of climate shaming to encompass these neglected dimensions, with the aim of encouraging further research as well as policy and governance experimentation in this evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨气候羞辱作为气候政策、治理和法律领域的一种补充策略，通过公开谴责来鼓励政府、企业和领导人的气候责任行为，分析了现有文献的不足并提出了扩展概念框架的建议。
AI.research_question: 气候羞辱作为气候政策、治理和法律领域的补充策略，其形式、机制、参与者和信息传递方式有哪些？现有文献和实践存在哪些空白？如何扩展气候羞辱的概念框架以促进进一步研究和政策实验？
AI.motivation: 近年来气候法律、政策和治理虽然有所发展，但成效有限。需要探索气候羞辱这一未被充分研究的补充策略，利用公开谴责来促进气候责任行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会科学、人文科学和法律的多学科研究，借鉴羞辱作为监管和治理工具在其他领域的应用理论，构建气候羞辱的概念框架。
AI.method: 文献综述和映射分析，回顾和梳理新兴的气候羞辱文献，识别主要研究脉络、形式、机制、参与者和信息传递方式。
AI.findings: 气候羞辱具有多样化的形式、机制、参与者和信息传递方式；现有文献和实践存在多个空白，包括明确的监管羞辱、政府间羞辱、公民社会对监管者的羞辱、以及监管机构对行业领导者的羞辱。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了气候羞辱的概念框架，纳入了被忽视的维度；为这一新兴领域提供了系统的理论梳理；提出了未来研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和治理实践者提供了气候羞辱作为补充策略的实践指导；鼓励在这一领域进行政策实验和治理创新；为公民社会组织和监管机构提供了具体的羞辱机制应用建议。

title: Competition Law and Antitrust Disputes in the Era of Sports' Hyper-Commercialisation: America and Australia Compared
affiliations: City University of New York - Baruch College, Zicklin School of Business and Monash University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Competition Law and Antitrust Disputes in the Era of Sports' Hyper-Commercialisation: America and Australia Compared

publicationDetails.detailsText: Australian and New Zealand Sports Law Journal, Volume 18 (2025)

detail.abstract: The twenty-first century has seen the hyper-commercialisation of sports. With hyper-commercialisation has come competition from actors both powerful and passionate for a share of the economic pie. This competition has sometimes escalated into conflict over legal and economic rights requiring judicial adjudication. This article explores the similarities and differences in the twenty-first century application of United States antitrust and Australian competition law to commercial sports. Observations and insights are then distilled from that examination about how courts and the law in the two jurisdictions have responded (and may in the future respond) to sports’ hyper-commercialisation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了21世纪美国和澳大利亚在体育超商业化背景下反垄断/竞争法的应用，分析了两国法院和法律对体育产业商业化的应对方式及未来可能的发展。

AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法理论、竞争法理论、体育经济学、法律比较研究、商业体育治理理论
AI.method: 比较法律分析、案例研究、文献综述、司法裁决分析
