title: The Economic Costs of Oligopoly in the Markets of Rare Earth Minerals
affiliations: University of Catania - Department of Economics and Business, University G. d’Annunzio of Chieti-Pescara and University of Messina

detail.title: The Economic Costs of Oligopoly in the Markets of Rare Earth Minerals
detail.abstract: In this research, the costs of rare earth elements (REEs) due to the oligopolistic market structure are estimated. On the supply side, China exercises a dominant position in the international REEs market because it controls more than 40 percent of deposits and more than 60 percent of REEs traded. Other countries assume an ancillary role in international markets for these minerals, which will increasingly play a crucial role in economic growth in the coming decades, since REEs are considered the minerals of technology and the green transition. Using the fringe oligopoly model, the costs due to this market structure for economies less endowed with deposits of these minerals are estimated. To perform this analysis, the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index was calculated, and a new index of dependence on REEs, as a proxy for a country's economic vulnerability, was constructed. Our database covers fifty years and sixty-two countries. Most of the data used comes from the World Bank database. Using quantile econometric models, we can calculate the economic costs of countries with fewer REEs caused by the market power exerted by the leading country in this market and estimate the loss for each country involved in the international trade of these minerals. Finally, technological advancements play a pivotal role in aiding countries reliant on REEs to lower their costs. This can be achieved through policies aimed at minimizing the utilization of REEs during manufacturing, harnessing the recycling of minerals from used products, and discovering alternative materials to replace REEs.

AI.tldr: 本文估计了稀土元素（REEs）因寡头垄断市场结构而产生的成本。中国在国际稀土市场占据主导地位，控制着超过40%的储量和60%以上的贸易量。研究使用边缘寡头垄断模型，计算了稀土资源较少国家因这种市场结构而承受的经济成本，并构建了稀土依赖指数来衡量经济脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 稀土元素寡头垄断市场结构对稀土资源较少国家造成了多大的经济成本？
AI.motivation: 稀土元素是技术和绿色转型的关键矿产，对经济增长至关重要。中国在国际稀土市场占据主导地位（控制40%以上储量和60%以上贸易），形成了寡头垄断市场结构，这可能导致其他国家对稀土进口国的经济成本增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边缘寡头垄断模型（fringe oligopoly model）、赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（Herfindahl-Hirschman Index）、稀土依赖指数（作为经济脆弱性的代理变量）
AI.method: 使用分位数计量经济模型，基于50年62个国家的数据（主要来自世界银行数据库），计算稀土资源较少国家因市场主导国家行使市场权力而产生的经济成本。
AI.findings: 估计了每个参与稀土国际贸易的国家因市场寡头结构而遭受的经济损失。技术发展在帮助依赖稀土的国家降低成本方面起着关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了新的稀土依赖指数作为经济脆弱性的代理变量；2. 将边缘寡头垄断模型应用于稀土市场分析；3. 量化了寡头垄断市场结构对资源较少国家的经济影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了减少稀土依赖的具体路径：减少制造过程中的稀土使用、加强废旧产品中的稀土回收、寻找替代材料；2. 帮助各国评估自身在稀土市场的经济脆弱性；3. 为国际贸易谈判和政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Measuring Food Insecurity in Afghanistan: Evidence from Latent Variable Analysis of Household Survey Indicators

detail.title: Measuring Food Insecurity in Afghanistan: Evidence from Latent Variable Analysis of Household Survey Indicators
detail.abstract: Food insecurity is a multidimensional and unobservable construct that is commonly assessed using a set of partially overlapping indicators. Using data from the 2023 Afghanistan Agriculture and Food Security Monitoring System survey, this paper examines the latent structure underlying commonly used food security measures, including food consumption, dietary diversity, food-based coping, and household hunger-based indicators. Exploratory factor analysis applied at the item level reveals that these measures capture multiple distinct dimensions of food insecurity rather than a single continuum, with substantial heterogeneity also observed within indicators. Relating extracted latent factors to existing composite measures highlights important implications for indicator selection, triangulation, and targeting in food security monitoring and humanitarian response.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用探索性因子分析发现，常用的粮食安全指标（食物消费、膳食多样性、食物应对策略和家庭饥饿指标）反映了粮食不安全的多个不同维度，而非单一连续体，这对粮食安全监测和人道主义响应中的指标选择、三角验证和针对性干预有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 常用的粮食安全指标（食物消费、膳食多样性、食物应对策略和家庭饥饿指标）是否捕捉了粮食不安全的单一维度，还是反映了多个不同的潜在维度？
AI.motivation: 粮食不安全是一个多维且不可直接观测的概念，通常通过一组部分重叠的指标来评估。理解这些指标背后的潜在结构对于改进粮食安全监测和人道主义响应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维粮食安全概念框架，认为粮食不安全包含多个相互关联但不同的维度，而非单一连续体。
AI.method: 使用2023年阿富汗农业和粮食安全监测系统调查数据，在项目层面应用探索性因子分析，检验常用粮食安全指标的潜在结构。
AI.findings: 探索性因子分析显示，常用粮食安全指标捕捉了粮食不安全的多个不同维度，而非单一连续体。指标内部也存在显著异质性。将提取的潜在因子与现有综合指标关联，揭示了重要启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上证实了粮食不安全的多维性质，挑战了将其视为单一连续体的传统观点，为理解不同指标之间的关系提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对粮食安全监测和人道主义响应实践有重要启示：1）指标选择需要考虑多维性；2）需要三角验证方法；3）针对性干预需要考虑不同维度的差异；4）现有综合指标可能需要重新评估。

title: Possibility of Applying Ijtihad Method in Humanities (Case Study: Leadership in Islamic Management)

detail.title: Possibility of Applying Ijtihad Method in Humanities (Case Study: Leadership in Islamic Management)
detail.abstract: In order to enable the application of the ijtihad method in the humanities, this article explores the leadership style in Islamic management, using Islamic teachings and based on ijtihad analysis. Findings of this study show that ijtihad method is a combined method that is related to the combined knowledge of management from the branches of humanities and the method of Islamic leadership as one of the subjects of humanities in the field of ijtihad method can be analyzed. Considering the ijtihad method in Islamic teachings, there are two categories of propositions, in both of which there is a part of Quranic propositions and a part of narrative propositions. Some of the first category statements directly depict the ruler or leader's relationship with followers and how they interact with them; However, some of these statements are general speeches that can be applied to the style of absolute softness; Therefore, it can be said that this category of propositions implies softness and absolute friendliness, and the second category of Qur'anic and narrative propositions emphasizes the mixing of softness with intensity of action; According to these two categories of propositions, according to the principles of jurisprudence and jurisprudence in the ijtihad method, it is possible to be in the position of a combination of propositions wherever a group of propositions (arguments) imply an absolute subject, at the same time a group Other propositions imply the same subject, carried absolute propositions to the constraint; What is more, according to the rule of "the plural is important, the first possibility of my plan", the arguments that are absolute can be carried on, so it can be inferred that in the leadership style, both flexibility and intensity of action are necessary; Hence, the result of ijtihad analysis is that leadership in Islamic management is a mixture of "maximum flexibility and minimum intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何将伊斯兰教法中的"伊智提哈德"（ijtihad）方法应用于人文科学领域，特别是伊斯兰管理中的领导风格。研究发现伊智提哈德是一种综合方法，能够分析伊斯兰领导风格这一人文科学主题。根据伊斯兰教义中的两类命题，领导风格需要结合最大限度的灵活性和最小限度的严厉性。
AI.research_question: 如何将伊斯兰教法中的"伊智提哈德"（ijtihad）方法应用于人文科学，特别是伊斯兰管理中的领导风格分析？
AI.motivation: 为了在人文科学领域应用伊智提哈德方法，探索伊斯兰管理中的领导风格，基于伊斯兰教义进行伊智提哈德分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊智提哈德（ijtihad）方法、伊斯兰教法学原理、古兰经命题与叙述命题的分类、伊斯兰领导理论、人文科学与管理知识的结合。
AI.method: 伊智提哈德分析方法，基于古兰经和圣训中的两类命题进行教法学分析，运用"复数重要，我的计划的第一可能性"规则进行推理。
AI.findings: 1. 伊智提哈德是一种综合方法，能够分析伊斯兰领导风格这一人文科学主题；2. 伊斯兰教义中存在两类命题：第一类强调绝对温和与友好，第二类强调温和与行动强度的结合；3. 根据教法学原理，绝对命题可以被约束命题所限定；4. 领导风格需要同时具备灵活性和行动强度；5. 伊斯兰管理中的领导是"最大限度的灵活性和最小限度的严厉性"的结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将伊智提哈德方法扩展到人文科学领域；2. 建立了伊斯兰领导风格的理论框架；3. 提出了基于古兰经和圣训命题分类的领导风格分析模型；4. 发展了伊斯兰管理理论的教法学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为伊斯兰组织提供了基于教义的领导实践指导；2. 帮助管理者理解如何在灵活性和严厉性之间取得平衡；3. 为伊斯兰教育机构提供了领导力培训的理论基础；4. 促进了伊斯兰价值观在现代管理实践中的应用。

title: The GENIUS Act's "Interest" Prohibition: Evidence of Regulatory Arbitrage in Digital Asset Markets
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The GENIUS Act's "Interest" Prohibition: Evidence of Regulatory Arbitrage in Digital Asset Markets
detail.abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence that the interest prohibition contained in the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins (GENIUS) Act has been effectively circumvented through intermediated distribution structures. Using archival data from January 2024 through January 2026, I demonstrate that USDC "rewards" distributed through Coinbase exhibit a 98.7% correlation with 3-month Treasury Bill yields, with 95.6% pass-through efficiency and a stable 21-basis-point intermediation spread. Ordinary least squares regression analysis with a structural break variable reveals that the Act's July 2025 enactment produced no statistically significant decoupling effect. These findings suggest that the statutory prohibition on "interest or yield" payments has been rendered ineffective through relabeling and structural intermediation. The economic substance of these rewards may trigger scrutiny under the Howey and Reves tests, potentially classifying them as securities despite their nomenclature. This research demonstrates the limitations of prohibition-based regulatory approaches in digital asset markets, a conclusion reinforced by Coinbase's successful January 2026 intervention to block similar interest prohibition language in the proposed Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 (Clarity).

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实证分析发现，美国《GENIUS法案》中的利息禁令通过中介分销结构被有效规避。USDC通过Coinbase分发的"奖励"与3个月国债收益率高度相关，法案实施后未产生显著脱钩效应，表明禁令式监管在数字资产市场效果有限。
AI.research_question: 《GENIUS法案》中的利息禁令是否有效阻止了稳定币的利息支付？中介分销结构如何影响禁令的有效性？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估美国《GENIUS法案》中禁止稳定币支付利息或收益的监管措施的实际效果，探索数字资产市场中监管规避的现实情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管规避理论、金融中介理论和证券法理论（Howey测试和Reves测试），分析禁令式监管在数字资产市场的局限性。
AI.method: 使用2024年1月至2026年1月的档案数据，通过普通最小二乘法回归分析，包含结构断点变量，检验USDC"奖励"与3个月国债收益率的相关性、传递效率和中介利差。
AI.findings: USDC通过Coinbase分发的"奖励"与3个月国债收益率存在98.7%的高度相关性，传递效率达95.6%，中介利差稳定在21个基点。法案2025年7月实施后未产生统计显著的脱钩效应，表明禁令被重新标签和结构中介有效规避。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）揭示了禁令式监管在数字资产市场的局限性；2）证明了监管规避通过重新标签和结构中介的有效性；3）为数字资产证券分类提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为监管机构提供禁令式监管无效的实证证据；2）建议监管机构关注经济实质而非名义标签；3）为《数字资产市场清晰法案》的立法讨论提供参考依据。

title: The IRS Approach To Periodic Adjustments: Losing Bet or Royal Flush?
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Law, University of Michigan Law School, California State Polytechnic University, San Luis Obispo and Cross Border Analytics, Inc.

detail.title: The IRS Approach To Periodic Adjustments: Losing Bet or Royal Flush?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This paper provides background on the January 2025 IRS Chief Counsel Generic Legal Advice Memorandum 2025-001, which provides guidance for the application of the Commensurate with Income approach in the second sentence of section 482 to controlled transfers of intangibles. The paper also strongly refutes assertions made by Elizabeth Stevens and Clark Armitage who strongly criticized this January 2025 GLAM maintaining that its content was inconsistent with a proper understanding of the CWI standard.

The paper demonstrates that the 2025 GLAM and regulations are fully consistent with the terms and purposes of the CWI provision, relevant legislative history, and applicable case law. Further, it demonstrates that the 2025 GLAM represents a valid application of discretion delegated by Congress to the Treasury under Loper Bright standards.

This paper concludes with a strong suggestion that multinational managements and directors should take a hard look at their taxation behavior given the potentially catastrophic effect that an application of periodic adjustments can have. The paper footnotes a series of article that hypothetically apply such periodic adjustments to a number of specific multinationals using publicly available information. The December 2025 issuance by the IRS of a Notice of Deficiency to Meta Platforms, Inc. for approximately $16 billion, the bulk of which arises from the application of periodic adjustments, only makes this suggestion that much more compelling.

AI.tldr: 该论文为2025年1月IRS首席法律顾问通用法律咨询备忘录2025-001号提供背景，该备忘录为第482条第二句中"与收入相称"方法在受控无形资产转让中的应用提供指导。论文反驳了Elizabeth Stevens和Clark Armitage对该备忘录的批评，论证该备忘录符合CWI标准、立法历史和判例法，并代表国会授权财政部的有效裁量权。论文建议跨国公司管理层审视税务行为，因为定期调整可能带来灾难性后果，并以Meta Platforms公司收到约160亿美元税务欠款通知为例说明。
AI.research_question: 2025年1月IRS首席法律顾问通用法律咨询备忘录2025-001号是否与"与收入相称"标准的正确理解一致？该备忘录是否代表国会授权财政部的有效裁量权应用？
AI.motivation: 针对Elizabeth Stevens和Clark Armitage对2025年1月IRS备忘录的强烈批评，该备忘录涉及第482条"与收入相称"方法在受控无形资产转让中的应用指导。批评者认为备忘录内容与CWI标准的正确理解不一致，需要澄清和辩护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国税法第482条"与收入相称"标准、相关立法历史、适用判例法、Loper Bright标准下的行政裁量权理论、受控无形资产转让的转让定价原则。
AI.method: 法律分析：分析2025年GLAM与CWI条款的术语和目的一致性；审查相关立法历史；研究适用判例法；依据Loper Bright标准评估行政裁量权的有效性；引用实际案例（如Meta Platforms公司约160亿美元税务欠款通知）。
AI.findings: 2025年GLAM和法规完全符合CWI条款的术语和目的、相关立法历史以及适用判例法。2025年GLAM代表国会根据Loper Bright标准授权财政部的有效裁量权应用。定期调整的应用可能对跨国公司产生灾难性财务影响，Meta Platforms公司的案例证明了这一点。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了"与收入相称"标准在受控无形资产转让中的正确应用；确立了GLAM在Loper Bright标准下的合法性；为CWI条款的解释提供了法律和理论支持；反驳了对IRS指导的错误批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司管理层提供明确的税务合规指导；警示跨国公司定期调整可能带来的灾难性财务后果；为税务从业者提供实际应用框架；通过Meta Platforms等实际案例说明风险严重性；建议跨国公司重新审视转让定价策略。

title: The Future of Branding in a Tech-Driven World: How Emerging Technologies Are Redefining Consumer Engagement
affiliations: Department of Management Technology Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management, Nagpur, India

detail.title: The Future of Branding in a Tech-Driven World: How Emerging Technologies Are Redefining Consumer Engagement
detail.abstract: In a world increasingly dependent on technology, companies must learn how to connect with consumers on an emotional level and cultivate meaningful relationships beyond instant gratification. AI can enhance personalized engagement marketing by providing customers with tailored options and information, transforming branding and customer management practices in both developed and developing countries (V. Kumar et al., 2019). Generating awareness for brands is now as simple as creating a cat video, resulting in a shortsighted view of branding that equates buying a TV.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨在技术依赖日益增加的世界中，企业如何通过AI增强个性化参与营销，与消费者建立情感连接和有意义的长期关系，而非仅追求即时满足。
AI.research_question: 在技术驱动的环境中，企业如何利用AI增强个性化参与营销，与消费者建立超越即时满足的情感连接和有意义的关系？
AI.motivation: 当前品牌营销过于注重短期效果（如病毒式传播），将品牌建设简化为购买广告，缺乏与消费者的深度情感连接和长期关系培养。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kumar等人（2019）的AI增强个性化参与营销理论，强调情感连接、关系营销和超越即时满足的长期品牌价值。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合文献综述和概念分析，探讨AI在个性化营销中的应用及其对品牌-消费者关系的影响。
AI.findings: AI能够通过提供定制化选项和信息增强个性化参与营销，帮助企业在发达和发展中国家转变品牌管理和客户关系实践，建立更深层次的情感连接。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI在营销领域的理论应用，提出了超越短期交易导向的情感连接框架，丰富了关系营销和品牌管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了利用AI建立情感连接的具体策略，帮助品牌从短期营销转向长期关系建设，提升客户忠诚度和品牌价值。

title: Market and Technological Reforms in Indian Agriculture: Needs for a Wholistic Approach
affiliations: ICAR- National Institute of Biotic Stress Management, Carnegie Mellon University and Centre for Multi-Disciplinary Development Research (CMDR)

detail.title: Market and Technological Reforms in Indian Agriculture: Needs for a Wholistic Approach
detail.abstract:
This paper critically evaluates the policy and institutional dynamics underlying India’s agricultural policy and technological evolution, with a focus on liberalization of agricultural markets and promote private investment in infrastructure such as cold chains and warehouses. The paper examined the demands for a legally guaranteed Minimum Support Price (MSP) and also structural constraints in existing market arrangements. Drawing on various government reports and scholarly literature, the analysis shows that politically influenced Agricultural Produce Marketing Committees (APMCs) have historically limited private investment and hindered market modernization. Negligible procurement of pulses and oilseeds at MSP constrained crop diversification, while assured procurement of paddy and wheat ensured price stability but contributed to monocropping systems, dietary imbalance and persistent undernutrition among women and children. Farmers cultivating non-cereal crops continue to face price volatility, low profitability, and increasing import dependence. The paper proposes a restructured MSP framework built on income insurance, combining limited cereal procurement,
Price Deficiency Payments, and strengthened APMCs and Farmer Producer Organisations.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了印度农业政策与制度动态，聚焦农业市场自由化与私人投资促进。研究发现政治影响的APMCs限制了私人投资和市场现代化，MSP政策导致作物单一化、营养失衡，非谷物作物面临价格波动。提出基于收入保险的重构MSP框架。
AI.research_question: 印度农业政策与制度动态如何影响市场现代化、作物多样化和营养结果？如何重构MSP框架以解决这些问题？
AI.motivation: 印度农业面临市场现代化不足、作物单一化、营养失衡等问题，需要评估现有政策制度并设计更有效的政策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、农业政策分析、市场结构理论、价格支持机制理论
AI.method: 基于政府报告和学术文献的政策分析，批判性评估现有政策制度
AI.findings: 1) 政治影响的APMCs限制了私人投资和市场现代化；2) MSP政策导致谷物作物单一化，非谷物作物面临价格波动；3) 政策造成营养失衡和持续营养不良；4) 进口依赖增加
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 深化对发展中国家农业政策制度动态的理解；2) 提出制度约束与市场现代化关系的分析框架；3) 拓展价格支持政策对营养结果影响的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出基于收入保险的重构MSP框架；2) 建议结合有限谷物采购、价格差额支付和强化APMCs/FPOs；3) 为印度农业政策改革提供具体方案

title: Transition Paths of Brazil from an Agricultural Economy to a Regional Powerhouse: A Global Supply Chain Perspective
affiliations: University of Southern Indiana,  and The University of Toledo

detail.title: Transition Paths of Brazil from an Agricultural Economy to a Regional Powerhouse: A Global Supply Chain Perspective
detail.abstract: This study examines Brazil's evolution from a primarily agricultural economy to a pivotal player within global supply chains, contesting the traditional view of emerging markets as mere suppliers of raw materials and labor. It closely examines Brazil's assertive efforts and the obstacles it encounters, focusing on its role within the context of Latin America. Utilizing macroeconomic data, the research reveals the barriers to Brazil's deeper integration into global supply chains and outlines novel strategies to enhance its global position. The findings highlight Brazil's capacity to significantly influence and advance the global economic framework, emphasizing its vital role in redefining the narrative on global supply chain engagement from a Latin American perspective.

AI.tldr: 巴西从农业经济向全球供应链关键参与者的转型，挑战了新兴市场仅是原材料和劳动力供应商的传统观点，研究揭示了巴西融入全球供应链的障碍并提出了提升其全球地位的新策略。
AI.research_question: 巴西如何从传统农业经济转型为全球供应链的关键参与者？其在融入全球供应链过程中面临哪些障碍？如何通过新策略提升其在全球经济中的地位？
AI.motivation: 挑战新兴市场仅是原材料和劳动力供应商的传统观点，从拉丁美洲视角重新定义全球供应链参与模式，探索巴西在全球经济框架中的潜在影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球供应链理论、新兴市场发展理论、经济转型理论、拉丁美洲区域经济一体化理论。
AI.method: 利用宏观经济数据分析，结合巴西在拉丁美洲的区域背景，系统研究其融入全球供应链的障碍和策略。
AI.findings: 巴西具有显著影响和推进全球经济框架的能力，但其融入全球供应链面临多重障碍；研究提出了提升其全球地位的新策略，强调巴西在重新定义全球供应链参与叙事中的关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了新兴市场在全球供应链中的传统定位理论，提出了从拉丁美洲视角重新定义全球供应链参与模式的理论框架，丰富了经济转型和区域一体化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西政府和企业提供了融入全球供应链的具体策略，为其他新兴市场国家提供了转型参考，为跨国公司理解拉丁美洲供应链格局提供了实践指导。

title: Digital Diplomacy and States' Soft Power: A Comprehensive Analysis
affiliations: University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Digital Diplomacy and States' Soft Power: A Comprehensive Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Bu çalışma için etik kurul onayı gerekmemektedir.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding source for this study.

detail.abstract: This study offers a comprehensive and comparative analysis of digital diplomacy as a transformative force reshaping states' soft power in the 21st century. Building on classical and contemporary theories of power, public diplomacy, and strategic communication, the article examines how digital platforms, algorithms, and networked publics reconfigure attraction, legitimacy, and influence. Methodologically, the study adopts a qualitative, comparative casestudy design drawing on document analysis, digital content analysis, and thematic coding. Empirically, it investigates the United States, the European Union, China, and Türkiye, complemented by regional cases from East Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America. The findings demonstrate that digital diplomacy increases the visibility and speed of soft power, centers narrative construction, multiplies non-state actors, deepens nation branding, and expands counter-disinformation practices, while simultaneously introducing ethical risks and reputational fragility. The article advances the concept of "digital soft power" to capture these dynamics and offers policy implications for strategic communication, institutional coordination, capacity-building, and ethical governance. By integrating theory with extensive case evidence, the study contributes to debates on power in the digital age and provides a framework for understanding influence in platformized international relations.

AI.tldr: 本文对数字外交作为重塑21世纪国家软实力的变革力量进行了全面比较分析，提出了"数字软实力"概念，探讨了数字平台如何重构吸引力、合法性和影响力。
AI.research_question: 数字外交如何作为变革力量重塑21世纪国家的软实力？数字平台、算法和网络公众如何重新配置吸引力、合法性和影响力？
AI.motivation: 数字技术正在深刻改变国际关系中的权力动态，传统软实力理论需要更新以适应平台化的国际关系环境，理解数字外交如何重塑国家影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古典和当代的权力理论、公共外交理论和战略传播理论，构建了数字软实力的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用定性比较案例研究设计，结合文档分析、数字内容分析和主题编码方法。
AI.findings: 数字外交提高了软实力的可见性和传播速度，强化了叙事建构，增加了非国家行为体的作用，深化了国家品牌建设，扩展了反虚假信息实践，同时也带来了伦理风险和声誉脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"数字软实力"概念，为理解数字时代的权力动态提供了新的理论框架，推动了数字时代权力理论的辩论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战略传播、机构协调、能力建设和伦理治理提供了政策启示，为平台化国际关系中的影响力运作提供了实践框架。

title: Fair Cooperation Without Desert: Rawls on Justice, Advantage, and Moral Arbitrariness

detail.title: Fair Cooperation Without Desert: Rawls on Justice, Advantage, and Moral Arbitrariness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was developed independently and revised for scholarly dissemination.

detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs and critically evaluates John Rawls's argument that social and economic inequalities are justifiable only when they arise within a scheme of fair cooperation among free and equal persons. Focusing on Rawls's rejection of desert-based justifications for inequality, the paper examines how the original position and the veil of ignorance function to exclude morally arbitrary advantages from the justification of political principles. Rawls's two principles of justice are interpreted not as distributive rules grounded in merit or efficiency, but as institutional constraints designed to secure reciprocity and public legitimacy. The analysis argues that Rawls offers a compelling account of why natural talents and social starting points cannot ground moral entitlement to greater reward, and why inequalities must be justified to those who are least advantaged. At the same time, the paper critically assesses persistent objections concerning effort, responsibility, motivation, and the limits of ideal theory. While Rawls's framework faces challenges in accounting for intuitions about individual responsibility and in addressing non-ideal conditions of structural injustice, the paper contends that these difficulties do not undermine his core insight. Justice as fairness is best understood as a normative standard for evaluating the moral legitimacy of social institutions rather than as a comprehensive theory of personal desert. By situating distributive justice within the context of social cooperation and institutional design, the paper defends Rawls's approach as a powerful alternative to moralized and entitlement-based accounts of inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文重构并批判性评估了罗尔斯关于社会经济不平等只有在自由平等个体公平合作框架内才可辩护的论证，聚焦其反对基于应得的正当性，分析原初状态和无知之幕如何排除道德任意优势，将正义原则解释为确保互惠和公共合法性的制度约束。
AI.research_question: 罗尔斯关于社会经济不平等正当性的论证如何重构？其反对基于应得的正当性、通过原初状态和无知之幕排除道德任意优势的框架是否具有说服力？
AI.motivation: 罗尔斯的正义理论对当代不平等讨论具有重要影响，但其反对应得基础的论证常受误解和批评，需要系统重构和评估其核心论证，澄清正义原则作为制度约束而非个人应得理论的性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 罗尔斯的正义即公平理论，包括原初状态、无知之幕、两个正义原则（平等自由原则、机会公平平等原则和差别原则），以及社会作为公平合作体系的理念。
AI.method: 哲学分析和概念重构方法，批判性评估罗尔斯的论证结构，分析其理论要素（原初状态、无知之幕、正义原则）如何排除道德任意优势，并回应关于努力、责任、动机等常见批评。
AI.findings: 罗尔斯的论证有力表明自然禀赋和社会起点不能作为更大回报的道德权利基础，不平等必须向最不利者辩护；正义原则应理解为确保互惠和公共合法性的制度约束，而非基于功绩或效率的分配规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清罗尔斯正义理论作为制度评价的规范性标准而非个人应得理论的本质；为理解社会合作背景下分配正义提供替代道德化和权利基础不平等解释的框架；系统回应关于责任、努力等常见批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估社会制度道德合法性提供规范性标准；强调不平等必须向最不利者辩护的政策含义；将分配正义置于制度设计而非个人应得框架，影响不平等政策讨论方向。

title: Entitlement, Redistribution, and the Limits of Patterned Justice in Robert Nozick

detail.title: Entitlement, Redistribution, and the Limits of Patterned Justice in Robert Nozick

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was developed independently and revised for scholarly dissemination.

detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs and critically evaluates Robert Nozick's entitlement theory of justice as presented in Anarchy, State, and Utopia. Rejecting patterned and end-state principles of distribution, Nozick argues that justice in holdings depends exclusively on historical processes of just acquisition and voluntary transfer. Through his critique of patterned principles and his defense of self-ownership, Nozick contends that redistributive taxation beyond the minimal functions of the state constitutes an unjust form of coercion analogous to forced labor. The paper argues that Nozick's entitlement theory offers a powerful and morally illuminating defense of individual liberty and voluntary exchange, successfully exposing the tension between liberty and distributive patterns. At the same time, it contends that the theory relies on idealized assumptions about historical acquisition, background justice, and social cooperation that limit its plausibility in non-ideal conditions. The paper concludes that while Nozick provides a stringent constraint on state action and a compelling critique of redistribution, his entitlement theory falls short as a comprehensive account of distributive justice in societies shaped by structural inequality and historical injustice.

AI.tldr: 本文重构并批判性评估了诺齐克在《无政府、国家与乌托邦》中提出的权利正义理论。诺齐克反对模式化和目的状态的分配原则，主张持有正义完全取决于公正获取和自愿转移的历史过程。论文认为诺齐克的理论为个人自由和自愿交换提供了有力辩护，但也依赖于理想化的历史获取、背景正义和社会合作假设，在非理想条件下缺乏说服力。
AI.research_question: 诺齐克的权利正义理论是否能为分配正义提供一个全面且可行的框架？
AI.motivation: 诺齐克的权利理论是当代政治哲学中自由至上主义的重要代表，对分配正义理论提出了根本性挑战。需要系统评估该理论在理想和非理想条件下的解释力和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 诺齐克的权利正义理论（entitlement theory of justice），包括自我所有权原则、公正获取原则、自愿转移原则，以及对模式化和目的状态分配原则的批判。
AI.method: 哲学分析和批判性重构方法，通过文本解读、概念分析和逻辑论证来评估诺齐克理论的内在一致性和外部适用性。
AI.findings: 诺齐克的理论成功揭示了自由与分配模式之间的张力，为个人自由提供了有力辩护，但依赖于理想化的历史获取和背景正义假设，在存在结构性不平等和历史不正义的现实社会中缺乏全面性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统重构了诺齐克权利正义理论的核心论证；2）揭示了该理论在理想与非理想条件下的适用性差异；3）指出了历史获取假设和背景正义问题的理论局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为评估再分配政策的正当性提供了自由至上主义视角；2）指出了在现实社会中应用诺齐克理论需要解决的历史不正义问题；3）为思考国家干预的限度提供了理论参考。

title: The Efficiency-Fragility Limit: Slack, Volatility, and Collapse Boundaries in Complex Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Efficiency-Fragility Limit: Slack, Volatility, and Collapse Boundaries in Complex Systems
detail.abstract: Efficiency is typically optimized on mean performance. Fragility, however, is paid in tails: rare delays, long recovery times, and discontinuous collapse under volatility. This paper states and motivates an Efficiency-Fragility Limit (EFL): for a broad class of systems that must process stochastic load with finite capacity, reducing slack yields approximately linear gains in average utilization but superlinear growth in delay, variance, and tail risk as utilization approaches one. The result is not a moral claim about "waste," but a structural constraint: zeroslack operation is generically unstable outside of near-deterministic environments. We anchor the EFL in three canonical domains-queueing, inventory, and feedback control-and connect it to empirical early-warning signatures such as critical slowing down and thickening delay tails. We then sketch how the same geometry appears in software delivery, large-scale computing, biological reserve capacity, and hospital operations. Finally, we define falsifiers and measurement guidance for diagnosing when "efficiency programs" are actually boundary-shifts that export fragility to enclosing systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了效率-脆弱性极限（EFL）理论：在必须处理随机负载的有限容量系统中，减少缓冲空间会线性提升平均利用率，但当利用率接近1时，会导致延迟、方差和尾部风险呈超线性增长，使零缓冲操作在非确定性环境中变得不稳定。
AI.research_question: 在有限容量系统中处理随机负载时，效率优化与系统脆弱性之间存在怎样的结构性约束关系？
AI.motivation: 传统效率优化通常关注平均性能，但系统脆弱性体现在尾部风险中：罕见延迟、长恢复时间和波动下的不连续崩溃。需要理解效率提升如何系统性增加脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效率-脆弱性极限（EFL）理论，基于排队论、库存理论和反馈控制理论，连接临界减速和延迟尾部增厚等经验预警信号。
AI.method: 理论推导与跨领域案例分析相结合，在排队、库存、反馈控制三个经典领域锚定EFL，并扩展到软件交付、大规模计算、生物储备能力和医院运营等实际场景。
AI.findings: 减少缓冲空间会线性提升平均利用率，但当利用率接近1时，延迟、方差和尾部风险呈超线性增长；零缓冲操作在非确定性环境中普遍不稳定；效率提升可能只是将脆弱性转移给外部系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了效率-脆弱性极限（EFL）理论框架，揭示了效率与脆弱性之间的结构性约束关系，为系统稳定性分析提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了诊断"效率计划"是否只是将脆弱性转移给外部系统的方法和测量指南，帮助管理者识别真正的效率提升与脆弱性转移。

detail.title: Organization as a Buffer for Market Disequilibrium: Microfoundations via Reinterpretation of Walras' Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest associated with this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper attempts to mathematically define the function of the "organization" (firm), which is often abstracted in neoclassical general equilibrium theory, through a reinterpretation of the identity of Walras' Law. Conventional theories, such as Human Capital Theory (Becker) and the Rational Expectations Hypothesis (Lucas), have attributed disequilibria and rigidities in the labor market to individual skill characteristics or informational imperfections (illusions) on the part of agents. In contrast, this paper introduces an equilibrium condition derived by transforming Walras' Law. We define an organization as a "structural buffer mechanism" that absorbs excess demand in the goods market (negative shock) by equating it with excess supply in the labor market (internal surplus). From this perspective, we demonstrate that business cycles and employment practices can be explained not as market failures or agent errors, but as structural necessities for the survival of organizations within a market economy.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过重新解释瓦尔拉斯定律的恒等式，从数学上定义了新古典一般均衡理论中常被抽象化的"组织"（企业）功能。论文将组织定义为"结构性缓冲机制"，通过将商品市场的超额需求与劳动力市场的超额供给相等来吸收冲击，从而解释商业周期和雇佣实践是市场经济中组织生存的结构性必要，而非市场失灵或代理人错误。
AI.research_question: 如何从数学上定义组织（企业）在市场经济中的功能？商业周期和雇佣实践是否可以被解释为组织生存的结构性必要而非市场失灵？
AI.motivation: 新古典一般均衡理论通常将组织抽象化处理，而传统理论（如人力资本理论和理性预期假说）将劳动力市场的非均衡和刚性归因于个体技能特征或信息不完全。本文旨在提供一个新的理论框架，将组织作为结构性缓冲机制来解释经济现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 瓦尔拉斯定律及其恒等式转换；2. 新古典一般均衡理论；3. 组织作为"结构性缓冲机制"的概念框架；4. 与传统理论（Becker的人力资本理论、Lucas的理性预期假说）的对比。
AI.method: 通过数学推导和理论分析，重新解释瓦尔拉斯定律的恒等式，推导出新的均衡条件，将组织定义为结构性缓冲机制，并进行理论论证。
AI.findings: 1. 组织可以被定义为吸收商品市场超额需求（负向冲击）的结构性缓冲机制；2. 这种缓冲通过将商品市场的超额需求与劳动力市场的超额供给（内部剩余）相等来实现；3. 商业周期和雇佣实践是组织在市场经济中生存的结构性必要，而非市场失灵或代理人错误的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了组织功能的数学定义；2. 建立了基于瓦尔拉斯定律转换的新均衡条件；3. 提出了"结构性缓冲机制"的新概念框架；4. 挑战了传统理论将经济波动归因于个体特征或信息不完全的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解商业周期提供了新的理论视角；2. 为雇佣实践提供了结构性解释；3. 为组织设计和经济政策制定提供了新的理论基础；4. 有助于重新思考劳动力市场政策和宏观经济管理。

title: The Thermodynamics of Organization: The Function of Financial Capital in Converting Market Disequilibrium
affiliations: Otaru University of Commerce - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Thermodynamics of Organization: The Function of Financial Capital in Converting Market Disequilibrium

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest associated with this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This note aims to resolve the static sign paradox observed in the definition of the organization as a buffer for market disequilibrium, represented by the identity p(C_D-C_S) = w(L_S-L_D), which was proposed in the author's preceding work. In a recession, for the negative shock from the market (LHS) and the positive cost of employment maintenance maintained by the organization (RHS) to be equated, an external injection of energy is indispensable. We introduce "Financial Capital (ΔM)" into the model as this energy source. We conclude that the organization functions as a "thermodynamic mechanism" that converts the entropy (disequilibrium) of the market into the welfare of workers by combusting financial capital as potential energy.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在解决先前研究中提出的组织作为市场失衡缓冲器的静态符号悖论，通过引入金融资本作为外部能量注入，解释组织如何将市场熵（失衡）转化为工人福利的热力学机制。
AI.research_question: 如何解决组织作为市场失衡缓冲器定义中的静态符号悖论？组织如何通过金融资本将市场失衡转化为工人福利？
AI.motivation: 作者先前工作中提出的组织作为市场失衡缓冲器的定义存在静态符号悖论：在衰退期，市场负冲击（左侧）与组织维持就业的正成本（右侧）相等需要外部能量注入，这促使作者引入金融资本来解决这一悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于热力学类比，将组织视为将市场熵（失衡）转化为工人福利的"热力学机制"，金融资本作为潜在能量来源，通过燃烧转化为维持就业的能量。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，在原有组织作为市场失衡缓冲器的恒等式p(C_D-C_S) = w(L_S-L_D)基础上，引入"金融资本(ΔM)"作为外部能量注入变量，解决静态符号悖论。
AI.findings: 引入金融资本作为外部能量源后，组织能够在衰退期将市场负冲击与维持就业的正成本相等，组织本质上是一个将市场熵（失衡）通过燃烧金融资本转化为工人福利的热力学转换机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 解决了组织作为市场失衡缓冲器定义中的静态符号悖论；2. 提出了组织作为"热力学机制"的新理论框架；3. 将金融资本概念化为维持组织缓冲功能的潜在能量来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解组织在衰退期的缓冲作用提供了新视角，强调金融资本在维持就业中的关键作用，对企业管理者和政策制定者在经济下行期制定就业维持策略具有启示意义。

title: Beyond Static Models: Iterative Optimization of Product Mix and Costs for Product Owners and Portfolio Managers

detail.title: Beyond Static Models: Iterative Optimization of Product Mix and Costs for Product Owners and Portfolio Managers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses synthetic data and mathematical modeling with no human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper examines product mix optimization when unit costs depend on production volumes. Traditional approaches assume costs are fixed, yet in practice overhead allocations vary with total output and raw material prices often change with procurement scale. These dependencies create feedback loops between volumes and costs that can alter the optimal allocation of capacity and affect projected profitability. An iterative linear and mixed-integer optimization framework with endogenous cost feedback is developed in which production volumes are optimized subject to capacity and product-level bounds, costs are recalculated to reflect the resulting mix, and the process is repeated until stability is reached. The approach demonstrates how incorporating feedback effects yields production plans that are operationally feasible and more consistent with income statement forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个考虑产量与成本相互反馈的迭代优化框架，用于产品组合优化，相比传统固定成本假设能产生更可行且与财务报表更一致的生产计划。
AI.research_question: 当单位成本依赖于生产量时，如何优化产品组合？
AI.motivation: 传统产品组合优化假设成本固定，但实际上间接费用分配随总产量变化，原材料价格随采购规模变化，这些依赖关系在产量和成本之间形成反馈循环，影响最优产能分配和预期盈利能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生成本反馈理论，考虑产量与成本之间的相互依赖关系，打破传统固定成本假设。
AI.method: 开发迭代线性与混合整数优化框架，包含内生成本反馈：在产能和产品级边界约束下优化生产量，根据结果组合重新计算成本，重复该过程直至达到稳定状态。
AI.findings: 考虑反馈效应能产生操作上可行且与利润表预测更一致的生产计划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出考虑产量与成本相互依赖的内生反馈优化框架，扩展传统产品组合优化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供更准确的产品组合优化工具，能产生更可行且与财务报表预测一致的生产计划，提高决策质量。

title: Do Leadership Transitions Degrade Law Enforcement? Evidence from Sheriff Elections

detail.title: Do Leadership Transitions Degrade Law Enforcement? Evidence from Sheriff Elections
detail.abstract: How disruptive are leadership changes in local law enforcement? While a large body of literature studies the performance effects of electoral turnover among local officials, little is known about county sheriffs. Sheriff elections generate abrupt leadership changes in agencies with substantial authority, raising questions about whether turnover disrupts operations or whether institutional continuity mitigates such effects. This paper investigates whether electoral turnover in law enforcement impacts arrest rates. Using hand-collected data on sheriff elections merged with arrest records, I employ a difference-indifferences design to examine how arrest rates respond, first, to an incumbent sheriff's electoral defeat and, second, to the subsequent transition to new leadership. I find that election losses lead to modest declines in arrests for lower-level offenses, while no significant effects are observed for arrest rates of severe offenses. In contrast, the transition to a new sheriff shows little impact on arrest activity. Analysis of deputy employment data suggests that staffing declines may drive the decrease in arrests following election losses.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨县警长选举更替对逮捕率的影响，发现现任警长选举失败会导致轻微犯罪逮捕率小幅下降，但对严重犯罪逮捕率无显著影响；而新警长上任过渡期对逮捕活动影响不大，人员减少可能是逮捕率下降的原因。
AI.research_question: 地方执法部门领导层更替（特别是县警长选举）是否会影响逮捕率？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要研究地方官员选举更替对绩效的影响，但对县警长这一重要执法职位的研究很少。警长选举会在拥有重大权力的机构中产生突然的领导层变化，这引发了一个问题：这种更替是否会破坏执法运作，还是制度连续性能够缓解这种影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导层更替理论、组织变革理论、制度连续性理论、公共管理中的选举问责理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分法设计，使用手工收集的警长选举数据与逮捕记录合并，分析逮捕率对两个事件的响应：1）现任警长选举失败；2）随后向新领导层的过渡。
AI.findings: 1）选举失败导致轻微犯罪逮捕率小幅下降；2）严重犯罪逮捕率无显著变化；3）新警长上任过渡期对逮捕活动影响有限；4）副警长就业数据分析表明，人员减少可能是选举失败后逮捕率下降的驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）填补了关于县警长选举更替对执法绩效影响的研究空白；2）区分了选举失败和领导过渡两个不同阶段的影响；3）提供了领导层更替在执法机构中的具体机制证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为地方政府管理警长选举过渡期提供参考；2）帮助理解执法机构人员配置与执法活动的关系；3）为政策制定者考虑执法机构稳定性提供实证依据。

title: South Africa: Populism's Next Target

detail.title: South Africa: Populism's Next Target
detail.abstract: Following news of Jacob Zuma's resignation from office, Jessie Duarte, the Deputy Secretary General of the African National Congress (ANC) party, struck a tone that was more elegiac, rather than energetic about the former president's departure. During a press briefing immediately after Zuma's speech, Duarte noted that the ANC's "decision to impose a recall was taken only after exhaustive discussions," lauding Zuma as a "disciplined member" of the ANC. That the decision to remove Zuma, whose epoch is best characterized by economic mismanagement, rampant unemployment, increased crime, and corruption took so long spells trouble for the ANC. Cyril Ramaphosa, who succeeded Zuma as the president of the ANC in December and will take over the reins from Zuma once more in the office of the presidency, inherits a nation that has seen the erosion of its democratic institutions and has slipped into irrelevance among the world's notable emerging economies. Furthermore, as the only majority party in power during the youthful history of South Africa's democracy, the ANC has seen its brand blemished by recalls that took down Zuma and his predecessor, Thabo Mbeki. As demonstrated by voters in the past two general elections, the appetite for undisputed ANC control has declined.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了南非非国大党在雅各布·祖马辞职后的政治困境，探讨了党领导层更替对政党声誉和南非民主制度的影响。
AI.research_question: 非国大党领导层更替（特别是祖马辞职）如何影响该党的政治声誉和南非的民主制度？
AI.motivation: 南非作为新兴民主国家，非国大党长期执政后面临领导危机，祖马时代的经济管理不善、腐败等问题损害了国家形象和民主制度，需要研究这种领导层更替对政党未来的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政党声誉理论、民主制度侵蚀理论、领导层更替政治学、新兴民主国家政党稳定性理论
AI.method: 定性分析，基于政治声明、媒体报道和历史选举数据的文本分析，结合南非政治背景的案例研究
AI.findings: 1. 非国大党在祖马辞职问题上反应迟缓，损害了政党声誉；2. 祖马时代的经济管理不善、腐败等问题导致南非民主制度受到侵蚀；3. 连续两位总统被"召回"削弱了非国大党的政治合法性；4. 选民对非国大党绝对控制的意愿在下降
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了新兴民主国家政党领导层更替的理论框架；2. 提出了"政党声誉侵蚀循环"的概念；3. 丰富了民主制度质量与政党稳定性关系的理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非国大党提供领导层过渡的管理建议；2. 为南非民主制度重建提供政策参考；3. 为其他新兴民主国家的政党治理提供借鉴

title: Trafficability Constrained Harvest Scheduling Under Weather Risk: Evidence from Sugar Beet Logistics
affiliations: WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management, WHU-Otto Beisheim School of Management and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Trafficability Constrained Harvest Scheduling Under Weather Risk: Evidence from Sugar Beet Logistics
detail.abstract: Increasingly wet autumn and winter seasons in Europe are putting winter crop supply chains under pressure. This study proposes a holistic, risk-adjusted scheduling approach for sugar beet harvesting, presenting a framework that is also applicable to other crops or military operations with similar logistical dynamics. We use soil moisture data, physical soil properties, and road type information to model field-level trafficability, identifying operationally infeasible periods for loaders and trucks. Moreover, we propose a Constraint Programming model to find optimal schedules that navigate these blocked periods. In the sequential decision-making context, we demonstrate the superiority of the Risky First strategy relative to a Weather Aware optimization and a standard Reactive benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对欧洲冬季甜菜收获的风险调整调度方法，通过土壤湿度数据、物理特性和道路类型建模田间可通行性，并使用约束规划模型优化调度，证明了Risky First策略优于Weather Aware优化和标准Reactive基准。
AI.research_question: 如何在欧洲日益潮湿的秋冬季节中，为甜菜收获作业开发一个考虑风险调整的优化调度框架？
AI.motivation: 欧洲秋冬季节日益潮湿的气候条件给冬季作物供应链带来压力，特别是甜菜收获作业面临田间可通行性挑战，需要更有效的调度方法来应对天气不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 风险调整调度理论；2. 约束规划优化理论；3. 田间可通行性建模理论；4. 顺序决策制定理论。
AI.method: 1. 使用土壤湿度数据、物理土壤特性和道路类型信息建模田间可通行性；2. 识别装载机和卡车的操作不可行期；3. 开发约束规划模型寻找最优调度方案；4. 比较Risky First策略、Weather Aware优化和标准Reactive基准的性能。
AI.findings: 1. 提出的框架能够有效识别田间操作不可行期；2. 约束规划模型能够生成规避阻塞期的最优调度；3. 在顺序决策制定情境下，Risky First策略优于Weather Aware优化和标准Reactive基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个适用于甜菜收获和其他类似物流动态作物的风险调整调度框架；2. 发展了基于田间可通行性建模的约束规划方法；3. 验证了Risky First策略在顺序决策中的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为农业供应链管理者提供了应对潮湿天气的实用调度工具；2. 框架可扩展到其他作物或具有类似物流动态的军事行动；3. 帮助减少因天气导致的收获损失和运营中断。

title: The Structural Impossibility of Global Financial Stability : The First Theorem of Financial Instability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Structural Impossibility of Global Financial Stability : The First Theorem of Financial Instability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Financial crises are commonly interpreted as episodic deviations caused by regulatory failures, distorted incentives, or inappropriate model assumptions. Such interpretations, however, rest on an implicit premise: that long-run financial stability is, in principle, attainable under sufficiently well-designed institutions and policy frameworks.

This paper challenges that premise.

 I show that in any financial system that simultaneously exhibits (i) intertemporal credit creation, (ii) leverage amplification, (iii) asynchronous information, and (iv) global balance-sheet and market coupling, persistent global financial stability cannot exist as a long-run equilibrium. Under these structural conditions, systemic instability is not an anomaly but a necessary logical outcome of the system’s configuration. Stability, when observed, represents only a transient state in which underlying structural tensions have not yet fully materialized.

 Accordingly, financial crises should not be understood as accidental departures from a stable norm, but as the endogenous realization of the financial system’s intrinsic structural dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了金融稳定是可实现长期均衡的传统观点，证明在具有跨期信贷创造、杠杆放大、异步信息和全球资产负债表耦合的金融系统中，系统性不稳定不是异常而是必然的逻辑结果。
AI.research_question: 在具有跨期信贷创造、杠杆放大、异步信息和全球资产负债表耦合的结构性条件下，长期全球金融稳定是否可能作为均衡状态存在？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将金融危机视为监管失败、激励扭曲或模型假设不当导致的偶然偏离，这种观点隐含的前提是：在制度设计良好的情况下，长期金融稳定原则上是可实现的。本文旨在挑战这一前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融系统的结构性特征分析框架，包括：(1) 跨期信贷创造，(2) 杠杆放大效应，(3) 异步信息，(4) 全球资产负债表和市场耦合。这些特征共同构成了金融系统的内在结构张力。
AI.method: 理论论证和逻辑分析，通过识别金融系统的四个关键结构性特征，证明在这些条件下长期稳定均衡在逻辑上不可能存在。
AI.findings: 在同时具备跨期信贷创造、杠杆放大、异步信息和全球资产负债表耦合的金融系统中，持久全球金融稳定不可能作为长期均衡存在。系统性不稳定不是异常，而是系统配置的必然逻辑结果。观察到的稳定只是结构性张力尚未完全显现的暂时状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了金融稳定是可实现长期均衡的传统范式；2. 提出了金融系统内在不稳定性的结构性解释；3. 将金融危机重新概念化为内生结构性动态的实现，而非偶然偏离。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应放弃追求永久稳定的目标，转而关注管理不可避免的不稳定性；2. 监管框架应基于金融系统内在不稳定性的认识进行设计；3. 风险管理应关注结构性张力的积累和释放过程。

title: From Restoration to Consolidation: A Bi-Annual Evaluative Study of Nigeria's 2025-2026 Fiscal Path and Its Socio-Economic Impact on the Grassroots Economy

detail.title: From Restoration to Consolidation: A Bi-Annual Evaluative Study of Nigeria's 2025-2026 Fiscal Path and Its Socio-Economic Impact on the Grassroots Economy

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval and Research Integrity Statement Ethics Approval: The author confirms that this study, "From Restoration to Consolidation: A Bi-Annual Evaluative Study of Nigeria’s 2025–2026 Fiscal Path," utilizes secondary, publicly available longitudinal data provided by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) and the Debt Management Office (DMO) of Nigeria. As the research involves no human subjects, animal testing, or sensitive personal data, formal institutional ethics committee approval was not required. The study adheres to the highest standards of research integrity and data transparency.

detail.abstract: This study evaluates the profound structural transition in Nigeria's fiscal landscape from the 2025 "Budget of Restoration" to the 2026 "Budget of Consolidation and Shared Prosperity." Moving beyond standard budgetary analysis, the research introduces the original theoretical framework of "Subnational Fiscal Hysteresis" and the "Elasticity Gap" to explain the persistent economic scarring affecting the federation. Utilizing a comprehensive 17-year longitudinal panel dataset (2008-2024) of Internally Generated Revenue (IGR) and debt stocks across all 36 states and the FCT, the paper quantifies a systemic divergence where subnational debt liabilitieslargely denominated in foreign currency-have become inelastic to domestic revenue growth. Findings show that the 2025 "Restoration" primarily achieved an optical recovery at the federal center through currency-devaluation-inflated oil receipts, while the subnational "grassroots" remained trapped in a "Zombie Solvency"cycle. In this state, debt-servicing obligations systematically "crowd out" the productive investments required for the 2026 Ward-Based Development Plan. Furthermore, the study identifies a "Compliance Paradox" within the 2026 Tax Regime, where the administrative friction of digital formalization under the Nigeria Tax Administration Act (NTAA) creates a "Hidden Tax" that negates statutory Personal Income Tax (PIT) relief for the working poor. The research concludes that for the 2026 "Consolidation" to be realistic, Nigeria must bridge the Elasticity Gap through a Rules-Based Neutral Fiscal Stance and a shift toward Endogenous Development, ensuring that fiscal policy functions as a catalyst for value-chain resilience rather than a driver of consumptive debt.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了尼日利亚从2025年"恢复预算"到2026年"巩固与共享繁荣预算"的深刻财政结构转型。研究发现，联邦层面通过货币贬值带来的石油收入实现了表面恢复，而地方政府仍陷于"僵尸偿付能力"循环，债务偿还挤出了生产性投资。研究还发现2026年税收制度存在"合规悖论"，数字正规化的行政摩擦对贫困工作者形成了"隐性税收"。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚从2025年"恢复预算"到2026年"巩固与共享繁荣预算"的财政结构转型如何影响联邦与地方政府的经济关系？特别是，地方政府债务与收入增长的系统性脱节如何阻碍2026年基于社区的发展计划？
AI.motivation: 传统预算分析未能解释尼日利亚联邦与地方政府之间持续存在的经济创伤。需要新的理论框架来理解地方政府债务（主要以外币计价）与国内收入增长之间的系统性脱节，以及这种脱节如何阻碍国家发展计划。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 地方政府财政滞后理论：解释经济创伤在联邦体系中的持续性影响
2. 弹性缺口理论：解释地方政府债务责任与国内收入增长之间的系统性脱节
3. 僵尸偿付能力循环：描述地方政府债务偿还挤占生产性投资的状态
4. 合规悖论：解释数字正规化行政摩擦如何抵消法定税收减免
AI.method: 使用2008-2024年17年纵向面板数据集，涵盖尼日利亚所有36个州和联邦首都区的内部生成收入(IGR)和债务存量。通过量化分析评估债务与收入增长之间的弹性关系。
AI.findings:
1. 2025年"恢复预算"主要通过货币贬值带来的石油收入实现了联邦层面的表面恢复
2. 地方政府仍陷于"僵尸偿付能力"循环，债务偿还义务系统性地挤出了生产性投资
3. 地方政府债务（主要以外币计价）对国内收入增长缺乏弹性
4. 2026年税收制度存在"合规悖论"，数字正规化的行政摩擦对贫困工作者形成了"隐性税收"
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"地方政府财政滞后"和"弹性缺口"的原创理论框架
2. 发展了"僵尸偿付能力循环"概念来解释地方政府财政困境
3. 提出了"合规悖论"理论来解释数字税收管理中的意外后果
4. 为发展中国家联邦财政体系分析提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为尼日利亚2026年"巩固预算"提供了现实性评估
2. 建议通过基于规则的中性财政立场和内生发展来弥合弹性缺口
3. 指出财政政策应作为价值链韧性的催化剂而非消费性债务的驱动因素
4. 为税收政策制定者提供了关于数字正规化意外后果的警示

title: Classical Political Economy and the Structural Limits of Development

detail.title: Classical Political Economy and the Structural Limits of Development
detail.abstract: Contemporary development theory repeatedly encounters structural constraintscommodity dependence, distributional asymmetries, and macroeconomic instabilitythat limit sustained growth despite policy reform. These constraints are often treated as empirical anomalies or institutional failures rather than as intrinsic features of the development process. This paper argues that classical political economy already articulated these limits in a coherent analytical framework. Reexamining Adam Smith, David Ricardo, and Thomas Malthus, the paper shows that classical theory conceptualised development as structurally constrained by scale, income distribution, and instability, rather than as a self-correcting outcome of market expansion. These insights prefigure later structuralist and dependency theories, including the Prebisch-Singer hypothesis, which reformulated classical constraints in a political economy of international asymmetry. By reconstructing this continuity, the paper clarifies why marginal policy interventions-liberalisation, price stabilisation, or institutional adjustment-have repeatedly failed to generate durable development outcomes in commodity-dependent economies. The contribution is not historical recovery but analytical synthesis: classical political economy offers a structurally grounded lens through which persistent development limits can be understood as endogenous rather than contingent. This perspective has direct implications for how development policy is conceptualised and evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文认为古典政治经济学（斯密、李嘉图、马尔萨斯）已经系统阐述了发展的结构性约束（商品依赖、分配不对称、宏观经济不稳定），这些约束是发展过程的内在特征而非偶然异常。古典理论为理解当代发展困境提供了结构性分析框架。
AI.research_question: 为什么当代发展理论中的结构性约束（商品依赖、分配不对称、宏观经济不稳定）在古典政治经济学中已有系统阐述，而这一理论连续性如何帮助我们理解发展政策的局限性？
AI.motivation: 当代发展理论反复遇到结构性约束（商品依赖、分配不对称、宏观经济不稳定），这些约束限制了持续增长，但通常被视为经验异常或制度失败，而非发展过程的内在特征。需要重新审视古典政治经济学对这些问题的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密、大卫·李嘉图和托马斯·马尔萨斯的古典政治经济学理论；结构主义和依附理论，特别是普雷维什-辛格假说；发展经济学中的结构性约束理论。
AI.method: 理论重构与历史分析：重新审视古典政治经济学文本，分析斯密、李嘉图和马尔萨斯对发展结构性约束的论述，建立古典理论与当代结构主义、依附理论的连续性。
AI.findings: 1. 古典政治经济学将发展概念化为受规模、收入分配和不稳定性结构性约束的过程，而非市场扩张的自发结果；2. 古典理论的这些见解预示了后来的结构主义和依附理论；3. 普雷维什-辛格假说在国际不对称的政治经济学中重新表述了古典约束；4. 边际政策干预（自由化、价格稳定、制度调整）在商品依赖经济体中反复失败的原因在于未能解决这些结构性约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重建古典政治经济学与当代发展理论之间的理论连续性；2. 提供结构性分析框架，将持久的发展限制理解为内生性而非偶然性；3. 阐明为什么发展政策需要超越边际干预，解决结构性约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展政策的概念化和评估提供新视角；2. 解释为什么自由化、价格稳定和制度调整等政策在商品依赖经济体中反复失败；3. 强调需要从根本上解决结构性约束而非表面政策调整。

title: Co-lab Nations ESG Partnerships Geriatric Disease Management Strategic Planning Framework for the Development of Subsidized Geriatric Care Implementors Infrastructure Robotic Integration, Care Protocols, and Audit Matrix
affiliations: Swiss School Of Business and Management

detail.title: Co-lab Nations ESG Partnerships Geriatric Disease Management Strategic Planning Framework for the Development of Subsidized Geriatric Care Implementors Infrastructure Robotic Integration, Care Protocols, and Audit Matrix

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
The global demographic landscape is undergoing a seismic shift, characterized by a rapidly aging population and a concurrent contraction in the professional caregiving workforce. This report presents an exhaustive Geriatric Disease Management Training Framework, designed specifically for nursing homes and long-term care facilities facing these dual pressures. The framework moves beyond traditional manual care models, proposing a technology-augmented ecosystem where Socially Assistive Robots (SARs), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices are integrated directly into the clinical workflow.

Crucially, this analysis pioneers the integration of Supply Chain Management (SCM) principles into the discourse of national elder care programs. It dissects the logistics of care delivery, contrasting the centralized pharmaceutical procurement efficiency of China’s National Volume-Based Procurement (NVBP) with the challenges of India’s Government e-Marketplace (GeM), and extends the supply chain concept to the "soft" pipeline of geriatric workforce training. The report synthesizes data from India’s Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY), China’s "9073" model, and Singapore’s Action Plan for Successful Ageing to formulate a robust operational blueprint. This blueprint details Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) and Operational Expenditure (OPEX) models for standardized 50-bed units, financial sustainability mechanisms involving Public-Private Partnerships (PPP), and a "Zero Tolerance" Quality Assurance protocol grounded in WHO QualityRights and ICOPE guidelines. By bridging the gap between high-level policy intent and ground-level operational reality, this document serves as a foundational text for policymakers, development agencies, and social welfare practitioners committed to dignified aging in Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个技术增强的老年疾病管理培训框架，将社交辅助机器人、人工智能和医疗物联网整合到临床工作流程中，并将供应链管理原则应用于国家养老计划，为亚洲养老机构提供可操作的实施方案。
AI.research_question: 如何通过技术增强的老年疾病管理培训框架和供应链管理原则，解决老龄化社会中的专业护理人员短缺问题，并提高养老机构的运营效率和质量？
AI.motivation: 全球人口快速老龄化与专业护理人员短缺的双重压力，传统人工护理模式已无法满足需求，需要创新的技术整合方案来提升养老服务质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 技术增强护理理论：整合社交辅助机器人(SARs)、人工智能(AI)和医疗物联网(IoMT)；2. 供应链管理理论在养老领域的应用；3. 公共-私营伙伴关系(PPP)理论；4. 质量保证理论(WHO QualityRights和ICOPE指南)。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比中国国家集中采购(NVBP)与印度政府电子市场(GeM)的药品采购效率；案例研究法：分析印度AVYAY、中国"9073"模式和新加坡成功老龄化行动计划；框架开发法：构建包含资本支出(CAPEX)和运营支出(OPEX)模型的标准化50床位单元操作蓝图。
AI.findings: 1. 技术整合能显著提升护理效率；2. 供应链管理原则可优化养老资源配置；3. 中国NVBP模式在集中采购方面更高效；4. PPP模式能确保财务可持续性；5. "零容忍"质量保证协议基于国际标准有效提升服务质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将供应链管理理论系统应用于国家养老计划分析；2. 提出"软性"老年劳动力培训供应链概念；3. 建立技术增强型老年护理的理论框架；4. 拓展PPP理论在养老领域的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为养老机构提供可操作的50床位标准化单元实施方案；2. 提供详细的CAPEX和OPEX财务模型；3. 建立基于WHO和ICOPE的质量保证协议；4. 为政策制定者提供亚洲多国经验比较的决策参考；5. 搭建高层政策意图与基层操作现实之间的桥梁。

title: Unmasking Cancer: The Economics of Glycan-Targeting Immunotherapies and the Future of Immune Recognition

detail.title: Unmasking Cancer: The Economics of Glycan-Targeting Immunotherapies and the Future of Immune Recognition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, personal, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this modular essay. The work was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that might be perceived as affecting its objectivity.
declarations.funderStatement: This work is a sovereign research artifact produced entirely through the author’s independent intellectual labour. It received no external funding, sponsorship, or institutional support. The analysis, framing, and conclusions arise from an autonomous research cycle, free from financial influence or organizational direction.

detail.abstract: Recent advances in cancer immunotherapy have revealed a previously under-theorised mechanism of tumour immune evasion: the construction of glycan-based "sugar shields" that suppress immune activation by engaging inhibitory Siglec receptors. In 2025, researchers at MIT and Stanford introduced a hybrid antibody-lectin therapy capable of removing these glycan layers and restoring immune visibility. While the biomedical implications of this discovery have been widely discussed, its economic significance remains unexplored. This paper develops the first economic analysis of glycan-targeting immunotherapies. It examines the innovation incentives shaping investment in glyco-immunology, the potential cost-effectiveness of glycan-removal therapies relative to existing immunotherapies, and the institutional constraints that govern their diffusion.

AI.research_question: 糖基化靶向免疫疗法的经济学意义是什么？包括创新激励、成本效益和制度约束等方面

title: Evaluating LLMs for Dynamic, Multimodal Clinical Decision-Making
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania - Operations & Information Management Department and WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management

detail.title: Evaluating LLMs for Dynamic, Multimodal Clinical Decision-Making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research has been approved by the Institutional Review Board at the University of Pennsylvania Protocol under Protocol #859387.
declarations.funderStatement: Mack Institute for Innovation Management.

detail.abstract:
In this study, we evaluate the ability of a multimodal LLM to autonomously manage a virtual end-to-end diagnostic workflow. We test an autonomous agent in a high-fidelity medical simulation across four acute care scenarios. We compare the AI’s policy against over 14,000 simulation runs by medical students and an expert emergency room physician benchmark. We find that (1) a multimodal LLM can function as a competent virtual physician, successfully stabilizing patients and solving complex cases that require interpreting text, audio, and imaging in real time, closely mirroring most of the actions of the expert physician; (2) the AI agent matches or exceeds medical students in case completion rates and secondary outcomes such as time and diagnostic accuracy, though it engages in less patient communication than both students and the expert physician; and (3) the agent's evolving diagnostic beliefs exhibit value-of-information properties—front-loading high-yield tests, experiencing diminishing belief revisions over time, and producing well-calibrated confidence estimates. These findings suggest that LLMs can orchestrate complex clinical workflows rather than merely execute isolated tasks. They also offer design implications for human-AI collaboration and diagnostic pathway design in low-resource and time-critical healthcare operations.

Supplemental Video: https://tinyurl.com/llm-dynamic-medical-eval

AI.tldr: 本研究评估多模态大语言模型在虚拟端到端诊断工作流中的自主管理能力。在四个急性护理场景的高保真医学模拟中，AI代理的表现优于医学生，接近专家医生水平，但患者沟通较少。
AI.research_question: 多模态大语言模型能否自主管理虚拟端到端诊断工作流，并在急性护理场景中达到或超越医学生和专家医生的表现？
AI.motivation: 探索LLM在复杂临床工作流中的潜力，超越单一任务执行，为低资源、时间紧迫的医疗环境提供人机协作和诊断路径设计的新思路。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多模态LLM的自主代理理论、信息价值理论（value-of-information）、诊断信念演化理论，以及临床工作流编排理论。
AI.method: 在高保真医学模拟环境中测试多模态LLM自主代理，涵盖四个急性护理场景。与14,000多次医学生模拟运行和急诊专家医生基准进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 1) 多模态LLM可作为胜任的虚拟医生，稳定患者并解决需要实时解读文本、音频和影像的复杂病例，接近专家医生行动；2) AI代理在病例完成率、时间和诊断准确性方面匹配或超越医学生，但患者沟通较少；3) 代理的诊断信念演化展现信息价值特性：优先高收益测试、信念修正随时间递减、产生良好校准的置信度估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明LLM能够编排复杂临床工作流而不仅仅是执行孤立任务；提出LLM在诊断信念演化中展现信息价值特性的理论框架；为自主医疗代理理论发展提供实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低资源和时间紧迫的医疗环境提供人机协作设计启示；为诊断路径优化提供新思路；展示了多模态LLM在急性护理模拟中的实际应用潜力。

title: The Missing Human Factor: Non-Hospital Personnel in the Operating Room Clarifying Access Credentialing and Competency Boundaries for Non-Employee Personnel in Healthcare Facilities A Pre-Normative Governance and Patient Safety White Paper Framework developed by Healthcare Workforce Access Standards Commission

detail.title: The Missing Human Factor: Non-Hospital Personnel in the Operating Room Clarifying Access Credentialing and Competency Boundaries for Non-Employee Personnel in Healthcare Facilities A Pre-Normative Governance and Patient Safety White Paper Framework developed by Healthcare Workforce Access Standards Commission

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with organizations engaged in patient safety research, workforce governance, and standards development related to non-hospital personnel in healthcare settings. This paper is an independent, pre-normative analysis intended to examine governance gaps and regulatory alignment issues. No commercial products, services, or certification programs are evaluated or promoted, and no compensation was received in connection with this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted independently by the author. No external grant or commercial funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Non-hospital personnel, including medical device representatives, play an integral role in modern surgical workflows, yet their presence and activities within healthcare facilities are commonly governed through access-based credentialing models rather than role-based competency verification. While hospitals routinely rely on vendor credentialing organizations (VCOs) to manage access requirements for non-employees, these systems are primarily designed to authorize visits, not to define or verify competency for work performed within the clinical environment. This misalignment creates a governance gap in which non-hospital personnel may perform operationally and safety-relevant tasks without a formally defined role or documented competency verification, despite regulatory and accreditation expectations that healthcare facilities ensure competence for all individuals whose actions affect patient care.

This paper introduces the VISIT vs JOB framework to distinguish between access for observation and the performance of defined work by non-employees in healthcare settings. Drawing on principles of human factors engineering, patient safety science, and healthcare governance, the paper examines how the absence of role definition for non-hospital personnel contributes to reliance on informal trust-based practices, particularly during critical moments such as surgical time-outs. The analysis highlights how this structural blind spot undermines system learning, accountability, and compliance with competency verification obligations embedded within CMS Conditions of Participation and accreditation frameworks.

The paper concludes by outlining the need for a pre-normative governance approach that clearly delineates access credentialing from competency assessment and establishes a foundation for consensus-based conformity standards. By reframing non-hospital workforce participation through a role- and work-based lens, the VISIT vs JOB framework provides a pathway for healthcare organizations to strengthen patient safety, clarify accountability, and align workforce governance with regulatory expectations without altering professional licensure or hospital privileging structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了VISIT vs JOB框架，区分医疗环境中非医院人员的访问权限和工作职责，旨在解决当前基于访问的认证系统无法验证非医院人员临床工作能力的治理缺口问题。
AI.research_question: 如何有效治理医疗环境中非医院人员（如医疗设备代表）的工作参与，确保其临床工作的能力验证和角色定义，以符合患者安全和监管要求？
AI.motivation: 当前医院依赖供应商认证组织管理非医院人员的访问权限，但这些系统只授权访问而不验证临床工作能力，导致非医院人员可能在无正式角色定义和能力验证的情况下执行安全和操作相关任务，这与监管机构要求确保所有影响患者护理的人员具备相应能力的期望存在差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人因工程学、患者安全科学和医疗治理原则，提出VISIT vs JOB框架，区分访问认证和能力评估两个维度。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过理论分析和现有治理结构的批判性评估，提出新的治理模型。
AI.findings: 当前治理结构存在结构性盲点，导致依赖非正式的信任实践，特别是在手术暂停等关键时刻；这削弱了系统学习、问责制，并违反了CMS参与条件和认证框架中的能力验证义务。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了VISIT vs JOB理论框架，为区分医疗环境中非医院人员的访问和工作参与提供了概念基础；发展了预规范性治理方法，明确区分访问认证和能力评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构提供了加强患者安全、明确问责制、使劳动力治理与监管期望保持一致的具体路径，无需改变专业执照或医院特权结构；为制定基于共识的符合性标准奠定了基础。

title: Private Equity and Industry Competition
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Department of Business Economics and Swedish House of Finance

detail.title: Private Equity and Industry Competition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to declare.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how industry concentration evolves through changes in corporate ownership, with a focus on private equity. Drawing on ownership and financial data for over five million public and private firms in the United Kingdom from 2002 to 2021, we examine how ownership types reshape industry structure. We introduce a decomposition of the Herfindahl Index that separates ownership-driven consolidation from reallocation driven by firm growth and entry, and apply it separately to private equity-owned, listed, and non-listed firms. Ownership-driven consolidation is pervasive and mechanically increases concentration, while growth-driven reallocation typically reduces it, resulting in modest net changes. Private equity-owned and listed firms contribute similarly to consolidation, whereas non-listed firms act as a countervailing force through relative growth. Consolidation is more prevalent in markets experiencing declining markups, indicating that ownership reallocation often occurs under increasing competitive pressure. Reflecting this selection, consolidation is associated with lower industry-level markups, while firm-level markups do not increase systematically, suggesting that concentration changes primarily operate through reallocation and productivity rather than higher prices.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析英国500多万家上市和非上市企业2002-2021年的所有权数据，发现所有权驱动的行业整合（特别是私募股权和上市公司）普遍存在并提高行业集中度，而增长驱动的资源再分配则降低集中度，净变化较小。整合更多发生在利润率下降的市场中，表明所有权重组常伴随竞争压力增加。
AI.research_question: 企业所有权变化（特别是私募股权）如何影响行业集中度的演变？所有权驱动的整合与增长驱动的资源再分配对行业结构有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 理解行业集中度变化背后的驱动因素，特别是所有权结构变化（如私募股权收购）对市场竞争结构的影响，以及这种影响是通过价格机制还是效率机制实现的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产业组织理论和所有权理论，研究所有权结构变化对市场竞争和效率的影响机制，区分所有权驱动整合与增长驱动再分配的不同效应。
AI.method: 使用英国2002-2021年500多万家上市和非上市企业的所有权和财务数据，开发赫芬达尔指数的分解方法，将所有权驱动整合与增长驱动再分配分离，分别分析私募股权所有、上市和非上市企业的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 所有权驱动整合普遍存在并提高行业集中度，增长驱动再分配则降低集中度，净变化较小；2. 私募股权所有和上市公司对整合贡献相似，非上市企业通过相对增长起抵消作用；3. 整合更多发生在利润率下降的市场；4. 行业层面利润率下降，企业层面利润率未系统性上升，表明集中度变化主要通过资源再分配和生产率而非提价实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了分解行业集中度变化的新方法，区分所有权驱动整合与增长驱动再分配；2. 揭示了所有权结构变化对市场竞争的复杂影响机制；3. 提供了所有权重组在竞争压力下发生的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供评估行业集中度变化原因的工具；2. 帮助监管机构区分反竞争整合与效率驱动整合；3. 为投资者理解私募股权等所有权变化对行业结构的影响提供参考。

title: Outlier-Robust Evaluation of Fixed-Event Macroeconomic Survey Expectations
affiliations: Bank of Greece and European Central Bank (ECB)
